rules.rule_name: Program Initialization on Fresh Entry
rules.rule_description: On every program invocation, working storage, communication areas, and default values are initialized before any processing begins.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
1:Program Initialization
Initialize working storage,
communication areas, set defaults

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Credit Card Update program is invoked
acceptance_criteria.When: The program starts execution
acceptance_criteria.Then: The working storage area (CC-WORK-AREA), miscellaneous storage (WS-MISC-STORAGE), and the communication area (WS-COMMAREA) are initialized to their default values; the current transaction ID is set to the program's own transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID); and the return message flag is set to OFF

rules.rule_name: Communication Area Handling - Fresh Entry Detection
rules.rule_description: Determines whether the program is being entered for the first time or re-entered from a prior interaction, and initializes or restores session data accordingly.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
2:Communication Area Handling
Is EIBCALEN = 0 or
fresh entry from menu?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Credit Card Update program has been invoked
acceptance_criteria.When: The communication area length (EIBCALEN) is zero, OR the calling program is the Main Menu (LIT-MENUPGM) and the program has not been re-entered (NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The CARDDEMO-COMMAREA and the program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) are initialized to defaults; the program entry flag is set to ENTER (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER); and the card details state is set to NOT-FETCHED (CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED)

rules.rule_name: Communication Area Restoration on Re-entry
rules.rule_description: When the program is re-entered from a prior interaction, the previously stored session data is restored from the communication area passed by CICS.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
2:Communication Area Handling
Is EIBCALEN = 0 or
fresh entry from menu?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Credit Card Update program has been invoked
acceptance_criteria.When: The communication area length (EIBCALEN) is greater than zero AND the calling program is not the Main Menu OR the program has been re-entered
acceptance_criteria.Then: The CARDDEMO-COMMAREA is restored from the first portion of DFHCOMMAREA; and the program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) is restored from the second portion of DFHCOMMAREA starting after the length of CARDDEMO-COMMAREA

rules.rule_name: Function Key Mapping
rules.rule_description: Maps the physical key pressed by the user (EIBAID) to a logical function key indicator used throughout the program. PF13-PF24 are treated as equivalents to PF01-PF12.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
3:PF Key Mapping and Validation
Map pressed function key
Validate: Enter/PF03/PF05/PF12

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed a key on the terminal
acceptance_criteria.When: The program reads the EIBAID value
acceptance_criteria.Then: The corresponding logical key flag is set: ENTER key sets CCARD-AID-ENTER; CLEAR sets CCARD-AID-CLEAR; PA1 sets CCARD-AID-PA1; PA2 sets CCARD-AID-PA2; PF1-PF12 set CCARD-AID-PFK01 through CCARD-AID-PFK12 respectively; PF13-PF24 are mapped to the same flags as PF01-PF12 respectively (e.g., PF13 maps to CCARD-AID-PFK01, PF24 maps to CCARD-AID-PFK12)

rules.rule_name: Valid Function Key Determination
rules.rule_description: Only specific function keys are considered valid for the Credit Card Update program. Invalid keys are defaulted to ENTER to prevent unintended navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
3:PF Key Mapping and Validation
Map pressed function key
Validate: Enter/PF03/PF05/PF12

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed a key and the logical key flag has been set
acceptance_criteria.When: The program evaluates which keys are valid
acceptance_criteria.Then: The key is considered VALID if it is: ENTER, OR PF3, OR PF5 AND the current state is Changes-OK-Not-Confirmed (CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED), OR PF12 AND card details have already been fetched (NOT CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED); any other key is considered INVALID and is defaulted to ENTER (CCARD-AID-ENTER is set to TRUE)

rules.rule_name: Exit and Navigation Control via PF3
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF3, or when an update has completed or failed and the user arrived from the Card List screen, the program navigates back to the appropriate calling program or the main menu.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
4:Exit and Navigation Control
PF03 pressed OR
Update done/failed from
Card List screen?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Credit Card Update screen
acceptance_criteria.When: PF3 is pressed, OR the update state is Changes-Okayed-And-Done or Changes-Failed AND the last map set used was the Card List map set (LIT-CCLISTMAPSET)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The destination transaction ID is set: if CDEMO-FROM-TRANID is empty or spaces then the Main Menu transaction ID (LIT-MENUTRANID) is used, otherwise the calling transaction ID (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID) is used; the destination program is set: if CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is empty or spaces then the Main Menu program (LIT-MENUPGM) is used, otherwise the calling program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM) is used; the current transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID) and program name (LIT-THISPGM) are recorded as the originating transaction and program; if the last map set was the Card List map set then Account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) and Card Number (CDEMO-CARD-NUM) are cleared to zeros; the user type is set to USER (CDEMO-USRTYP-USER); the program entry flag is set to ENTER (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER); and control is transferred to the destination program via XCTL with the updated CARDDEMO-COMMAREA

rules.rule_name: Automatic Card Detail Fetch on Arrival from Card List
rules.rule_description: When the program is entered directly from the Card List screen, or when PF12 is pressed while the calling program is the Card List, the card details are automatically fetched using the account and card number passed in the session.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
5:Fetch Card Details from Card List
Arriving from Card List screen
or PF12 from Card List?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has been entered
acceptance_criteria.When: The program entry state is ENTER and the calling program is the Card List program (LIT-CCLISTPGM), OR PF12 is pressed and the calling program is the Card List program (LIT-CCLISTPGM)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program re-entry flag is set (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER); input, account filter, and card filter flags are all set to valid (INPUT-OK, FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID, FLG-CARDFILTER-ISVALID); the Account ID from the session (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) is moved to the working account field (CC-ACCT-ID-N); the Card Number from the session (CDEMO-CARD-NUM) is moved to the working card field (CC-CARD-NUM-N); the card data read routine is performed; the state is set to Show Details (CCUP-SHOW-DETAILS); and the screen is sent to the terminal

rules.rule_name: Fresh Entry Blank Search Screen Presentation
rules.rule_description: When the program is entered fresh (details not yet fetched and it is a first-time entry or entry from the main menu), a blank search screen is displayed prompting the user to enter search criteria.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
6:Fresh Entry Screen Presentation
Details not fetched AND
fresh program entry OR
from main menu?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has been entered
acceptance_criteria.When: The card details state is NOT-FETCHED (CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED) AND the program entry flag is ENTER (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER), OR the calling program is the Main Menu (LIT-MENUPGM) AND the program has not been re-entered (NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) is initialized; a blank search screen is sent to the terminal prompting for Account ID and Card Number; the program re-entry flag is set (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER); and the card details state remains NOT-FETCHED (CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED)

rules.rule_name: Post-Update Screen Reset to Fresh Search
rules.rule_description: After a successful update or a failed update (not originating from the Card List screen), the program resets all state and presents a fresh blank search screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
7:Post-Update Screen Reset
Changes completed or
changes failed?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has processed an update attempt
acceptance_criteria.When: The current state is Changes-Okayed-And-Done (CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE) OR Changes-Failed (CCUP-CHANGES-FAILED)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA), miscellaneous storage (WS-MISC-STORAGE), Account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID), and Card Number (CDEMO-CARD-NUM) are all initialized to defaults; the program entry flag is set to ENTER (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER); a fresh blank search screen is sent to the terminal; the program re-entry flag is set (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER); and the card details state is set to NOT-FETCHED (CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED)

rules.rule_name: Screen Data Reception and Asterisk/Space Normalization
rules.rule_description: When the user submits the screen, all input fields are received and normalized: asterisk (*) or space values in key fields are treated as blank (LOW-VALUES), ensuring consistent downstream validation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
9:Screen Data Reception
Receive map input from terminal
Replace asterisks/spaces with low-values
for account, card, name, status,
expiry month and year

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has submitted the Credit Card Update screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen map (CCRDUPAI) is received from the terminal
acceptance_criteria.Then: The new card details area (CCUP-NEW-DETAILS) is initialized; for each of the following fields — Account ID (ACCTSIDI), Card Number (CARDSIDI), Card Name (CRDNAMEI), Card Status Code (CRDSTCDI), Expiry Month (EXPMONI), Expiry Year (EXPYEARI) — if the value is an asterisk (*) or spaces then LOW-VALUES is stored in both the working field and the new-details holding area; otherwise the entered value is stored; the Expiry Day (EXPDAYI) is always moved as-is without normalization

rules.rule_name: Account Number Validation
rules.rule_description: Validates that the Account ID entered by the user is present, numeric, and non-zero before a card lookup can be performed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
10:Account Number Validation
Check account number provided,
numeric, 11-digit non-zero

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is in search mode (card details not yet fetched) and the user has submitted the screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID field (CC-ACCT-ID) is evaluated
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the Account ID is LOW-VALUES, spaces, or zero (CC-ACCT-ID-N equals zero) then: INPUT-ERROR is set, FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK is set, the Account ID in the session (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) is set to zero, the new account ID (CCUP-NEW-ACCTID) is set to LOW-VALUES, and if no prior error message exists the prompt message is set to 'prompt for account'; if the Account ID is not numeric then: INPUT-ERROR is set, FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK is set, the session Account ID is set to zero, the new account ID is set to LOW-VALUES, and if no prior error message exists the message 'ACCOUNT FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER' is set; if the Account ID is valid numeric then: it is stored in both CDEMO-ACCT-ID and CCUP-NEW-ACCTID, and FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID is set

rules.rule_name: Card Number Validation
rules.rule_description: Validates that the Card Number entered by the user is present, numeric, and non-zero before a card lookup can be performed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
11:Card Number Validation
Check card number provided,
numeric, 16-digit number

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is in search mode (card details not yet fetched) and the user has submitted the screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The Card Number field (CC-CARD-NUM) is evaluated
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the Card Number is LOW-VALUES, spaces, or zero (CC-CARD-NUM-N equals zero) then: INPUT-ERROR is set, FLG-CARDFILTER-BLANK is set, both CDEMO-CARD-NUM and CCUP-NEW-CARDID are set to zero/LOW-VALUES, and if no prior error message exists the prompt message is set to 'prompt for card'; if the Card Number is not numeric then: INPUT-ERROR is set, FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK is set, CDEMO-CARD-NUM is set to zero, CCUP-NEW-CARDID is set to LOW-VALUES, and if no prior error message exists the message 'CARD ID FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 16 DIGIT NUMBER' is set; if the Card Number is valid numeric then: the numeric value (CC-CARD-NUM-N) is stored in CDEMO-CARD-NUM, the character value (CC-CARD-NUM) is stored in CCUP-NEW-CARDID, and FLG-CARDFILTER-ISVALID is set

rules.rule_name: Search Criteria Completeness Check
rules.rule_description: When the program is in search mode, if both the Account ID and Card Number are blank, the user is informed that no search criteria have been provided.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
12:Search Criteria Completeness Check
If both account and card blank
set no search criteria message

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is in search mode (card details not yet fetched) and both Account ID and Card Number validations have been performed
acceptance_criteria.When: Both FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK and FLG-CARDFILTER-BLANK are set (both fields were blank)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The state NO-SEARCH-CRITERIA-RECEIVED is set; the new card data area (CCUP-NEW-CARDDATA) is set to LOW-VALUES; processing exits the input editing routine without further validation

rules.rule_name: Cardholder Name Validation
rules.rule_description: Validates that the cardholder name entered is present and contains only alphabetic characters and spaces.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
13:Card Name Validation
Check name provided,
alphabetic characters and spaces only

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is in edit mode (card details already fetched) and the user has submitted changes
acceptance_criteria.When: The new Card Name field (CCUP-NEW-CRDNAME) is evaluated
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the name is LOW-VALUES, spaces, or zeros then: INPUT-ERROR is set, FLG-CARDNAME-BLANK is set, and if no prior error message exists the prompt message is set to 'prompt for name'; if the name is present, all valid alphabetic characters (LIT-ALL-ALPHA-FROM) are converted to spaces (LIT-ALL-SPACES-TO) in a check copy, and if any non-space characters remain after trimming then: INPUT-ERROR is set, FLG-CARDNAME-NOT-OK is set, and if no prior error message exists the message is set to 'name must be alphabetic' (WS-NAME-MUST-BE-ALPHA); if the name passes all checks then FLG-CARDNAME-ISVALID is set

rules.rule_name: Card Active Status Validation
rules.rule_description: Validates that the card active status entered by the user is present and is either Y (Yes/Active) or N (No/Inactive).
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
14:Card Active Status Validation
Check status provided,
must be Y or N

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is in edit mode (card details already fetched) and the user has submitted changes
acceptance_criteria.When: The new Card Status Code field (CCUP-NEW-CRDSTCD) is evaluated
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the status is LOW-VALUES, spaces, or zeros then: INPUT-ERROR is set, FLG-CARDSTATUS-BLANK is set, and if no prior error message exists the message is set to 'card status must be yes or no' (CARD-STATUS-MUST-BE-YES-NO); if the status is present, it is moved to FLG-YES-NO-CHECK and evaluated: if FLG-YES-NO-VALID is true then FLG-CARDSTATUS-ISVALID is set; otherwise INPUT-ERROR is set, FLG-CARDSTATUS-NOT-OK is set, and if no prior error message exists the message is set to 'card status must be yes or no' (CARD-STATUS-MUST-BE-YES-NO)

rules.rule_name: Card Expiry Month Validation
rules.rule_description: Validates that the card expiry month entered by the user is present and represents a valid calendar month.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
15:Card Expiry Month Validation
Check month provided,
numeric, between 1 and 12

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is in edit mode (card details already fetched) and the user has submitted changes
acceptance_criteria.When: The new Expiry Month field (CCUP-NEW-EXPMON) is evaluated
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the month is LOW-VALUES, spaces, or zeros then: INPUT-ERROR is set, FLG-CARDEXPMON-BLANK is set, and if no prior error message exists the message is set to 'card expiry month not valid' (CARD-EXPIRY-MONTH-NOT-VALID); if the month is present, it is moved to CARD-MONTH-CHECK and evaluated against the VALID-MONTH condition: if valid then FLG-CARDEXPMON-ISVALID is set; otherwise INPUT-ERROR is set, FLG-CARDEXPMON-NOT-OK is set, and if no prior error message exists the message is set to 'card expiry month not valid' (CARD-EXPIRY-MONTH-NOT-VALID)

rules.rule_name: Card Expiry Year Validation
rules.rule_description: Validates that the card expiry year entered by the user is present and represents a valid year.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
16:Card Expiry Year Validation
Check year provided,
numeric, between 1950 and 2099

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is in edit mode (card details already fetched) and the user has submitted changes
acceptance_criteria.When: The new Expiry Year field (CCUP-NEW-EXPYEAR) is evaluated
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the year is LOW-VALUES, spaces, or zeros then: INPUT-ERROR is set, FLG-CARDEXPYEAR-BLANK is set, and if no prior error message exists the message is set to 'card expiry year not valid' (CARD-EXPIRY-YEAR-NOT-VALID); if the year is present, it is moved to CARD-YEAR-CHECK and evaluated against the VALID-YEAR condition: if valid then FLG-CARDEXPYEAR-ISVALID is set; otherwise INPUT-ERROR is set, FLG-CARDEXPYEAR-NOT-OK is set, and if no prior error message exists the message is set to 'card expiry year not valid' (CARD-EXPIRY-YEAR-NOT-VALID)

rules.rule_name: Change Detection Between New and Original Card Data
rules.rule_description: When the program is in edit mode, the newly entered card data is compared against the originally fetched data to determine whether the user has made any changes.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
17:Change Detection
Compare new card data against
originally fetched card data

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is in edit mode (card details already fetched) and the user has submitted the screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The uppercase version of the new card data (CCUP-NEW-CARDDATA) is compared against the uppercase version of the original card data (CCUP-OLD-CARDDATA)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the two values are equal (case-insensitive comparison using FUNCTION UPPER-CASE) then NO-CHANGES-DETECTED is set; if NO-CHANGES-DETECTED is set, or the state is Changes-OK-Not-Confirmed (CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED), or the state is Changes-Okayed-And-Done (CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE) then all field validation flags (FLG-CARDNAME-ISVALID, FLG-CARDSTATUS-ISVALID, FLG-CARDEXPMON-ISVALID, FLG-CARDEXPYEAR-ISVALID) are set to valid and the edit routine exits without further validation

rules.rule_name: Action Decision - Search Mode Card Lookup Trigger
rules.rule_description: When the program is in search mode (details not fetched) or PF12 is pressed, and both search keys are valid, the card lookup is triggered.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
18:Action Decision Logic
Decide next action based on
current program state

acceptance_criteria.Given: The action decision logic is being evaluated
acceptance_criteria.When: The current state is Details-Not-Fetched (CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED) OR PF12 has been pressed (CCARD-AID-PFK12)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If both FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID and FLG-CARDFILTER-ISVALID are set then the card data read routine (9000-READ-DATA) is performed; if the card is found (FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT) then the state is set to Show Details (CCUP-SHOW-DETAILS)

rules.rule_name: Action Decision - Show Details State Handling
rules.rule_description: When the program is in Show Details state, determines whether to advance to the confirmation-pending state based on whether there are input errors or no changes.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
18:Action Decision Logic
Decide next action based on
current program state

acceptance_criteria.Given: The action decision logic is being evaluated
acceptance_criteria.When: The current state is Show Details (CCUP-SHOW-DETAILS)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If INPUT-ERROR is set OR NO-CHANGES-DETECTED is set then no state change occurs (continue); otherwise the state is advanced to Changes-OK-Not-Confirmed (CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED)

rules.rule_name: Action Decision - Confirmation and Update Trigger via PF5
rules.rule_description: When changes are valid and pending confirmation, pressing PF5 triggers the write processing and evaluates the outcome to set the appropriate result state.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
18:Action Decision Logic
Decide next action based on
current program state

acceptance_criteria.Given: The action decision logic is being evaluated
acceptance_criteria.When: The current state is Changes-OK-Not-Confirmed (CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED) AND PF5 has been pressed (CCARD-AID-PFK05)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The write processing routine (9200-WRITE-PROCESSING) is performed; the outcome is evaluated: if COULD-NOT-LOCK-FOR-UPDATE then the state is set to CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-LOCK-ERROR; if LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED then the state is set to CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-BUT-FAILED; if DATA-WAS-CHANGED-BEFORE-UPDATE then the state is set to Show Details (CCUP-SHOW-DETAILS); otherwise the state is set to Changes-Okayed-And-Done (CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE)

rules.rule_name: Action Decision - Post-Success State Handling
rules.rule_description: After a successful update, the program transitions to show the updated card details and optionally clears session account/card data if there is no originating transaction.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
18:Action Decision Logic
Decide next action based on
current program state

acceptance_criteria.Given: The action decision logic is being evaluated
acceptance_criteria.When: The current state is Changes-Okayed-And-Done (CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The state is set to Show Details (CCUP-SHOW-DETAILS); if CDEMO-FROM-TRANID is LOW-VALUES or spaces then CDEMO-ACCT-ID and CDEMO-CARD-NUM are set to zeros and CDEMO-ACCT-STATUS is set to LOW-VALUES

rules.rule_name: Card Data Read from Database
rules.rule_description: Reads the card record from the CARDDAT VSAM file using the card number as the lookup key to retrieve current card details for display.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
19:Card Data Read for Display
Read card record using
card number as key

acceptance_criteria.Given: A valid Account ID and Card Number have been provided
acceptance_criteria.When: The card data read routine is executed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The card number (CC-CARD-NUM) is used as the record key (WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM) to read the card record from the CARDDAT file; if the record is found (DFHRESP NORMAL) then FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT is set; if the record is not found (DFHRESP NOTFND) then INPUT-ERROR is set, FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK and FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK are set, and if no prior error message exists the message 'did not find account/card combination' (DID-NOT-FIND-ACCTCARD-COMBO) is set; if any other error occurs then INPUT-ERROR is set and FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK is set

rules.rule_name: Card Data Preparation for Display
rules.rule_description: After a card record is successfully read, the relevant fields are extracted, the cardholder name is converted to uppercase, and all values are stored in the old-details holding area for display and later comparison.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
20:Card Data Preparation for Display
Extract CVV, embossed name uppercase,
expiry year/month/day, active status
Store in old-details holding area

acceptance_criteria.Given: A card record has been successfully read from the CARDDAT file
acceptance_criteria.When: FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT is set
acceptance_criteria.Then: The old details area (CCUP-OLD-DETAILS) is initialized; the Account ID (CC-ACCT-ID) is stored in CCUP-OLD-ACCTID; the Card Number (CC-CARD-NUM) is stored in CCUP-OLD-CARDID; the CVV code (CARD-CVV-CD) is stored in CCUP-OLD-CVV-CD; the cardholder name (CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME) is converted to uppercase (LIT-LOWER converted to LIT-UPPER) and stored in CCUP-OLD-CRDNAME; the expiry year is extracted from positions 1-4 of CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE and stored in CCUP-OLD-EXPYEAR; the expiry month is extracted from positions 6-7 of CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE and stored in CCUP-OLD-EXPMON; the expiry day is extracted from positions 9-10 of CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE and stored in CCUP-OLD-EXPDAY; the active status (CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS) is stored in CCUP-OLD-CRDSTCD

rules.rule_name: Concurrent Update Detection via Re-read with Lock
rules.rule_description: Before saving changes, the card record is re-read with an exclusive lock and compared against the values originally displayed to the user to detect if another user has modified the record in the interim.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
21:Concurrent Update Detection
Re-read card record with lock
Compare current DB values against
originally fetched values

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has confirmed changes by pressing PF5 and the write processing routine has been invoked
acceptance_criteria.When: The card record is re-read from the CARDDAT file with an UPDATE lock using the card number as the key
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the lock read fails then COULD-NOT-LOCK-FOR-UPDATE is set and processing exits; if the lock read succeeds then the current database values are compared against the originally fetched values (CCUP-OLD-*): CVV code (CARD-CVV-CD vs CCUP-OLD-CVV-CD), cardholder name after uppercase conversion (CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME vs CCUP-OLD-CRDNAME), expiry year from positions 1-4 (vs CCUP-OLD-EXPYEAR), expiry month from positions 6-7 (vs CCUP-OLD-EXPMON), expiry day from positions 9-10 (vs CCUP-OLD-EXPDAY), and active status (CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS vs CCUP-OLD-CRDSTCD); if any field differs then DATA-WAS-CHANGED-BEFORE-UPDATE is set, the old-details holding area is refreshed with the current database values, and processing exits without saving

rules.rule_name: Card Record Update Write
rules.rule_description: Constructs the updated card record from the user's new values and the original unchanged values, then writes it back to the CARDDAT file.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
22:Card Record Update
Prepare updated record:
new name, expiry date YYYY-MM-DD,
active status, CVV
Write updated record to card database

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card record has been locked and no concurrent changes have been detected
acceptance_criteria.When: The card update record (CARD-UPDATE-RECORD) is prepared and written
acceptance_criteria.Then: The update record is initialized; the card number (CCUP-NEW-CARDID) is stored in CARD-UPDATE-NUM; the account ID (CC-ACCT-ID-N) is stored in CARD-UPDATE-ACCT-ID; the CVV code is carried forward from the original (CCUP-NEW-CVV-CD converted to CARD-CVV-CD-N stored in CARD-UPDATE-CVV-CD); the new cardholder name (CCUP-NEW-CRDNAME) is stored in CARD-UPDATE-EMBOSSED-NAME; the expiry date is constructed in YYYY-MM-DD format by concatenating new expiry year (CCUP-NEW-EXPYEAR), literal '-', new expiry month (CCUP-NEW-EXPMON), literal '-', and the ORIGINAL expiry day (CCUP-NEW-EXPDAY) into CARD-UPDATE-EXPIRAION-DATE; the new active status (CCUP-NEW-CRDSTCD) is stored in CARD-UPDATE-ACTIVE-STATUS; the record is rewritten to the CARDDAT file; if the rewrite fails then LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED is set

rules.rule_name: Update Outcome Evaluation
rules.rule_description: After the write processing routine completes, the outcome is evaluated and the appropriate success or failure state is set for display to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
23:Update Outcome Handling
Evaluate update result

acceptance_criteria.Given: The write processing routine (9200-WRITE-PROCESSING) has completed
acceptance_criteria.When: The update result flags are evaluated
acceptance_criteria.Then: If COULD-NOT-LOCK-FOR-UPDATE is set then the state CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-LOCK-ERROR is set; if LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED is set then the state CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-BUT-FAILED is set; if DATA-WAS-CHANGED-BEFORE-UPDATE is set then the state is set to Show Details (CCUP-SHOW-DETAILS) to re-display the refreshed data; otherwise the state is set to Changes-Okayed-And-Done (CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE)

rules.rule_name: Screen Header Initialization
rules.rule_description: Before sending the screen to the user, the output screen area is initialized and the standard header fields are populated with current system values.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
24:Screen Initialization
Initialize output screen area
Populate header: titles, transaction ID,
program name, current date and time

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is preparing to send a screen to the terminal
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen initialization routine (3100-SCREEN-INIT) is executed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The output screen area (CCRDUPAO) is set to LOW-VALUES; the screen title lines (TITLE01O, TITLE02O) are populated from CCDA-TITLE01 and CCDA-TITLE02; the transaction name (TRNNAMEO) is set to the current transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID); the program name (PGMNAMEO) is set to the current program name (LIT-THISPGM); the current date is formatted as MM/DD/YY and placed in CURDATEO; the current time is formatted as HH:MM:SS and placed in CURTIMEO

rules.rule_name: Screen Field Population Based on Program State
rules.rule_description: The screen fields are populated with appropriate values depending on the current program state, ensuring the user sees the correct data for their current workflow step.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
25:Screen Variable Population
Populate screen fields based on state:
old values for display, new values
for changes, blank for fresh entry

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is preparing to send a screen to the terminal and the program entry flag is not ENTER (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER)
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen variable population routine (3200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS) is executed
acceptance_criteria.Then: If Account ID (CC-ACCT-ID-N) is zero then ACCTSIDO is set to LOW-VALUES, otherwise it is populated with CC-ACCT-ID; if Card Number (CC-CARD-NUM-N) is zero then CARDSIDO is set to LOW-VALUES, otherwise it is populated with CC-CARD-NUM; for card detail fields: if state is Details-Not-Fetched then all detail fields (CRDNAMEO, CRDSTCDO, EXPDAYO, EXPMONO, EXPYEARO) are set to LOW-VALUES; if state is Show-Details then all detail fields are populated from the old-details holding area (CCUP-OLD-*); if state is any Changes-Made state then CRDNAMEO, CRDSTCDO, EXPMONO, EXPYEARO are populated from new values (CCUP-NEW-*) and EXPDAYO is populated from the original value (CCUP-OLD-EXPDAY); for any other state the old-details values are used; if the program entry flag IS ENTER then no field population occurs

rules.rule_name: Informational Message Setup Based on Program State
rules.rule_description: Sets the appropriate informational message for the user based on the current program state, guiding the user through the workflow.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
26:Information Message Setup
Set informational message:
prompt search keys, card found,
prompt changes, confirm, success, failure

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is preparing to send a screen to the terminal
acceptance_criteria.When: The information message setup routine (3250-SETUP-INFOMSG) is executed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message (INFOMSGO) is set based on state: if CDEMO-PGM-ENTER or CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED then PROMPT-FOR-SEARCH-KEYS message is set; if CCUP-SHOW-DETAILS then FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT message is set; if CCUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK then PROMPT-FOR-CHANGES message is set; if CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED then PROMPT-FOR-CONFIRMATION message is set; if CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE then CONFIRM-UPDATE-SUCCESS message is set; if CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-LOCK-ERROR or CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-BUT-FAILED then INFORM-FAILURE message is set; if WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE then PROMPT-FOR-SEARCH-KEYS is set; the error message (ERRMSGO) is always populated from WS-RETURN-MSG

rules.rule_name: Screen Field Editability Control Based on Program State
rules.rule_description: Controls which fields on the screen are editable versus protected (read-only) based on the current program state, enforcing the correct workflow step.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
27:Screen Field Attribute Control
Set field attributes protected/editable
based on program state

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is preparing to send a screen to the terminal
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen attribute control routine (3300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS) is executed for field editability
acceptance_criteria.Then: If state is Details-Not-Fetched: Account ID (ACCTSIDA) and Card Number (CARDSIDA) are set to editable (DFHBMFSE); Card Name (CRDNAMEA), Card Status (CRDSTCDA), Expiry Month (EXPMONA), Expiry Year (EXPYEARA) are set to protected (DFHBMPRF); if state is Show-Details OR Changes-Not-OK: Account ID and Card Number are set to protected (DFHBMPRF); Card Name, Card Status, Expiry Month, Expiry Year are set to editable (DFHBMFSE); if state is Changes-OK-Not-Confirmed OR Changes-Okayed-And-Done: ALL fields (Account ID, Card Number, Card Name, Card Status, Expiry Month, Expiry Year) are set to protected (DFHBMPRF); for any other state: Account ID and Card Number are editable; Card Name, Card Status, Expiry Month, Expiry Year are protected

rules.rule_name: Cursor Positioning Based on Validation State
rules.rule_description: Automatically positions the cursor on the most relevant field based on the current validation errors or program state, guiding the user to the field requiring attention.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
28:Cursor Positioning
Position cursor on appropriate field
based on validation errors or state

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is preparing to send a screen to the terminal
acceptance_criteria.When: The cursor positioning logic within the screen attribute control routine (3300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS) is evaluated
acceptance_criteria.Then: Cursor length (-1) is set on the first matching condition in priority order: if FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT or NO-CHANGES-DETECTED then cursor is placed on Card Name (CRDNAMEL); if FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK or FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK then cursor is placed on Account ID (ACCTSIDL); if FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK or FLG-CARDFILTER-BLANK then cursor is placed on Card Number (CARDSIDL); if FLG-CARDNAME-NOT-OK or FLG-CARDNAME-BLANK then cursor is placed on Card Name (CRDNAMEL); if FLG-CARDSTATUS-NOT-OK or FLG-CARDSTATUS-BLANK then cursor is placed on Card Status (CRDSTCDL); if FLG-CARDEXPMON-NOT-OK or FLG-CARDEXPMON-BLANK then cursor is placed on Expiry Month (EXPMONL); if FLG-CARDEXPYEAR-NOT-OK or FLG-CARDEXPYEAR-BLANK then cursor is placed on Expiry Year (EXPYEARL); otherwise cursor defaults to Account ID (ACCTSIDL)

rules.rule_name: Screen Color Coding for Errors and Highlights
rules.rule_description: Applies visual color coding to screen fields to highlight errors in red, show default colors for fields populated from the Card List, and highlight the function key area when confirmation is required.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
29:Screen Color Coding
Apply colors: red for errors,
default for card list fields,
highlight function keys for confirmation

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is preparing to send a screen to the terminal
acceptance_criteria.When: The color coding logic within the screen attribute control routine (3300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS) is evaluated
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the last map set used was the Card List map set (LIT-CCLISTMAPSET) then Account ID color (ACCTSIDC) and Card Number color (CARDSIDC) are set to default (DFHDFCOL); if FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK then Account ID color is set to RED (DFHRED); if FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK AND program has been re-entered then Account ID display shows '*' and color is set to RED; if FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK then Card Number color is set to RED; if FLG-CARDFILTER-BLANK AND program has been re-entered then Card Number display shows '*' and color is set to RED; if FLG-CARDNAME-NOT-OK AND state is Changes-Not-OK then Card Name color (CRDNAMEC) is set to RED; if FLG-CARDNAME-BLANK AND state is Changes-Not-OK then Card Name shows '*' and color is RED; if FLG-CARDSTATUS-NOT-OK AND state is Changes-Not-OK then Card Status color (CRDSTCDC) is set to RED; if FLG-CARDSTATUS-BLANK AND state is Changes-Not-OK then Card Status shows '*' and color is RED; Expiry Day color (EXPDAYC) is always set to dark/non-interactive (DFHBMDAR); if FLG-CARDEXPMON-NOT-OK AND state is Changes-Not-OK then Expiry Month color (EXPMONC) is set to RED; if FLG-CARDEXPMON-BLANK AND state is Changes-Not-OK then Expiry Month shows '*' and color is RED; if FLG-CARDEXPYEAR-NOT-OK AND state is Changes-Not-OK then Expiry Year color (EXPYEARC) is set to RED; if FLG-CARDEXPYEAR-BLANK AND state is Changes-Not-OK then Expiry Year shows '*' and color is RED; if WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE then info message attribute (INFOMSGA) is set to dark (DFHBMDAR), otherwise it is set to bright yellow (DFHBMBRY); if state is PROMPT-FOR-CONFIRMATION then the function key area attribute (FKEYSCA) is set to bright yellow (DFHBMBRY)

rules.rule_name: Screen Transmission to Terminal
rules.rule_description: Sends the fully prepared and formatted screen map to the user's terminal with cursor positioning enabled and the keyboard unlocked for input.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
30:Screen Transmission
Send formatted screen map to terminal
with cursor positioning and keyboard unlock

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen has been fully initialized, populated, and attributed
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen transmission routine (3400-SEND-SCREEN) is executed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The next map set (CCARD-NEXT-MAPSET) is set to LIT-THISMAPSET and the next map (CCARD-NEXT-MAP) is set to LIT-THISMAP; the screen map (CCRDUPAO) is sent to the terminal using CICS SEND with CURSOR positioning, ERASE to clear the screen, and FREEKB to unlock the keyboard

rules.rule_name: Program Return with Updated Communication Area
rules.rule_description: Before returning control to CICS, the current error message and all session state data are saved into the communication area so they are available on the next program invocation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
31:Program Return
Save error messages and comm area data
Return control to CICS with
transaction ID and updated comm area

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has completed its current processing cycle
acceptance_criteria.When: The COMMON-RETURN routine is executed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current return message (WS-RETURN-MSG) is moved to the screen error message field (CCARD-ERROR-MSG); the CARDDEMO-COMMAREA is moved to the first portion of WS-COMMAREA; the program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) is moved to WS-COMMAREA starting at the position after CARDDEMO-COMMAREA; control is returned to CICS via EXEC CICS RETURN with the current transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID) and the full WS-COMMAREA passed as the communication area for the next invocation

key_functionalities.title: Program Initialization
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Program Entry])
    B[Clear Working Storage Area\nReset all work fields to default values]
    C[Clear Miscellaneous Storage\nReset all miscellaneous fields]
    D[Clear Communication Area\nReset communication area to defaults]
    E[Set Current Transaction ID\nStore this program's transaction identifier]
    F[Turn Off Return Message Flag\nNo messages to display at startup]
    G([Initialization Complete\nProceed to Communication Area Handling])

    A --> B
    B --> C
    C --> D
    D --> E
    E --> F
    F --> G

rules.rule_name: Reset Working Storage Area on Program Entry
rules.rule_description: At program entry, all working storage fields used during card update processing must be reset to their default values to ensure no residual data from a previous session affects the current execution.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Clear Working Storage Area
Reset all work fields to default values

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Credit Card Update program has been invoked and is beginning execution
acceptance_criteria.When: The program starts its initialization sequence
acceptance_criteria.Then: The working storage area (CC-WORK-AREA) must be fully reset to its default initial values, clearing all card-related work fields such as account ID, card number, and any intermediate processing fields used during the update workflow

rules.rule_name: Reset Miscellaneous Storage Area on Program Entry
rules.rule_description: At program entry, all miscellaneous storage fields must be reset to their default values to ensure a clean processing environment, preventing any carry-over of error messages, flags, or temporary values from prior executions.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Clear Miscellaneous Storage
Reset all miscellaneous fields

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Credit Card Update program has been invoked and the working storage area has been cleared
acceptance_criteria.When: The program continues its initialization sequence
acceptance_criteria.Then: The miscellaneous storage area (WS-MISC-STORAGE) must be fully reset to its default initial values, clearing all auxiliary fields including error messages, response codes, and temporary processing indicators

rules.rule_name: Reset Communication Area on Program Entry
rules.rule_description: At program entry, the communication area used to pass data between programs must be reset to its default values to ensure no stale inter-program data influences the current session's processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Clear Communication Area
Reset communication area to defaults

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Credit Card Update program has been invoked and both the working storage and miscellaneous storage areas have been cleared
acceptance_criteria.When: The program continues its initialization sequence
acceptance_criteria.Then: The communication area (WS-COMMAREA) must be fully reset to its default initial values, clearing all fields used for inter-program communication including account ID, card number, program identifiers, transaction identifiers, and session state flags

rules.rule_name: Establish Current Transaction Identity on Program Entry
rules.rule_description: At program entry, the program must record its own transaction identifier into the working session context so that it can be referenced during navigation, return routing, and inter-program communication throughout the session.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Current Transaction ID
Store this program's transaction identifier

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Credit Card Update program has been invoked and all storage areas have been cleared
acceptance_criteria.When: The program sets up its session identity
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current program's transaction identifier (LIT-THISTRANID) must be stored in the working transaction ID field (WS-TRANID), establishing the identity of this transaction for use in screen headers, navigation routing, and communication area handoffs

rules.rule_name: Suppress Return Messages at Program Startup
rules.rule_description: At program entry, the return message display flag must be turned off so that no error or informational messages from a prior interaction are inadvertently shown to the user when the program first initializes.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Turn Off Return Message Flag
No messages to display at startup

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Credit Card Update program has been invoked, all storage areas have been cleared, and the transaction ID has been set
acceptance_criteria.When: The program completes its initialization sequence
acceptance_criteria.Then: The return message flag (WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF) must be set to TRUE, ensuring that no return messages are displayed to the user during the initial program entry, and that any message display logic later in the program will only show messages that are explicitly set during the current interaction

key_functionalities.title: Communication Area Handling
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Start: Communication Area Handling])
    B{Is this a brand new\nsession with no prior\ncommunication data?}
    C{Is the program being\ncalled fresh from\nthe Main Menu?}
    D[Initialize all communication areas\nwith default empty values]
    E[Mark program state as\nFresh Entry]
    F[Mark card details as\nNot Yet Retrieved]
    G[Load existing communication data\nfrom previous interaction\ninto main communication area]
    H[Load program-specific\ncommunication data\nfrom previous interaction]
    I([End: Communication Area Ready])

    A --> B
    B -->|Yes - No prior session data| D
    B -->|No - Prior session exists| C
    C -->|Yes - Fresh call from Main Menu| D
    C -->|No - Returning user interaction| G
    D --> E
    E --> F
    F --> I
    G --> H
    H --> I

rules.rule_name: Detect Brand-New Session with No Prior Communication Data
rules.rule_description: Determines whether the Credit Card Update program is being invoked for the very first time in a new session, where no prior interaction data exists to restore.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is this a brand new session with no prior communication data?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user initiates the Credit Card Update program
acceptance_criteria.When: There is no communication data from any prior session (the communication area length passed to the program is zero)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program identifies this as a brand-new session and proceeds to initialize all communication areas with default empty values, mark the program state as Fresh Entry, and mark card details as Not Yet Retrieved

rules.rule_name: Detect Fresh Call from Main Menu Without Prior Re-Entry
rules.rule_description: Determines whether the Credit Card Update program is being called fresh from the Main Menu as a first-time entry (not a re-entry), even when prior session communication data technically exists.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is the program being called fresh from the Main Menu?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user navigates to the Credit Card Update program and prior session communication data exists
acceptance_criteria.When: The originating program is identified as the Main Menu program AND the program has not been previously re-entered in this interaction cycle
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program treats this as a fresh entry equivalent to a brand-new session and proceeds to initialize all communication areas with default empty values, mark the program state as Fresh Entry, and mark card details as Not Yet Retrieved

rules.rule_name: Initialize All Communication Areas for Fresh Program Entry
rules.rule_description: When the program is entered fresh (either as a brand-new session or as a first-time call from the Main Menu), all shared and program-specific communication areas must be reset to their default empty state to prevent stale data from a prior session from influencing the current interaction.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Initialize all communication areas with default empty values

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has determined this is a brand-new session or a fresh call from the Main Menu
acceptance_criteria.When: The initialization step is executed
acceptance_criteria.Then: Both the main shared communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) and the program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) are cleared and set to their default empty values, ensuring no residual data from any prior session is present

rules.rule_name: Mark Program State as Fresh Entry
rules.rule_description: After initializing communication areas for a fresh session, the program must record its current state as a Fresh Entry so that subsequent processing steps know to present the initial search screen rather than attempting to resume a prior workflow.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark program state as Fresh Entry

acceptance_criteria.Given: All communication areas have been initialized for a fresh program entry
acceptance_criteria.When: The program state flag is set
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program state is marked as 'Program Enter' (fresh entry), indicating that the program is starting its workflow from the beginning and downstream logic should treat this as an initial entry point

rules.rule_name: Mark Card Details as Not Yet Retrieved
rules.rule_description: As part of fresh program entry initialization, the program must explicitly flag that no card details have been fetched yet, so the screen displays an empty search form prompting the user to enter Account ID and Card Number.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark card details as Not Yet Retrieved

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program state has been marked as Fresh Entry
acceptance_criteria.When: The card details retrieval status flag is set
acceptance_criteria.Then: The card details status is marked as 'Details Not Fetched', indicating that no card information has been retrieved from the database yet and the user must provide search criteria (Account ID and Card Number) before any card details can be displayed

rules.rule_name: Load Main Communication Area from Prior Interaction
rules.rule_description: When a returning user re-enters the Credit Card Update program after a prior interaction, the shared communication area data passed from the previous interaction must be restored so that session context (such as account ID, card number, and navigation history) is preserved.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Load existing communication data from previous interaction into main communication area

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is returning to the Credit Card Update program after a prior interaction and prior session communication data exists
acceptance_criteria.When: The program determines this is not a brand-new session and not a fresh call from the Main Menu
acceptance_criteria.Then: The first portion of the passed communication data, corresponding exactly to the length of the main shared communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA), is loaded into the main communication area, restoring all shared session context including account ID, card number, originating program, transaction IDs, and navigation state

rules.rule_name: Load Program-Specific Communication Area from Prior Interaction
rules.rule_description: In addition to the shared communication area, the Credit Card Update program maintains its own program-specific communication area that tracks the card update workflow state (e.g., whether details have been fetched, whether changes are pending confirmation). This must also be restored from the prior interaction to allow the workflow to resume correctly.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Load program-specific communication data from previous interaction

acceptance_criteria.Given: The main shared communication area has been successfully loaded from the prior interaction data
acceptance_criteria.When: The program-specific communication area is being restored
acceptance_criteria.Then: The second portion of the passed communication data, starting immediately after the main communication area and spanning exactly the length of the program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA), is loaded into the program-specific communication area, restoring the card update workflow state including card detail fetch status, change confirmation status, and all field-level validation flags from the prior interaction

rules.rule_name: Map Terminal Key Press to Logical Function Key
rules.rule_description: When a user presses any key on the terminal, the system identifies and maps the physical key press to a named logical function key (Enter, PF03, PF05, PF12, Clear, PA1, PA2, or PF01–PF12) so that subsequent business logic can act on a consistent, named key identity.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Capture the key pressed by the user on the terminal

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is interacting with the Credit Card Update screen and presses a key on the terminal
acceptance_criteria.When: The system captures the key pressed (Enter, Clear, PA1, PA2, PF1 through PF12)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system maps the physical key to its corresponding logical key identifier: Enter key maps to 'Enter Action', Clear maps to 'Clear Action', PA1 maps to 'PA1 Action', PA2 maps to 'PA2 Action', PF1 maps to 'PF01', PF2 maps to 'PF02', PF3 maps to 'PF03 - Exit/Back', PF4 maps to 'PF04', PF5 maps to 'PF05 - Confirm Update', PF6 maps to 'PF06', PF7 maps to 'PF07', PF8 maps to 'PF08', PF9 maps to 'PF09', PF10 maps to 'PF10', PF11 maps to 'PF11', PF12 maps to 'PF12 - Search/Refresh'

rules.rule_name: Map Extended Function Keys PF13–PF24 to PF01–PF12 Equivalents
rules.rule_description: Extended function keys PF13 through PF24 are treated as direct equivalents of PF01 through PF12 respectively, ensuring consistent behavior regardless of which row of function keys the user presses on the terminal keyboard.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Capture the key pressed by the user on the terminal

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is interacting with the Credit Card Update screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses any extended function key PF13 through PF24
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system maps the extended key to its base equivalent: PF13 maps to PF01, PF14 maps to PF02, PF15 maps to PF03 (Exit/Back), PF16 maps to PF04, PF17 maps to PF05 (Confirm Update), PF18 maps to PF06, PF19 maps to PF07, PF20 maps to PF08, PF21 maps to PF09, PF22 maps to PF10, PF23 maps to PF11, PF24 maps to PF12 (Search/Refresh), so that the same business actions are triggered regardless of which function key row is used

rules.rule_name: Enter Key Is Always a Valid Action
rules.rule_description: The Enter key is unconditionally valid in all program states. Pressing Enter always constitutes a valid user action and the system will process the current screen inputs regardless of the current workflow state.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Enter key pressed?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card Update screen in any program state (Details Not Fetched, Show Details, Changes Not OK, Changes Pending Confirmation, or Changes Done)
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the Enter key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the key as valid and proceeds to process the screen inputs without any restriction

rules.rule_name: PF03 Exit Key Is Always a Valid Action
rules.rule_description: The PF03 key (Exit/Back) is unconditionally valid in all program states. A user may exit the Credit Card Update screen at any time regardless of what data has been entered or what workflow state the screen is in.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is PF03 Exit pressed?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card Update screen in any program state
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF03 (or its equivalent PF15)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the key as valid and proceeds to execute the exit/back navigation action without any restriction

rules.rule_name: PF05 Confirm Key Is Valid Only When Changes Are Awaiting Confirmation
rules.rule_description: The PF05 key (Confirm Update) is only a valid action when the program is in the 'Changes OK - Not Confirmed' state, meaning the user has entered valid changes that have not yet been saved. Pressing PF05 in any other state is not a valid action.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is PF05 pressed AND changes are ready for confirmation?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card Update screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF05 (or its equivalent PF17)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the program state is 'Changes OK - Not Confirmed' (valid changes have been entered and are awaiting user confirmation), the system marks the key as valid and proceeds to the save/confirmation workflow; If the program state is anything other than 'Changes OK - Not Confirmed' (e.g., Details Not Fetched, Show Details, Changes Not OK, or Changes Already Done), the key is treated as invalid and the system defaults to Enter key behavior to safely re-display the screen

rules.rule_name: PF12 Search/Refresh Key Is Valid Only When Card Details Have Been Fetched
rules.rule_description: The PF12 key (Search/Refresh) is only a valid action when card details have already been retrieved and are currently displayed on the screen. Pressing PF12 before any card has been looked up is not a valid action, as there is nothing to refresh.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is PF12 pressed AND card details have been fetched?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card Update screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF12 (or its equivalent PF24)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If card details have already been fetched and are displayed (program state is NOT 'Details Not Fetched'), the system marks the key as valid and proceeds to re-fetch and refresh the card data from the database; If card details have NOT yet been fetched (program state is 'Details Not Fetched'), the key is treated as invalid and the system defaults to Enter key behavior to safely re-display the screen

rules.rule_name: Invalid or Unsupported Key Press Defaults to Enter Key Behavior
rules.rule_description: Any key press that is not valid in the current program context (including unsupported keys such as PA1, PA2, Clear, PF01, PF02, PF04, PF06–PF11, and context-invalid uses of PF05 or PF12) is treated as an invalid action. The system safely recovers by defaulting to Enter key behavior, which re-displays the current screen without causing errors or unintended navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Mark Key as INVALID
Default to Enter key behavior
to safely re-display screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card Update screen and the system has initially marked the current key press as invalid
acceptance_criteria.When: The validation check determines the key is not valid in the current context — specifically: the key is not Enter, AND the key is not PF03, AND it is not the case that PF05 was pressed while changes are pending confirmation, AND it is not the case that PF12 was pressed while card details have already been fetched
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system overrides the captured key and sets the active key to 'Enter', so that the screen is safely re-displayed with the current data and state, preventing any unintended action from being executed

rules.rule_name: Identify Valid Exit and Navigation Trigger Conditions
rules.rule_description: Determines the valid conditions under which the Exit and Navigation Control is triggered: when the user presses PF03 (Back/Exit), when a card update has completed successfully and the user arrived from the Card List screen, or when a card update has failed and the user arrived from the Card List screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: What triggered the exit?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Credit Card Update screen and has either pressed PF03, or the system has completed a card update (successfully or with failure) and the last screen visited was the Card List screen (CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET equals the Card List mapset identifier)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the current program state and the key pressed to determine if exit and navigation should be triggered
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system confirms that exit and navigation processing should proceed if: (1) PF03 was pressed, OR (2) the card update was completed successfully AND the user came from the Card List screen, OR (3) the card update failed AND the user came from the Card List screen. In all three cases, the system internally marks the action as a PF03-type navigation event and proceeds with destination resolution.

rules.rule_name: Determine Destination Transaction for Navigation
rules.rule_description: Determines which transaction the system should navigate to when exiting the Credit Card Update screen. If the session contains a valid originating transaction ID, the user is returned to that transaction; otherwise, the system defaults to the Main Menu transaction.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is a calling transaction ID available?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The exit and navigation control has been triggered and the system needs to determine the destination transaction
acceptance_criteria.When: The system checks whether the originating transaction ID (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID) stored in the session context is empty (LOW-VALUES) or blank (SPACES)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the originating transaction ID is empty or blank, the destination transaction is set to the Main Menu transaction (LIT-MENUTRANID). If the originating transaction ID contains a valid value, the destination transaction is set to that originating transaction ID (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID copied to CDEMO-TO-TRANID).

rules.rule_name: Determine Destination Program for Navigation
rules.rule_description: Determines which program the system should transfer control to when exiting the Credit Card Update screen. If the session contains a valid originating program name, the user is returned to that program; otherwise, the system defaults to the Main Menu program.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is a calling program name available?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The destination transaction has been resolved and the system now needs to determine the destination program
acceptance_criteria.When: The system checks whether the originating program name (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM) stored in the session context is empty (LOW-VALUES) or blank (SPACES)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the originating program name is empty or blank, the destination program is set to the Main Menu program (LIT-MENUPGM). If the originating program name contains a valid value, the destination program is set to that originating program name (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM copied to CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM).

rules.rule_name: Clear Account Number and Card Number When Navigating from Card List Screen
rules.rule_description: When the user navigates away from the Credit Card Update screen and their session originated from the Card List screen, the Account Number and Card Number must be cleared from the session context to prevent stale search context from being carried forward.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Did user arrive from Card List screen?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The exit and navigation control is processing and the destination program and transaction have been resolved
acceptance_criteria.When: The system checks whether the last mapset used (CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET) matches the Card List screen mapset identifier (LIT-CCLISTMAPSET)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the user arrived from the Card List screen (CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET equals LIT-CCLISTMAPSET), the Account Number (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) and Card Number (CDEMO-CARD-NUM) are both set to zeros in the session context. If the user did not arrive from the Card List screen, the Account Number and Card Number are retained unchanged in the session context.

rules.rule_name: Record Current Program as the Source of Navigation in Session Context
rules.rule_description: Before transferring control to the destination program, the system records the current program's identity as the navigation source in the shared session context, sets the user type to standard user, and marks the program state as a fresh entry so the destination program knows where the navigation originated.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Mark current program as the source of navigation
Set user type to standard user
Set program state to fresh entry

acceptance_criteria.Given: The destination program and transaction have been resolved, and account/card context has been handled appropriately
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the session context data before transferring control to the destination program
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) record the current transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID) as the originating transaction (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID), (2) record the current program name (LIT-THISPGM) as the originating program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM), (3) record the current mapset (LIT-THISMAPSET) as the last mapset used (CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET), (4) record the current map (LIT-THISMAP) as the last map used (CDEMO-LAST-MAP), (5) set the user type to standard user (CDEMO-USRTYP-USER), and (6) set the program state to fresh entry (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER).

rules.rule_name: Transfer Control to Destination Program with Full Session Context
rules.rule_description: After all navigation context has been prepared, the system transfers control to the resolved destination program, passing the complete session context data (communication area) so the destination program has full awareness of the navigation origin and user session state.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Transfer control to destination program passing all context data

acceptance_criteria.Given: All navigation context has been prepared: destination program is set in CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM, session context (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) contains the updated originating program, transaction, mapset, map, user type, and program state, and a database synchronization point has been established
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes the program transfer to the destination program
acceptance_criteria.Then: Control is transferred to the program identified in CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM, and the complete session context data (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) is passed to the destination program so it can resume processing with full knowledge of the navigation source and user session.
