rules.rule_name: Lock Card Record for Update Using Card Number
rules.rule_description: Before any update can be made to a card record, the system must exclusively lock the card record in the database using the card number as the key, to prevent simultaneous updates by other users.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Attempt to Lock Card Record for Update using Card Number

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has confirmed changes to a card record and the card number is available in the current session
acceptance_criteria.When: The system attempts to retrieve and lock the card record from the card database using the card number as the lookup key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The card record is locked exclusively for update, preventing other users from modifying it simultaneously, and processing continues to verify data integrity before applying changes

rules.rule_name: Card Record Lock Failure Prevents Update
rules.rule_description: If the card record cannot be locked for update (e.g., it is already locked by another user or process), the update must be aborted and the user must be informed that the update cannot proceed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Lock Successful?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has attempted to lock the card record for update using the card number
acceptance_criteria.When: The lock attempt is unsuccessful (the record cannot be exclusively acquired for update)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The update is immediately aborted, a lock error status (COULD-NOT-LOCK-FOR-UPDATE) is set, and the user is notified that the update cannot proceed; no changes are written to the database

rules.rule_name: Detect Concurrent Modification of Card Record Before Update
rules.rule_description: After successfully locking the card record, the system must verify that the card data has not been changed by another user between the time it was originally displayed to the current user and the time the update is being applied. This protects against lost updates in a concurrent environment.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Check if Card Data was Modified by Another User
Compare Current DB Values vs Originally Fetched Values

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card record has been successfully locked for update and the system holds the originally fetched card values (CVV code, cardholder name, expiry year, expiry month, expiry day, and active status)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system compares the current database values of the card record against the originally fetched values for all of the following fields: CVV Code, Cardholder Name (converted to uppercase), Expiry Year, Expiry Month, Expiry Day, and Active Status
acceptance_criteria.Then: If all six fields match exactly, the data is confirmed unchanged and the update proceeds; if any field differs, a concurrent change is detected and the update is blocked

rules.rule_name: Refresh Card Details and Notify User of Concurrent Change
rules.rule_description: When a concurrent modification is detected (another user changed the card record after it was displayed to the current user), the system must refresh the displayed card details with the latest database values and notify the user so they can review the current state before re-attempting their update.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Refresh Old Details with Latest Database Values
Notify User of Concurrent Change

acceptance_criteria.Given: A concurrent change has been detected, meaning the current database values differ from the values originally shown to the user
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the concurrent change condition
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the DATA-WAS-CHANGED-BEFORE-UPDATE status flag, refreshes the stored original card details with the latest values from the database for all fields (CVV Code, Cardholder Name, Expiry Year, Expiry Month, Expiry Day, Active Status), and returns to display the updated card details to the user so they can review and re-confirm their changes

rules.rule_name: Initialize a Clean Card Update Record Before Populating
rules.rule_description: Before populating the card update record with new values, the update record must be fully initialized (cleared) to ensure no residual or stale data from previous operations is carried into the new update.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Initialize New Card Update Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card record has been locked, no concurrent modification has been detected, and the system is ready to prepare the updated card record
acceptance_criteria.When: The system begins constructing the card update record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The card update record is fully initialized and cleared of all prior values before any new field values are populated

rules.rule_name: Populate Card Update Record with Card Number and Account ID
rules.rule_description: The card update record must be populated with the card number (from the user's confirmed input) and the account ID (from the current session) as key identifying fields of the card record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Populate Update Record:
- New Card Number
- Account ID
- CVV Code

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card update record has been initialized and the confirmed new card number and current session account ID are available
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the identifying fields of the card update record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The card update record is populated with the new card number (CCUP-NEW-CARDID) as the card identifier and the account ID (CC-ACCT-ID-N) as the account identifier

rules.rule_name: Carry Forward Original CVV Code to Updated Card Record
rules.rule_description: The CVV code is not a user-editable field in this update process. The original CVV code from the fetched card record must be carried forward unchanged into the updated card record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Populate Update Record:
- New Card Number
- Account ID
- CVV Code

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card update record is being populated and the original CVV code (CCUP-NEW-CVV-CD) from the previously fetched card record is available
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sets the CVV code on the card update record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The CVV code from the originally fetched card record is transferred to the card update record (CARD-UPDATE-CVV-CD) without modification, preserving the original CVV value

rules.rule_name: Set New Embossed Cardholder Name on Updated Card Record
rules.rule_description: The cardholder name entered and validated by the user must be applied to the card update record as the new embossed name on the card.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set New Embossed Card Name

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card update record is being populated and the user has provided a validated new cardholder name (CCUP-NEW-CRDNAME) consisting of alphabetic characters only
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sets the cardholder name on the card update record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The new cardholder name entered by the user is moved to the embossed name field (CARD-UPDATE-EMBOSSED-NAME) of the card update record

rules.rule_name: Format and Set Card Expiry Date as YYYY-MM-DD
rules.rule_description: The card expiry date must be stored in the database in a standardized YYYY-MM-DD format. The year and month come from the user's new input, while the expiry day is always carried forward from the original card record (the day is not user-editable).
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Format Expiry Date as YYYY-MM-DD
Combining New Year, Month and Day

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card update record is being populated with the user's new expiry year (CCUP-NEW-EXPYEAR) and new expiry month (CCUP-NEW-EXPMON), and the original expiry day (CCUP-NEW-EXPDAY) carried forward from the originally fetched card record
acceptance_criteria.When: The system constructs the expiry date for the card update record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The expiry date is formatted by concatenating the new expiry year, a hyphen separator, the new expiry month, a hyphen separator, and the original expiry day (e.g., YYYY-MM-DD), and this formatted date is stored in the CARD-UPDATE-EXPIRAION-DATE field of the card update record

rules.rule_name: Set New Card Active Status on Updated Card Record
rules.rule_description: The card active status entered and validated by the user (Y for active, N for inactive) must be applied to the card update record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set New Card Active Status Y or N

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card update record is being populated and the user has provided a validated new card active status (CCUP-NEW-CRDSTCD) with a value of either Y (active) or N (inactive)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sets the active status on the card update record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The new card active status entered by the user is moved to the active status field (CARD-UPDATE-ACTIVE-STATUS) of the card update record

rules.rule_name: Write Updated Card Record Back to Card Database
rules.rule_description: Once the card update record has been fully populated with all new and carried-forward values, the updated record must be written back to the card database to persist the changes.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Write Updated Card Record Back to Card Database

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card update record has been fully populated with the new card name, formatted expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD), active status, CVV code, card number, and account ID, and the card record is currently locked for update
acceptance_criteria.When: The system writes the updated card record back to the card database
acceptance_criteria.Then: The card database record is overwritten with the fully populated card update record, replacing the previous card details with the new values

rules.rule_name: Determine Update Success or Failure After Write Operation
rules.rule_description: After attempting to write the updated card record to the database, the system must determine whether the write operation succeeded or failed, and set the appropriate outcome status to inform the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Write Successful?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has attempted to write the updated card record back to the card database
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the outcome of the write operation
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the write operation is successful, the update success status (CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE) is set and the user is informed of the successful update; if the write operation fails (even though the record was locked), the update failed status (LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED) is set and the user is notified of the failure

sub_functionalities.title: Populate Update Record: New Card Number, Account ID, CVV Code, New Embossed Card Name, Format Expiry Date as YYYY

rules.rule_name: Clear Update Record Before Populating New Card Data
rules.rule_description: Before writing updated card information to the database, the card update record must be fully cleared to ensure no residual or stale data from previous operations is carried forward into the new update.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Initialize Card Update Record
Clear all fields to prepare
for new values

acceptance_criteria.Given: A confirmed card update request has passed concurrent change validation and the system is ready to construct the update record for writing to the database
acceptance_criteria.When: The system begins preparing the card update record
acceptance_criteria.Then: All fields in the card update record are reset to their initial empty state, ensuring no previously held values remain before new data is populated

rules.rule_name: Carry Forward Card Number Into Update Record
rules.rule_description: The card number associated with the update request must be written into the update record to correctly identify which card record is being modified in the database.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set New Card Number
Copy new card number
into update record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card update record has been initialized and the new card number is available from the user's confirmed update request
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the card number field in the update record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The new card number (CCUP-NEW-CARDID) is copied into the card update record's card number field (CARD-UPDATE-NUM), uniquely identifying the card being updated

rules.rule_name: Associate Account ID With the Card Update Record
rules.rule_description: The account identifier must be included in the card update record to maintain the association between the credit card and its owning account in the database.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Account ID
Copy account ID
into update record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card update record has been initialized and the account ID is available as a numeric value (CC-ACCT-ID-N) from the current session
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the account ID field in the update record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The numeric account ID (CC-ACCT-ID-N) is copied into the card update record's account ID field (CARD-UPDATE-ACCT-ID), preserving the card-to-account relationship

rules.rule_name: Preserve Original CVV Security Code in Update Record
rules.rule_description: The CVV security code must be carried forward unchanged from the original card record into the update record. The CVV is not a user-editable field and must remain as originally stored to preserve card security integrity.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set CVV Code
Copy CVV security code
into update record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card update record has been initialized and the CVV code (CCUP-NEW-CVV-CD) has been carried forward from the original card record that was read and displayed to the user
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the CVV security code field in the update record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The CVV code value (CCUP-NEW-CVV-CD) is first staged into the CVV working field (CARD-CVV-CD-X), and then the resulting numeric CVV value (CARD-CVV-CD-N) is copied into the card update record's CVV field (CARD-UPDATE-CVV-CD), preserving the original security code without any user modification

rules.rule_name: Write New Embossed Cardholder Name Into Update Record
rules.rule_description: The new cardholder name entered and validated by the user must be written into the update record as the embossed name on the card. This replaces the previously stored cardholder name.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set New Embossed Card Name
Copy new cardholder name
into update record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card update record has been initialized, and the new cardholder name (CCUP-NEW-CRDNAME) has been entered by the user, validated as alphabetic-only, and confirmed
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the embossed cardholder name field in the update record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The new cardholder name (CCUP-NEW-CRDNAME) is copied into the card update record's embossed name field (CARD-UPDATE-EMBOSSED-NAME), replacing the previously stored name

rules.rule_name: Format Card Expiry Date as YYYY-MM-DD Combining New Year and Month With Original Day
rules.rule_description: The card expiry date must be stored in the database in a standardized YYYY-MM-DD format. The year and month are taken from the user's new input, while the expiry day is always preserved from the original card record since the expiry day is not an editable field.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Format Card Expiry Date
Combine New Expiry Year + '-' +
New Expiry Month + '-' +
Expiry Day into YYYY-MM-DD format

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card update record has been initialized, the new expiry year (CCUP-NEW-EXPYEAR) and new expiry month (CCUP-NEW-EXPMON) have been entered and validated by the user, and the original expiry day (CCUP-NEW-EXPDAY, carried forward from the original record) is available
acceptance_criteria.When: The system formats and populates the card expiry date field in the update record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The expiry date is constructed by concatenating the new expiry year, a hyphen separator '-', the new expiry month, a hyphen separator '-', and the original expiry day, resulting in a date string in YYYY-MM-DD format, which is stored in the card update record's expiry date field (CARD-UPDATE-EXPIRAION-DATE). The expiry day component is never changed from its original value regardless of user input.

rules.rule_name: Write New Card Active Status Into Update Record
rules.rule_description: The new card active status entered and validated by the user must be written into the update record. The status indicates whether the card is active (Y) or inactive (N) and controls whether the card can be used for transactions.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Card Active Status
Copy new active status
Y for Active or N for Inactive
into update record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card update record has been initialized, and the new card active status (CCUP-NEW-CRDSTCD) has been entered by the user with a value of either 'Y' (Active) or 'N' (Inactive), validated, and confirmed
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the card active status field in the update record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The new card active status value (CCUP-NEW-CRDSTCD), which must be either 'Y' for Active or 'N' for Inactive, is copied into the card update record's active status field (CARD-UPDATE-ACTIVE-STATUS), replacing the previously stored status

rules.rule_name: Card Record Lock Verification Before Update
rules.rule_description: Before applying any changes to a card record, the system must exclusively reserve (lock) the record for update. If the record cannot be locked, the update is abandoned and a lock error status is set to inform the user that the card could not be reserved.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Was the card record successfully locked for update?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has confirmed pending card changes by pressing PF5, and the system attempts to lock the card record in the database using the Card Number as the unique identifier
acceptance_criteria.When: The system attempts to acquire an exclusive lock on the card record for update
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the lock is successfully acquired, processing continues to check for concurrent changes; if the lock cannot be acquired (record is already held by another process), the system sets the status to 'Could Not Lock For Update', marks the input as in error, and exits the update process without making any changes to the card record

rules.rule_name: Concurrent Modification Detection Before Card Update
rules.rule_description: After successfully locking the card record, the system must verify that no other user has modified the card data between the time it was displayed to the current user and the time the update is being applied. This protects data integrity by detecting concurrent modifications.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Was the data changed by another user before this update?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card record has been successfully locked for update, and the system holds the original card values that were displayed to the user (CVV Code, Cardholder Name, Expiry Year, Expiry Month, Expiry Day, and Active Status)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system compares the current database values of the card record against the original values that were displayed to the user, checking all six fields: CVV Code, Cardholder Name (case-insensitive, converted to uppercase), Expiry Year (positions 1-4 of expiry date), Expiry Month (positions 6-7 of expiry date), Expiry Day (positions 9-10 of expiry date), and Active Status
acceptance_criteria.Then: If all six fields match exactly, the record is considered unchanged and the system proceeds to write the user's changes; if any one or more fields differ, the system sets the status to 'Data Was Changed Before Update', refreshes the stored original values with the latest database values (CVV Code, Cardholder Name, Expiry Year, Expiry Month, Expiry Day, Active Status), and exits the update process without saving the user's changes

rules.rule_name: Refresh Screen with Latest Card Data After Concurrent Change
rules.rule_description: When a concurrent modification is detected — meaning another user changed the card record after the current user loaded it — the system must discard the current user's pending changes, update the displayed values with the latest data from the database, and return the screen to the 'Show Details' state so the user can review the current values before attempting any further changes.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Refresh screen with latest card details from database
Notify user data changed

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has detected that the card record was modified by another user between the time it was displayed and the time the current user attempted to confirm their changes, and the stored original values (CVV Code, Cardholder Name, Expiry Year, Expiry Month, Expiry Day, Active Status) have been refreshed with the latest database values
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the update outcome and finds the status is 'Data Was Changed Before Update'
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the program state to 'Show Details', which causes the screen to re-display the card record using the refreshed latest database values for Cardholder Name, Active Status, Expiry Year, Expiry Month, and Expiry Day, effectively notifying the user that the data has changed and prompting them to review and re-confirm any desired changes

rules.rule_name: Card Record Write Success Verification
rules.rule_description: After the system has locked the card record and confirmed no concurrent changes, it attempts to write the updated card details to the database. The outcome of this write operation must be evaluated to determine whether the update was successfully persisted or whether it failed despite the record being locked.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Was the record successfully written to the database?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card record has been successfully locked, no concurrent changes were detected, and the system has constructed the updated card record with the new Cardholder Name, new Active Status, new Expiry Month, new Expiry Year, original Expiry Day, original CVV Code, Card Number, and Account ID
acceptance_criteria.When: The system attempts to write (rewrite) the updated card record to the database
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the write operation completes successfully, processing continues and the success status will be set; if the write operation fails for any reason, the system sets the status to 'Locked But Update Failed', indicating that the record was locked but the save could not be completed

rules.rule_name: Card Update Failure Due to Write Error
rules.rule_description: When the card record was successfully locked and no concurrent changes were detected, but the actual write operation to the database fails, the system must set a specific failure status to distinguish this scenario from a lock failure, allowing the screen to display an appropriate failure notification to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Update Failed Status
Record was locked but
could not be saved

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card record was successfully locked for update, no concurrent modifications were detected, and the system attempted to write the updated card details to the database
acceptance_criteria.When: The database write (rewrite) operation does not complete successfully
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the status to 'Locked But Update Failed', which will subsequently cause the update outcome evaluation to set the program state to 'Changes Okayed But Failed' and display a failure notification message to the user

rules.rule_name: Card Update Success Status Assignment
rules.rule_description: When the card record has been locked, no concurrent changes were found, and the write operation completed successfully, the system must set the success status to confirm that the card details have been permanently updated in the database and to trigger the appropriate success confirmation message on screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Update Success Status
Card details have been
successfully updated

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card record was successfully locked, no concurrent modifications were detected, and the database write operation completed successfully
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the overall update outcome and none of the failure conditions (lock error, update failed, data changed) are present
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the program state to 'Changes Okayed And Done', which will cause the screen to display a success confirmation message and re-display the card details reflecting the successfully saved values

rules.rule_name: Card Update Outcome Routing and Status Assignment
rules.rule_description: After the write processing attempt completes, the system evaluates the overall outcome across all possible scenarios — lock failure, concurrent data change, write failure, or success — and routes to the appropriate program state to ensure the correct message and screen behavior is presented to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: After the write attempt, evaluate the outcome: set success status if update succeeded, or set appropriate failure status (lock error, update failed, or data changed by another user)

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has completed the card update write processing, which may have resulted in one of four possible internal statuses: 'Could Not Lock For Update', 'Locked But Update Failed', 'Data Was Changed Before Update', or a successful write with none of those statuses set
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the outcome of the write processing attempt
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system applies the following routing logic in priority order: (1) If status is 'Could Not Lock For Update' — set program state to 'Changes Okayed Lock Error' and display a failure notification; (2) If status is 'Locked But Update Failed' — set program state to 'Changes Okayed But Failed' and display a failure notification; (3) If status is 'Data Was Changed Before Update' — set program state to 'Show Details' and re-display the refreshed card data for user review; (4) In all other cases (successful write) — set program state to 'Changes Okayed And Done' and display a success confirmation message

rules.rule_name: Skip Screen Field Population on Fresh Program Entry
rules.rule_description: When the credit card update screen is accessed for the first time in a new session, all screen fields should remain blank so the user can enter their search criteria from scratch. No prior data should be pre-populated.

acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the screen fields for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: All screen fields are left blank and no data is populated; the user is presented with an empty form to enter their Account Number and Card Number search criteria

rules.rule_name: Clear Account Number Field When Account ID Is Zero
rules.rule_description: During screen re-entry (non-fresh entry), if the current Account ID held in the session has a zero value, the Account Number field on the screen must be cleared to blank rather than displaying a zero or invalid value.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Account ID is zero? → Clear Account Number field on screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update program is in a re-entry state (not a fresh program entry) and the session Account ID has a numeric value of zero
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the Account Number field on the screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Account Number field on the screen is cleared to blank (LOW-VALUES), displaying nothing to the user

rules.rule_name: Display Account Number on Screen When Account ID Is Non-Zero
rules.rule_description: During screen re-entry, if the current session Account ID holds a non-zero value, the Account Number field on the screen must be populated with that value so the user can see the account they are working with.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Account ID is zero? → Display Account Number on screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update program is in a re-entry state (not a fresh program entry) and the session Account ID has a non-zero numeric value
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the Account Number field on the screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Account Number field on the screen is populated with the current Account ID value from the session

rules.rule_name: Clear Card Number Field When Card Number Is Zero
rules.rule_description: During screen re-entry, if the current Card Number held in the session has a zero value, the Card Number field on the screen must be cleared to blank rather than displaying a zero or invalid value.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Card Number is zero? → Clear Card Number field on screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update program is in a re-entry state (not a fresh program entry) and the session Card Number has a numeric value of zero
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the Card Number field on the screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Card Number field on the screen is cleared to blank (LOW-VALUES), displaying nothing to the user

rules.rule_name: Display Card Number on Screen When Card Number Is Non-Zero
rules.rule_description: During screen re-entry, if the current session Card Number holds a non-zero value, the Card Number field on the screen must be populated with that value so the user can see the card they are working with.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Card Number is zero? → Display Card Number on screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update program is in a re-entry state (not a fresh program entry) and the session Card Number has a non-zero numeric value
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the Card Number field on the screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Card Number field on the screen is populated with the current Card Number value from the session

rules.rule_name: Clear All Card Detail Fields When Card Details Have Not Yet Been Fetched
rules.rule_description: When the program state indicates that card details have not yet been retrieved from the database (the user has not yet performed a successful search), all card detail fields on the screen must be cleared to blank. This prevents stale or misleading data from being displayed in the editable detail section.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Details Not Yet Fetched - Clear all card detail fields: Card Name, Card Status, Expiry Day, Month, Year

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update program is in a re-entry state and the current program state is 'Details Not Yet Fetched' (no card data has been retrieved from the database yet)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the card detail fields on the screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: All card detail fields are cleared to blank (LOW-VALUES): Card Name field is cleared, Card Status Code field is cleared, Expiry Day field is cleared, Expiry Month field is cleared, and Expiry Year field is cleared

rules.rule_name: Display Originally Fetched Card Values When Showing Card Details
rules.rule_description: When the program state is 'Show Details' (a card has been successfully retrieved from the database and is being presented to the user), all card detail fields on the screen must be populated with the original values that were read from the database. This gives the user an accurate view of the current state of the card record before making any changes.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Showing Card Details - Display originally fetched values: Card Name, Card Status, Expiry Day, Month, Year

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update program is in a re-entry state and the current program state is 'Show Details' (card data has been successfully retrieved from the database)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the card detail fields on the screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: All card detail fields are populated with the originally fetched database values: Card Name field is set to the original Card Name (CCUP-OLD-CRDNAME), Card Status Code field is set to the original Card Status (CCUP-OLD-CRDSTCD), Expiry Day field is set to the original Expiry Day (CCUP-OLD-EXPDAY), Expiry Month field is set to the original Expiry Month (CCUP-OLD-EXPMON), and Expiry Year field is set to the original Expiry Year (CCUP-OLD-EXPYEAR)

rules.rule_name: Display New User-Entered Values During Changes In Progress While Preserving Original Expiry Day
rules.rule_description: When the program state indicates that changes are in progress (the user has entered modifications that are either pending validation confirmation or awaiting final confirmation via PF5), the screen must display the new values entered by the user for editable fields. Critically, the Expiry Day field must always retain the original value from the database because the Expiry Day is not an editable field and cannot be changed by the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Changes In Progress - Display new values entered by user: New Card Name, New Card Status, New Expiry Month, New Expiry Year - Keep original Expiry Day

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update program is in a re-entry state and the current program state is 'Changes Made' (user has entered changes that are in progress - either pending confirmation or validation)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the card detail fields on the screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Card Name field is populated with the new Card Name entered by the user (CCUP-NEW-CRDNAME); the Card Status Code field is populated with the new Card Status entered by the user (CCUP-NEW-CRDSTCD); the Expiry Month field is populated with the new Expiry Month entered by the user (CCUP-NEW-EXPMON); the Expiry Year field is populated with the new Expiry Year entered by the user (CCUP-NEW-EXPYEAR); and the Expiry Day field is populated with the ORIGINAL Expiry Day from the database (CCUP-OLD-EXPDAY) — the Expiry Day is never changed by user input

rules.rule_name: Display Originally Fetched Card Values for All Other Program States
rules.rule_description: For any program state not explicitly handled by the other state-specific rules (such as after a successful update, after a failed update, or any unexpected state), the screen must fall back to displaying the original values that were fetched from the database. This ensures the user always sees consistent and accurate card data as a safe default.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Other States - Display originally fetched values: Card Name, Card Status, Expiry Day, Month, Year

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update program is in a re-entry state and the current program state does not match 'Details Not Fetched', 'Show Details', or 'Changes Made' (i.e., it is any other state such as post-update success, post-update failure, or an unrecognized state)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the card detail fields on the screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: All card detail fields are populated with the originally fetched database values as a safe default: Card Name field is set to the original Card Name (CCUP-OLD-CRDNAME), Card Status Code field is set to the original Card Status (CCUP-OLD-CRDSTCD), Expiry Day field is set to the original Expiry Day (CCUP-OLD-EXPDAY), Expiry Month field is set to the original Expiry Month (CCUP-OLD-EXPMON), and Expiry Year field is set to the original Expiry Year (CCUP-OLD-EXPYEAR)

rules.rule_name: Display Search Prompt on Fresh Program Entry
rules.rule_description: When the credit card update program is entered for the first time in a session, the system must guide the user to begin by entering search criteria (Account Number and Card Number).
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Fresh Program Entry

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update program has been entered fresh (no prior session data exists, i.e., program state is set to ENTER for the first time)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the current program state to determine which informational message to display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message is set to prompt the user to enter both the Account Number and Card Number to perform a card search

rules.rule_name: Display Search Prompt When Card Details Have Not Been Fetched
rules.rule_description: When the program is in a state where card details have not yet been retrieved from the database, the system must prompt the user to provide search criteria before any card information can be displayed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Card Details Not Yet Fetched

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program state is 'Details Not Fetched', meaning no card record has been retrieved and displayed yet in the current interaction
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the current program state to determine which informational message to display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message is set to prompt the user to enter both the Account Number and Card Number to perform a card search

rules.rule_name: Display Card Found Message When Card Details Are Shown
rules.rule_description: When a card record has been successfully retrieved and its details are currently displayed on screen, the system must inform the user that the card was found and invite them to review and optionally modify the details.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Card Details Found and Displayed

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program state is 'Show Details', meaning a card record was successfully found and its details (cardholder name, active status, expiry month, expiry year, expiry day) are displayed on screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the current program state to determine which informational message to display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message is set to indicate that card details have been found and the user may review and make changes if needed

rules.rule_name: Display Correction Prompt When Validation Errors Are Present
rules.rule_description: When the user has submitted changes to card details but one or more fields have failed validation, the system must direct the user to correct the highlighted fields before resubmitting.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Changes Entered But Validation Errors Found

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program state is 'Changes Not OK', meaning the user submitted changes to card fields (cardholder name, active status, expiry month, and/or expiry year) and at least one field failed validation
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the current program state to determine which informational message to display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message is set to prompt the user to correct the highlighted fields and resubmit the changes

rules.rule_name: Display Confirmation Prompt When Changes Are Validated and Awaiting Confirmation
rules.rule_description: When the user has entered changes that have passed all validation checks but have not yet been confirmed and saved, the system must prompt the user to explicitly confirm the changes by pressing PF5.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Changes Entered and Validated Successfully

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program state is 'Changes OK - Not Confirmed', meaning all edited card fields (cardholder name, active status, expiry month, expiry year) have passed validation and the changes are pending user confirmation
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the current program state to determine which informational message to display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message is set to prompt the user to confirm the changes by pressing PF05 to save them to the database

rules.rule_name: Display Success Message After Card Update Is Completed
rules.rule_description: When the user has confirmed their changes and the card record has been successfully updated in the database, the system must notify the user that the update was completed successfully.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Changes Confirmed and Saved Successfully

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program state is 'Changes Okayed and Done', meaning the user pressed PF5 to confirm changes, the record was locked, verified as unchanged by another user, and successfully rewritten to the card database
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the current program state to determine which informational message to display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message is set to confirm that the card update was completed successfully

rules.rule_name: Display Failure Message When Record Cannot Be Locked for Update
rules.rule_description: When the user confirms changes but the system is unable to obtain an exclusive lock on the card record (because another user or process currently holds it), the system must inform the user that the update could not be completed due to a record lock.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Update Failed - Record Lock Error

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program state is 'Changes Okayed - Lock Error', meaning the user pressed PF5 to confirm changes but the system failed to lock the card record for update because it was already locked by another process
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the current program state to determine which informational message to display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message is set to inform the user that the update could not be completed because the record is currently locked, and the failure message is placed in the screen error area

rules.rule_name: Display Failure Message When Record Is Locked But Write Operation Fails
rules.rule_description: When the user confirms changes, the record is successfully locked, but the actual write/rewrite operation to the card database fails, the system must inform the user that the update could not be completed and they should try again.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Update Failed - Write Error

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program state is 'Changes Okayed - But Failed', meaning the user pressed PF5 to confirm changes, the card record was successfully locked for update, but the rewrite operation to the card database did not complete successfully
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the current program state to determine which informational message to display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message is set to inform the user that the update could not be completed and they should try again, and the failure message is placed in the screen error area

rules.rule_name: Default to Search Prompt When No Informational Message Is Available
rules.rule_description: When no specific informational message has been set for the current program state, the system defaults to displaying the search prompt to guide the user to enter search criteria.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: No Information Message Available

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program state does not match any of the defined states (Fresh Entry, Details Not Fetched, Show Details, Changes Not OK, Changes OK Not Confirmed, Changes Done, Lock Error, Write Error) and no informational message has been set (WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE is true)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the current program state to determine which informational message to display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message defaults to prompting the user to enter both the Account Number and Card Number to perform a card search

rules.rule_name: Place Informational Message in Screen Information Area
rules.rule_description: After the appropriate informational message has been determined based on the current program state, the system must place that message into the designated informational message area of the screen so the user can see it.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Place informational message on screen information area

acceptance_criteria.Given: The appropriate informational message (WS-INFO-MSG) has been set based on the current program state (one of: search prompt, card found, correct changes, confirm with PF5, update success, or failure notification)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the screen output for display to the user
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message stored in WS-INFO-MSG is moved to the screen's information message display area (INFOMSGO) so it is visible to the user on the current screen

rules.rule_name: Place Error or Return Message in Screen Error Area
rules.rule_description: In addition to the informational message, any error or return message generated during processing (such as validation errors, field-level error descriptions, or system messages) must be placed in the dedicated error message area of the screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Place error/return message on screen error area

acceptance_criteria.Given: A return or error message (WS-RETURN-MSG) may have been set during input processing or validation (e.g., 'Account filter must be an 11-digit number', 'Card ID filter must be a 16-digit number', 'Name must be alphabetic', 'Card status must be Y or N', 'Expiry month not valid', 'Expiry year not valid', 'Did not find account/card combination', or a system error message)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the screen output for display to the user
acceptance_criteria.Then: The error or return message stored in WS-RETURN-MSG is moved to the screen's error message display area (ERRMSGO) so it is visible to the user alongside the informational message

rules.rule_name: Set Screen Fields to Search Mode When Card Details Not Yet Fetched
rules.rule_description: When the program is in the initial search state (card details have not yet been retrieved), the Account Number and Card Number fields must be editable so the user can enter search criteria, while all card detail fields (Name, Status, Expiry Month, Expiry Year) are protected and cannot be edited.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Searching for Card
Details Not Yet Fetched

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is displayed and the program state is 'Details Not Yet Fetched' (no card has been looked up yet)
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen field attributes are being set for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Account Number field is set to editable (unprotected), the Card Number field is set to editable (unprotected), the Card Name field is set to protected (non-editable), the Card Status field is set to protected (non-editable), the Expiry Month field is set to protected (non-editable), and the Expiry Year field is set to protected (non-editable)

rules.rule_name: Set Screen Fields to Edit Mode When Card Details Are Displayed or Have Validation Errors
rules.rule_description: When the program is in the 'Show Details' state (card found and displayed) or in the 'Changes Not OK' state (validation errors exist in card fields), the Account Number and Card Number fields must be protected (non-editable) while all card detail fields become editable so the user can make or correct changes.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Card Details Displayed
OR Validation Errors in Card Fields

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is displayed and the program state is either 'Show Details' (card details are visible) or 'Changes Not OK' (card field validation errors exist)
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen field attributes are being set for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Account Number field is set to protected (non-editable), the Card Number field is set to protected (non-editable), the Card Name field is set to editable (unprotected), the Card Status field is set to editable (unprotected), the Expiry Month field is set to editable (unprotected), and the Expiry Year field is set to editable (unprotected)

rules.rule_name: Set All Screen Fields to Protected When Changes Are Confirmed Pending or Already Saved
rules.rule_description: When the program is in the 'Changes OK - Not Confirmed' state (awaiting user confirmation via PF5) or the 'Changes Okayed and Done' state (update successfully saved), all screen fields must be fully protected so the user cannot modify any values until the current workflow step is resolved.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Changes Confirmed Pending
OR Changes Already Saved

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is displayed and the program state is either 'Changes OK - Not Confirmed' (pending PF5 confirmation) or 'Changes Okayed and Done' (update successfully completed)
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen field attributes are being set for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Account Number field is set to protected, the Card Number field is set to protected, the Card Name field is set to protected, the Card Status field is set to protected, the Expiry Month field is set to protected, and the Expiry Year field is set to protected — all fields are non-editable

rules.rule_name: Apply Default Search Mode Field Attributes for All Other Program States
rules.rule_description: For any program state not explicitly handled (default/fallback), the screen reverts to search mode: Account Number and Card Number fields are editable, while all card detail fields are protected.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
All Other States
Default

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is displayed and the program state does not match any of the explicitly defined states (Details Not Fetched, Show Details, Changes Not OK, Changes OK Not Confirmed, Changes Done)
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen field attributes are being set for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Account Number field is set to editable (unprotected), the Card Number field is set to editable (unprotected), the Card Name field is set to protected (non-editable), the Card Status field is set to protected (non-editable), the Expiry Month field is set to protected (non-editable), and the Expiry Year field is set to protected (non-editable)

rules.rule_name: Position Cursor on Card Name Field When Card Is Found or No Changes Detected
rules.rule_description: When a card has been successfully found and its details are displayed, or when the user submits the screen but no changes have been detected compared to the original values, the cursor is automatically positioned on the Card Name field to guide the user to begin editing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Card Details Found
OR No Changes Detected
→ Cursor on Card Name Field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display
acceptance_criteria.When: The condition 'Found Cards for Account' is true OR the condition 'No Changes Detected' is true
acceptance_criteria.Then: The cursor is automatically positioned on the Card Name field

rules.rule_name: Position Cursor on Account Number Field When Account Number Is Invalid or Blank
rules.rule_description: When the Account Number field fails validation (either because it is blank or contains a non-numeric value), the cursor is automatically positioned on the Account Number field to direct the user to correct the entry.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Account Number Invalid
or Blank
→ Cursor on Account Number Field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account Number filter flag is set to 'Not OK' (invalid value) OR the Account Number filter flag is set to 'Blank' (no value entered)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The cursor is automatically positioned on the Account Number field

rules.rule_name: Position Cursor on Card Number Field When Card Number Is Invalid or Blank
rules.rule_description: When the Card Number field fails validation (either because it is blank or contains a non-numeric value), the cursor is automatically positioned on the Card Number field to direct the user to correct the entry.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Card Number Invalid
or Blank
→ Cursor on Card Number Field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display
acceptance_criteria.When: The Card Number filter flag is set to 'Not OK' (invalid value) OR the Card Number filter flag is set to 'Blank' (no value entered)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The cursor is automatically positioned on the Card Number field

rules.rule_name: Position Cursor on Card Name Field When Card Name Is Invalid or Blank
rules.rule_description: When the Card Name field fails validation (either because it is blank or contains non-alphabetic characters), the cursor is automatically positioned on the Card Name field to direct the user to correct the entry.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Card Name Invalid
or Blank
→ Cursor on Card Name Field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display
acceptance_criteria.When: The Card Name flag is set to 'Not OK' (invalid characters) OR the Card Name flag is set to 'Blank' (no value entered)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The cursor is automatically positioned on the Card Name field

rules.rule_name: Position Cursor on Card Status Field When Card Status Is Invalid or Blank
rules.rule_description: When the Card Status field fails validation (either because it is blank or does not contain a valid Y/N value), the cursor is automatically positioned on the Card Status field to direct the user to correct the entry.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Card Status Invalid
or Blank
→ Cursor on Card Status Field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display
acceptance_criteria.When: The Card Status flag is set to 'Not OK' (invalid value) OR the Card Status flag is set to 'Blank' (no value entered)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The cursor is automatically positioned on the Card Status field

rules.rule_name: Position Cursor on Expiry Month Field When Expiry Month Is Invalid or Blank
rules.rule_description: When the Expiry Month field fails validation (either because it is blank or is not a valid calendar month 01-12), the cursor is automatically positioned on the Expiry Month field to direct the user to correct the entry.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Expiry Month Invalid
or Blank
→ Cursor on Expiry Month Field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display
acceptance_criteria.When: The Expiry Month flag is set to 'Not OK' (invalid month value) OR the Expiry Month flag is set to 'Blank' (no value entered)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The cursor is automatically positioned on the Expiry Month field

rules.rule_name: Position Cursor on Expiry Year Field When Expiry Year Is Invalid or Blank
rules.rule_description: When the Expiry Year field fails validation (either because it is blank or fails the year validity check), the cursor is automatically positioned on the Expiry Year field to direct the user to correct the entry.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Expiry Year Invalid
or Blank
→ Cursor on Expiry Year Field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display
acceptance_criteria.When: The Expiry Year flag is set to 'Not OK' (invalid year value) OR the Expiry Year flag is set to 'Blank' (no value entered)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The cursor is automatically positioned on the Expiry Year field

rules.rule_name: Position Cursor on Account Number Field as Default When No Specific Error Condition Applies
rules.rule_description: When no specific field error or card-found condition applies, the cursor defaults to the Account Number field as the primary entry point for the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Default
→ Cursor on Account Number Field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display
acceptance_criteria.When: None of the specific cursor-positioning conditions are met (no card found, no changes detected, no field validation errors)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The cursor is automatically positioned on the Account Number field by default

rules.rule_name: Reset Account and Card Number Field Colors to Default When User Arrived from Card List Screen
rules.rule_description: When the user navigates to the card update screen from the Card List screen, the Account Number and Card Number fields are displayed in the default color (not highlighted), since these values were passed in from the list and are pre-populated.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Did user arrive
from Card List screen?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display
acceptance_criteria.When: The last map set used was the Card List map set (indicating the user arrived from the Card List screen)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Account Number field color is set to the default display color and the Card Number field color is set to the default display color (overriding any previously set color)

rules.rule_name: Highlight Account Number Field in Red When Account Number Value Is Invalid
rules.rule_description: When the Account Number entered by the user fails validation (non-numeric or otherwise invalid), the Account Number field is highlighted in red to visually alert the user to the error.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Account Number Invalid → Highlight Red

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account Number filter flag is set to 'Not OK' (the value entered is invalid, e.g., non-numeric)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Account Number field is displayed with a red color highlight

rules.rule_name: Show Asterisk and Highlight Account Number Field in Red When Account Number Is Blank on Re-entry
rules.rule_description: When the user has previously interacted with the screen (re-entry) and the Account Number field is blank, an asterisk placeholder is displayed in the field and it is highlighted in red to indicate that a required value is missing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Account Number Blank on Re-entry → Show Asterisk and Highlight Red

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display and the program is in re-entry mode (user has previously submitted the screen)
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account Number filter flag is set to 'Blank' (no account number was entered)
acceptance_criteria.Then: An asterisk character '*' is displayed in the Account Number field and the field is highlighted in red color

rules.rule_name: Highlight Card Number Field in Red When Card Number Value Is Invalid
rules.rule_description: When the Card Number entered by the user fails validation (non-numeric or otherwise invalid), the Card Number field is highlighted in red to visually alert the user to the error.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Card Number Invalid → Highlight Red

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display
acceptance_criteria.When: The Card Number filter flag is set to 'Not OK' (the value entered is invalid, e.g., non-numeric)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Card Number field is displayed with a red color highlight

rules.rule_name: Show Asterisk and Highlight Card Number Field in Red When Card Number Is Blank on Re-entry
rules.rule_description: When the user has previously interacted with the screen (re-entry) and the Card Number field is blank, an asterisk placeholder is displayed in the field and it is highlighted in red to indicate that a required value is missing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Card Number Blank on Re-entry → Show Asterisk and Highlight Red

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display and the program is in re-entry mode (user has previously submitted the screen)
acceptance_criteria.When: The Card Number filter flag is set to 'Blank' (no card number was entered)
acceptance_criteria.Then: An asterisk character '*' is displayed in the Card Number field and the field is highlighted in red color

rules.rule_name: Highlight Card Name Field in Red When Card Name Is Invalid and Changes Have Errors
rules.rule_description: When the Card Name field contains an invalid value (e.g., non-alphabetic characters) AND the program is in the 'Changes Not OK' state (validation errors exist), the Card Name field is highlighted in red.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Card Name Invalid with Errors → Highlight Red

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display and the program state is 'Changes Not OK'
acceptance_criteria.When: The Card Name flag is set to 'Not OK' (the name contains invalid characters such as non-alphabetic characters)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Card Name field is displayed with a red color highlight

rules.rule_name: Show Asterisk and Highlight Card Name Field in Red When Card Name Is Blank and Changes Have Errors
rules.rule_description: When the Card Name field is blank AND the program is in the 'Changes Not OK' state (validation errors exist), an asterisk placeholder is displayed in the field and it is highlighted in red to indicate the required value is missing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Card Name Blank with Errors → Show Asterisk and Highlight Red

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display and the program state is 'Changes Not OK'
acceptance_criteria.When: The Card Name flag is set to 'Blank' (no card name was entered)
acceptance_criteria.Then: An asterisk character '*' is displayed in the Card Name field and the field is highlighted in red color

rules.rule_name: Highlight Card Status Field in Red When Card Status Is Invalid and Changes Have Errors
rules.rule_description: When the Card Status field contains an invalid value (not Y or N) AND the program is in the 'Changes Not OK' state, the Card Status field is highlighted in red.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Card Status Invalid with Errors → Highlight Red

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display and the program state is 'Changes Not OK'
acceptance_criteria.When: The Card Status flag is set to 'Not OK' (the value is not a valid Y or N)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Card Status field is displayed with a red color highlight

rules.rule_name: Show Asterisk and Highlight Card Status Field in Red When Card Status Is Blank and Changes Have Errors
rules.rule_description: When the Card Status field is blank AND the program is in the 'Changes Not OK' state, an asterisk placeholder is displayed in the field and it is highlighted in red to indicate the required value is missing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Card Status Blank with Errors → Show Asterisk and Highlight Red

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display and the program state is 'Changes Not OK'
acceptance_criteria.When: The Card Status flag is set to 'Blank' (no status value was entered)
acceptance_criteria.Then: An asterisk character '*' is displayed in the Card Status field and the field is highlighted in red color

rules.rule_name: Always Display Expiry Day Field as Dark and Non-Editable
rules.rule_description: The Expiry Day field is always displayed as dark (suppressed/non-interactive) regardless of program state, because the expiry day cannot be changed by the user — it is always carried forward from the original card record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Expiry Day Field → Always Display as Dark/Non-editable

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display

rules.rule_name: Show Asterisk and Highlight Expiry Month Field in Red When Expiry Month Is Blank and Changes Have Errors

rules.rule_name: Highlight Expiry Year Field in Red When Expiry Year Is Invalid and Changes Have Errors

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display and the program state is 'Changes Not OK'

rules.rule_name: Show Asterisk and Highlight Expiry Year Field in Red When Expiry Year Is Blank and Changes Have Errors

rules.sub_graph_node_text: Expiry Year Blank with Errors → Show Asterisk and Highlight Red

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display and the program state is 'Changes Not OK'

rules.rule_name: Suppress Information Message Area When No Informational Message Is Present

Is there an

acceptance_criteria.When: The information message indicator is set to 'No Info Message' (no message content is available)

rules.rule_name: Display Information Message Area as Bright and Visible When a Message Is Present
rules.rule_description: When there is an informational message to display to the user (e.g., card found, update successful, prompt for confirmation), the information message area is set to bright/visible so the user's attention is drawn to it.

rules.rule_name: Highlight Function Key Area in Bright Yellow When User Must Confirm Changes via PF5

Is user being prompted

rules.rule_name: Position Cursor on Card Name After Successful Card Lookup
rules.rule_description: When a card has just been successfully retrieved from the database, or when the user submits the screen with no changes detected compared to the original card data, the screen cursor is automatically positioned on the Card Name field to guide the user to begin editing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Card details just found or no changes detected?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display, and either a card record has just been successfully found in the database (FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT is true) OR the user submitted the screen and no differences were detected between the entered values and the original card data (NO-CHANGES-DETECTED is true)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system determines where to position the screen cursor for the next user interaction
acceptance_criteria.Then: The cursor is positioned on the Card Name (Cardholder Name) input field, directing the user to begin entering or reviewing the cardholder name

rules.rule_name: Position Cursor on Account Number Field When Account Is Invalid or Blank
rules.rule_description: When the Account Number entered by the user is either invalid (non-numeric or otherwise fails validation) or was left blank, the screen cursor is positioned on the Account Number field to direct the user to correct or supply the required value.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Account Number invalid or blank?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display, and the card details have not yet been fetched (search mode is active), and the Account Number field is either flagged as invalid (FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK is true) OR flagged as blank (FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK is true)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system determines where to position the screen cursor for the next user interaction
acceptance_criteria.Then: The cursor is positioned on the Account Number (Account ID) input field, directing the user to enter or correct the 11-digit numeric Account Number

rules.rule_name: Position Cursor on Card Number Field When Card Number Is Invalid or Blank
rules.rule_description: When the Card Number entered by the user is either invalid (non-numeric or otherwise fails validation) or was left blank, the screen cursor is positioned on the Card Number field to direct the user to correct or supply the required value.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Card Number invalid or blank?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display, and the card details have not yet been fetched (search mode is active), and the Account Number is not flagged with an error, and the Card Number field is either flagged as invalid (FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK is true) OR flagged as blank (FLG-CARDFILTER-BLANK is true)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system determines where to position the screen cursor for the next user interaction
acceptance_criteria.Then: The cursor is positioned on the Card Number (Card ID) input field, directing the user to enter or correct the 16-digit numeric Card Number

rules.rule_name: Position Cursor on Card Name Field When Card Name Is Invalid or Blank
rules.rule_description: When the user has submitted changes to the card details and the Cardholder Name field is either invalid (contains non-alphabetic characters) or was left blank, the screen cursor is positioned on the Card Name field to direct the user to correct or supply the required value.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Card Name invalid or blank?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display in edit mode (card details already fetched), and neither a successful card lookup nor a no-change condition applies, and the Account Number and Card Number are not flagged with errors, and the Card Name field is either flagged as invalid (FLG-CARDNAME-NOT-OK is true) OR flagged as blank (FLG-CARDNAME-BLANK is true)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system determines where to position the screen cursor for the next user interaction
acceptance_criteria.Then: The cursor is positioned on the Card Name (Cardholder Name) input field, directing the user to enter or correct the cardholder name using alphabetic characters only

rules.rule_name: Position Cursor on Card Status Field When Card Active Status Is Invalid or Blank
rules.rule_description: When the user has submitted changes to the card details and the Card Active Status field is either invalid (not Y or N) or was left blank, the screen cursor is positioned on the Card Status field to direct the user to correct or supply the required value.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Card Active Status invalid or blank?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display in edit mode (card details already fetched), and neither a successful card lookup, no-change condition, account error, card number error, nor card name error applies, and the Card Active Status field is either flagged as invalid (FLG-CARDSTATUS-NOT-OK is true) OR flagged as blank (FLG-CARDSTATUS-BLANK is true)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system determines where to position the screen cursor for the next user interaction
acceptance_criteria.Then: The cursor is positioned on the Card Active Status input field, directing the user to enter or correct the status value which must be Y (Yes/Active) or N (No/Inactive)

rules.rule_name: Position Cursor on Expiry Month Field When Expiry Month Is Invalid or Blank
rules.rule_description: When the user has submitted changes to the card details and the Expiry Month field is either invalid (not a valid calendar month 01–12) or was left blank, the screen cursor is positioned on the Expiry Month field to direct the user to correct or supply the required value.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Expiry Month invalid or blank?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display in edit mode (card details already fetched), and none of the higher-priority error conditions apply (no successful lookup, no no-change, no account error, no card number error, no card name error, no card status error), and the Expiry Month field is either flagged as invalid (FLG-CARDEXPMON-NOT-OK is true) OR flagged as blank (FLG-CARDEXPMON-BLANK is true)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system determines where to position the screen cursor for the next user interaction
acceptance_criteria.Then: The cursor is positioned on the Expiry Month input field, directing the user to enter or correct the card expiry month with a valid value between 01 and 12

rules.rule_name: Position Cursor on Expiry Year Field When Expiry Year Is Invalid or Blank
rules.rule_description: When the user has submitted changes to the card details and the Expiry Year field is either invalid (fails year validity check) or was left blank, the screen cursor is positioned on the Expiry Year field to direct the user to correct or supply the required value.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Expiry Year invalid or blank?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display in edit mode (card details already fetched), and none of the higher-priority error conditions apply (no successful lookup, no no-change, no account error, no card number error, no card name error, no card status error, no expiry month error), and the Expiry Year field is either flagged as invalid (FLG-CARDEXPYEAR-NOT-OK is true) OR flagged as blank (FLG-CARDEXPYEAR-BLANK is true)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system determines where to position the screen cursor for the next user interaction
acceptance_criteria.Then: The cursor is positioned on the Expiry Year input field, directing the user to enter or correct the card expiry year with a valid year value

rules.rule_name: Default Cursor Position on Account Number Field When No Specific Error Applies
rules.rule_description: When none of the specific error or state conditions (card found, no changes, account error, card number error, card name error, card status error, expiry month error, expiry year error) are applicable, the screen cursor defaults to the Account Number field as the primary entry point for the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Default: Position cursor on Account Number field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display, and none of the following conditions are true: card just found (FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT), no changes detected (NO-CHANGES-DETECTED), account number invalid (FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK), account number blank (FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK), card number invalid (FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK), card number blank (FLG-CARDFILTER-BLANK), card name invalid (FLG-CARDNAME-NOT-OK), card name blank (FLG-CARDNAME-BLANK), card status invalid (FLG-CARDSTATUS-NOT-OK), card status blank (FLG-CARDSTATUS-BLANK), expiry month invalid (FLG-CARDEXPMON-NOT-OK), expiry month blank (FLG-CARDEXPMON-BLANK), expiry year invalid (FLG-CARDEXPYEAR-NOT-OK), expiry year blank (FLG-CARDEXPYEAR-BLANK)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system determines where to position the screen cursor for the next user interaction and no specific field error or post-lookup state is identified
acceptance_criteria.Then: The cursor is positioned on the Account Number (Account ID) input field as the default starting point, prompting the user to begin by entering the account number

rules.rule_description: When a user navigates to the Credit Card Update screen from the Card List screen, the Account Number and Card Number fields are displayed in the default color to indicate they were pre-populated from the previous screen and are not in an error state.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Apply default color to Account Number field and Card Number field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has arrived at the Credit Card Update screen from the Card List screen (the last mapset used equals the Card List mapset)
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen is being prepared for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Account Number field and the Card Number field are both rendered in the default display color (no error highlighting), indicating they were passed in from the Card List screen

rules.rule_name: Highlight Account Number Field in Red When Format is Invalid
rules.rule_description: When the Account Number entered by the user fails format validation (i.e., it is not a valid 11-digit numeric value), the Account Number field is highlighted in red to alert the user to the error.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Account Number invalid - wrong format?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has submitted the Credit Card Update screen with an Account Number value
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account Number fails format validation — it is present but is not a valid numeric value
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Account Number field is highlighted in RED on the screen to indicate an invalid format error

rules.rule_name: Show Asterisk and Highlight Account Number Field in Red When Blank on Re-entry
rules.rule_description: When the user has previously interacted with the screen (re-entry) and the Account Number field is blank, an asterisk placeholder is displayed in the field and it is highlighted in red to prompt the user to provide the required value.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Account Number blank on re-entry?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on a re-entry interaction with the Credit Card Update screen (not the first time the screen is shown) and the Account Number field is blank or empty
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen is being prepared for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: An asterisk character ('*') is placed in the Account Number field as a visual placeholder, and the field is highlighted in RED to indicate it is required and missing

rules.rule_name: Highlight Card Number Field in Red When Format is Invalid
rules.rule_description: When the Card Number entered by the user fails format validation (i.e., it is not a valid 16-digit numeric value), the Card Number field is highlighted in red to alert the user to the error.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Card Number invalid - wrong format?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has submitted the Credit Card Update screen with a Card Number value
acceptance_criteria.When: The Card Number fails format validation — it is present but is not a valid numeric value
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Card Number field is highlighted in RED on the screen to indicate an invalid format error

rules.rule_name: Show Asterisk and Highlight Card Number Field in Red When Blank on Re-entry
rules.rule_description: When the user has previously interacted with the screen (re-entry) and the Card Number field is blank, an asterisk placeholder is displayed in the field and it is highlighted in red to prompt the user to provide the required value.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Card Number blank on re-entry?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on a re-entry interaction with the Credit Card Update screen (not the first time the screen is shown) and the Card Number field is blank or empty
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen is being prepared for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: An asterisk character ('*') is placed in the Card Number field as a visual placeholder, and the field is highlighted in RED to indicate it is required and missing

rules.rule_name: Highlight Card Name Field in Red When Invalid During Active Change Session

rules.sub_graph_node_text: Card Name invalid AND changes in progress?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen is in the 'Changes Not OK' state (changes were submitted but failed validation) and the Card Name field contains an invalid value (non-alphabetic characters)

rules.rule_name: Show Asterisk and Highlight Card Name Field in Red When Blank During Active Change Session

rules.sub_graph_node_text: Card Name blank AND changes in progress?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen is in the 'Changes Not OK' state and the Card Name field is blank or empty
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen is being prepared for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: An asterisk character ('*') is placed in the Card Name field as a visual placeholder, and the field is highlighted in RED to indicate it is required and missing

rules.rule_name: Highlight Card Status Field in Red When Invalid During Active Change Session
