Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The input status is set to error (INPUT-ERROR = TRUE), both the account number filter flag (FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK = TRUE) and the card number filter flag (FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK = TRUE) are set to invalid, and if no prior error message has been set, the error message is set to indicate that the account and card combination was not found (DID-NOT-FIND-ACCTCARD-COMBO = TRUE); the user is returned to the search screen with the error message displayed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Handle Card Not Found for Account and Card Number Combination
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the card database lookup fails to find a record matching the provided card number, the system flags both the account number and card number as invalid and sets an error message indicating that the specific account and card combination does not exist in the system.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user initiates the Credit Card Update program
Acceptance_Criteria.When: There is no prior session communication area (first-time launch), OR the program was called from the Main Menu program and the user has not yet interacted with this program (not in re-entry state)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program is identified as a fresh entry requiring initialization of all work areas and display of a blank search screen; all previously stored account, card, and program state data is discarded

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect Fresh Program Entry or Return from Main Menu
all_rules.Rule_Description: Determines whether the program is being accessed for the first time (no prior session data) or is being re-entered from the Main Menu without a prior interaction, triggering a fresh blank search screen presentation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has been identified as a fresh entry (first launch or return from Main Menu)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The fresh entry condition is confirmed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The entire CardDemo communication area is initialized to empty values, the program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) is initialized to empty values, the program state flag is set to 'Enter' (first-time entry mode), and the card details status is set to 'Details Not Fetched'

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reset All Program State and Data on Fresh Entry
all_rules.Rule_Description: On fresh entry or return from the Main Menu, all communication area data, program-specific work areas, and card detail storage are fully initialized to ensure no stale data from a prior session is carried forward.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is preparing to display the Credit Card Update screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Screen initialization is performed prior to any screen send operation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The screen output area is cleared to low values; the first and second title lines are populated from the application title constants; the transaction name field is set to the current transaction ID; the program name field is set to the current program name; the date field is populated with the current date formatted as MM/DD/YY; the time field is populated with the current time formatted as HH:MM:SS

all_rules.Rule_Name: Initialize Screen Header with Current Date, Time, and Program Identity
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before displaying any screen to the user, the screen header area is populated with the application title lines, the current transaction identifier, the program name, the current calendar date in MM/DD/YY format, and the current time in HH:MM:SS format.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is in 'Details Not Fetched' state and is preparing to display the search screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Screen field attributes are being configured
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account Number field (ACCTSIDA) is set to an editable/enterable attribute (DFHBMFSE) and the Card Number field (CARDSIDA) is set to an editable/enterable attribute (DFHBMFSE), allowing the user to type values into both fields

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Account Number and Card Number Fields as Editable on Fresh Entry
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the program is in the 'Details Not Fetched' state (search mode), the Account Number and Card Number input fields must be made available for user entry so the user can provide search criteria.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is in 'Details Not Fetched' state and is preparing to display the search screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Screen field attributes are being configured
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Cardholder Name field (CRDNAMEA), Card Active Status field (CRDSTCDA), Expiry Month field (EXPMONA), and Expiry Year field (EXPYEARA) are all set to a protected/non-enterable attribute (DFHBMPRF), preventing the user from entering data into these fields until a card record has been retrieved

all_rules.Rule_Name: Protect Card Detail Fields from Entry on Fresh Search Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the program is in search mode (card details not yet retrieved), the card detail fields — cardholder name, card active status, expiry month, and expiry year — must be protected so the user cannot enter data into them before a card has been looked up.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is in 'Details Not Fetched' state or is being entered for the first time
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The informational message area of the screen is being prepared
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The information message flag is set to 'Prompt for Search Keys', the corresponding search prompt message text is moved to the screen information message output field (INFOMSGO), the information message attribute is set to bright/highlighted (DFHBMBRY) to draw user attention, and any error message field (ERRMSGO) is populated with the current return message value (which will be blank on fresh entry)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Search Prompt Information Message on Fresh Entry Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the program is in the initial state (first entry or details not yet fetched), an informational message is set and displayed on screen to guide the user to enter the Account Number and Card Number as search keys.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is preparing to display the search screen and no specific field-level validation error condition is active
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The cursor positioning logic evaluates all field error flags and none of the specific error conditions (account invalid, card invalid, name invalid, status invalid, month invalid, year invalid) are met
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor length attribute for the Account Number field (ACCTSIDL) is set to -1, which instructs CICS to place the cursor on the Account Number field when the screen is displayed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Position Cursor on Account Number Field by Default
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no specific field error condition is active and the screen is in its default or initial state, the cursor is automatically positioned on the Account Number field to guide the user to begin data entry at the correct starting point.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All screen variables, field attributes, informational messages, and cursor positioning have been set up for the fresh entry search screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen send operation is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Credit Card Update map (CCARD-NEXT-MAP) from the Credit Card Update mapset (CCARD-NEXT-MAPSET) is sent to the terminal using the prepared output area (CCRDUPAO); the previous screen content is erased (ERASE); the keyboard is unlocked for user input (FREEKB); and the cursor is placed as configured

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display the Blank Search Screen to the User
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all screen fields, attributes, messages, and cursor position have been configured, the fully prepared screen is sent to the user's terminal, erasing any previous screen content and freeing the keyboard for input.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The blank search screen has been successfully displayed to the user following a fresh entry
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program prepares to return control to CICS to await user input
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program re-entry flag (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER) is set to TRUE indicating the next interaction is a re-entry, and the card details status flag (CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED) is set to TRUE confirming that no card data has been retrieved in this session

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark Program in Re-Entry State with Details Still Not Fetched After Fresh Screen Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: After displaying the blank search screen, the program state is updated to indicate that the next interaction will be a re-entry (the user is returning after seeing the screen), while maintaining the 'details not fetched' flag so the program knows no card data has been retrieved yet.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The blank search screen has been displayed and program state has been updated to re-entry mode with details not fetched
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program reaches the common return point
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current return message is moved to the screen error message field; the CardDemo communication area and the program-specific communication area are combined into the full session communication area (WS-COMMAREA); CICS RETURN is executed specifying the current transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID) and the full communication area (WS-COMMAREA) with its full length, so the transaction is re-invoked when the user next interacts with the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Return Control to CICS Awaiting User Input After Screen Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the screen has been displayed and program state flags have been updated, control is returned to CICS with the current transaction ID and the full session communication area, so that when the user presses a key the same transaction is re-invoked with all session context preserved.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has completed a credit card update attempt on the Card Update screen, and the update outcome is either 'Changes Okayed and Done' (successful save) or 'Changes Failed' (unsuccessful save)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the current program state after the update attempt
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must trigger the full post-update screen reset process for both the successful update outcome and the failed update outcome, applying identical reset logic in both cases without distinction between the two outcomes

all_rules.Rule_Name: Post-Update Reset Triggered for Both Success and Failure Outcomes
all_rules.Rule_Description: After a credit card update attempt, regardless of whether the update succeeded or failed, the system must initiate the same post-update screen reset workflow. Both outcomes converge to the same reset path.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has determined that the update outcome is either 'Changes Okayed and Done' or 'Changes Failed', and the post-update reset process has been triggered
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the post-update reset sequence
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must clear the Account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) stored in the session communication area and clear the Card Number (CDEMO-CARD-NUM) stored in the session communication area, so that neither value is carried forward to the next screen interaction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Account Number and Card Number from Session After Update
all_rules.Rule_Description: After a credit card update completes (successfully or with failure), the Account Number and Card Number that were used in the update session must be cleared from the active session data, ensuring no stale search keys persist into the next user interaction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has determined that the update outcome is either 'Changes Okayed and Done' or 'Changes Failed', and the Account Number and Card Number have been cleared from the session
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the post-update reset sequence
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must reset all program-specific state information (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA), which includes all card update workflow flags such as change detection flags, confirmation flags, and validation flags, AND reset all miscellaneous working storage data (WS-MISC-STORAGE), which includes intermediate field values, error messages, and working variables, so that no residual state from the previous update transaction influences the next user interaction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reset All Program State Information and Working Data After Update
all_rules.Rule_Description: After a credit card update attempt (success or failure), all program-specific state flags, intermediate working data, and miscellaneous storage must be fully reset to their initial values to ensure a clean slate for the next user interaction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has cleared the Account Number, Card Number, all program state information, and all working storage data as part of the post-update reset sequence
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to display the search screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must set the program entry state flag to 'Program Enter' mode (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER = TRUE), which causes the screen display logic to render a blank search screen with no pre-populated field values and with Account ID and Card Number fields in editable state

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Program to Fresh Entry Mode Before Displaying Search Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: After resetting all state and working data following an update attempt, the program must be placed into 'Fresh Entry' mode so that the subsequent screen display behaves as if the user is entering the program for the first time, presenting a clean search screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program state has been set to 'Fresh Entry' mode (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER = TRUE) following a post-update reset, with all prior session data cleared
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the send-map process (3000-SEND-MAP through 3000-SEND-MAP-EXIT), which performs screen initialization, screen variable setup, informational message setup, screen attribute setup, and screen transmission
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must display a blank search screen where: (1) the Account ID field and Card Number field are empty and editable, (2) all card detail fields (Name, Status, Expiry Month, Expiry Year) are blank and protected, (3) the informational message area prompts the user to enter search keys, (4) the screen header shows the current date and time, and (5) the cursor is positioned on the Account ID field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Blank Search Screen Prompting for New Account and Card Number
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all session data and state flags have been reset and the program is placed in fresh entry mode, the system must render and send a blank search screen to the user, prompting them to enter a new Account Number and Card Number to begin a new card lookup.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The blank search screen has been successfully sent to the user as part of the post-update reset sequence
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system finalizes the post-update reset process before returning control to await the next user interaction
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must set the program re-entry flag to 'Program Re-enter' mode (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER = TRUE), indicating the program has already been entered once and is awaiting the next user input, AND must set the card details fetch status to 'Details Not Yet Fetched' (CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED = TRUE), so that the next user interaction is treated as a new search request requiring Account ID and Card Number input rather than a card edit operation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Program State to Awaiting New Search Input After Displaying Reset Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the blank search screen has been sent to the user following a post-update reset, the program must update its state flags to indicate that it is now awaiting a new search input and that no card details have been fetched, ensuring the next user interaction is processed correctly as a new search request.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted the credit card update screen with values entered for Account ID, Card Number, Card Name, Card Status, Expiry Month, and/or Expiry Year
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system receives the screen input from the terminal
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: For each of the following fields — Account ID, Card Number, Card Name, Card Status, Expiry Month, and Expiry Year — if the entered value is an asterisk (*) or blank spaces, the system replaces it with an internal empty marker (LOW-VALUES) and clears the corresponding working storage field; otherwise, the entered value is stored as-is in the corresponding working storage field. The Expiry Day field is always captured as entered without any blank/asterisk substitution.

all_rules.Rule_Name: Capture and Normalize Screen Input Fields
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user submits the card update screen, the system receives all entered field values. Any field containing an asterisk (*) or blank spaces is treated as an empty/not-provided value and replaced with an internal empty marker (LOW-VALUES), ensuring consistent downstream processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted the credit card update screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the current program state after receiving screen input
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the program state flag indicates that card details have NOT yet been fetched (Search Mode), the system proceeds to validate the Account ID and Card Number search fields only; if the program state flag indicates that card details HAVE already been fetched (Update Mode), the system skips search field validation and proceeds directly to change detection and card detail field validation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Processing Mode: Search Mode vs Update Mode
all_rules.Rule_Description: After receiving screen input, the system determines whether it is operating in Search Mode (card details have not yet been retrieved) or Update Mode (card details are already displayed). This decision controls which set of validations are applied to the user's input.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is in Search Mode and the user has submitted the screen with an Account ID value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system validates the Account ID field
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Account ID is blank, spaces, LOW-VALUES, or zero, the system sets an input error flag, sets the account filter flag to BLANK, clears the Account ID from the session, and if no prior error message exists, sets the prompt message to request the account number; if the Account ID is provided but is not a numeric value, the system sets an input error flag, sets the account filter flag to NOT-OK, clears the Account ID from the session, and if no prior error message exists, sets the error message to 'ACCOUNT FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER'; if the Account ID is a valid numeric value, the system stores it in the session account field and sets the account filter flag to VALID

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validate Account Number Format and Presence
all_rules.Rule_Description: In Search Mode, the Account ID entered by the user must be a valid 11-digit non-zero numeric value. The system enforces this rule before attempting any card lookup.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is in Search Mode and the user has submitted the screen with a Card Number value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system validates the Card Number field
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Card Number is blank, spaces, LOW-VALUES, or zero, the system sets an input error flag, sets the card filter flag to BLANK, clears the Card Number from the session, and if no prior error message exists, sets the prompt message to request the card number; if the Card Number is provided but is not a numeric value, the system sets an input error flag, sets the card filter flag to NOT-OK, clears the Card Number from the session, and if no prior error message exists, sets the error message to 'CARD ID FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 16 DIGIT NUMBER'; if the Card Number is a valid numeric value, the system stores it in the session card number field and sets the card filter flag to VALID

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validate Card Number Format and Presence
all_rules.Rule_Description: In Search Mode, the Card Number entered by the user must be a valid 16-digit non-zero numeric value. The system enforces this rule before attempting any card lookup.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is in Search Mode and both the Account ID and Card Number fields have been evaluated as blank or zero
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system checks whether both account filter flag and card filter flag are set to BLANK
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If both the account filter flag AND the card filter flag are BLANK, the system sets the NO-SEARCH-CRITERIA-RECEIVED flag to indicate that the user has not provided any search criteria; the system then clears all card detail fields and proceeds to the action decision step regardless of whether one or both fields are blank

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect Missing Search Criteria When Both Fields Are Blank
all_rules.Rule_Description: After validating individual search fields in Search Mode, if both the Account ID and Card Number are blank, the system recognizes that no search criteria have been provided and sets an appropriate flag to inform the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is in Update Mode with card details already displayed, and the user has submitted the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system compares all new card data entered by the user against the originally fetched card data using a case-insensitive comparison of the complete card data block
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the new card data (converted to uppercase) is identical to the original card data (converted to uppercase), the system sets the NO-CHANGES-DETECTED flag, marks all field validation flags as valid (card name, card status, expiry month, expiry year), and skips all further field-level validation; if differences are found, the system proceeds to validate each individual card detail field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect Changes Between New and Original Card Data
all_rules.Rule_Description: In Update Mode, before validating individual card detail fields, the system compares the entire set of newly entered card data against the original values that were fetched from the database. If no changes are detected, no further validation or update processing is needed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is in Update Mode and the user has submitted the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the current program state after change detection
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the program state is NO-CHANGES-DETECTED, OR CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED (changes pending confirmation), OR CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE (changes already saved), the system sets all field validation flags to valid (card name valid, card status valid, expiry month valid, expiry year valid) and exits the validation routine without performing any further field-level checks

all_rules.Rule_Name: Skip Validation When Changes Are Pending Confirmation or Already Completed
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the program state indicates that changes are already pending user confirmation or have already been completed, the system bypasses all field-level validation and marks all fields as valid, preventing redundant re-validation of already-approved data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is in Update Mode, changes have been detected, and the system is validating the new cardholder name
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system validates the Card Name field
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Card Name is blank, spaces, LOW-VALUES, or zeros, the system sets an input error flag, sets the card name flag to BLANK, and if no prior error message exists, sets the prompt message to request the cardholder name; if the Card Name is provided, the system converts all valid alphabetic characters (and spaces) to spaces and checks if any non-alphabetic characters remain — if non-alphabetic characters are found after trimming, the system sets an input error flag, sets the card name flag to NOT-OK, and if no prior error message exists, sets the message to indicate the name must be alphabetic; if the Card Name contains only alphabetic characters, the system sets the card name flag to VALID

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validate Cardholder Name Format and Presence
all_rules.Rule_Description: When changes have been detected in Update Mode, the new cardholder name entered by the user must be provided and must contain only alphabetic characters. Names with numeric digits or special characters are rejected.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is in Update Mode, changes have been detected, and the system is validating the new card active status
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system validates the Card Active Status field
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Card Status is blank, spaces, LOW-VALUES, or zeros, the system sets an input error flag, sets the card status flag to BLANK, and if no prior error message exists, sets the message to indicate that card status must be Y or N; if the Card Status is provided, the system checks whether it is a valid YES/NO value — if the value is not a valid Y or N, the system sets an input error flag, sets the card status flag to NOT-OK, and if no prior error message exists, sets the message to indicate that card status must be Y or N; if the value is Y or N, the system sets the card status flag to VALID

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validate Card Active Status Value
all_rules.Rule_Description: When changes have been detected in Update Mode, the card active status entered by the user must be provided and must be either 'Y' (Active) or 'N' (Inactive). Any other value is rejected.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is in Update Mode, changes have been detected, and the system is validating the new expiry month
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system validates the Expiry Month field
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Expiry Month is blank, spaces, LOW-VALUES, or zeros, the system sets an input error flag, sets the expiry month flag to BLANK, and if no prior error message exists, sets the message to indicate the expiry month is not valid; if the Expiry Month is provided, the system checks whether it is a valid calendar month (01 through 12) — if the month value is outside the valid range, the system sets an input error flag, sets the expiry month flag to NOT-OK, and if no prior error message exists, sets the message to indicate the expiry month is not valid; if the month is valid, the system sets the expiry month flag to VALID

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validate Card Expiry Month Range
all_rules.Rule_Description: When changes have been detected in Update Mode, the expiry month entered by the user must be provided and must represent a valid calendar month (01 through 12).

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is in Update Mode, changes have been detected, and the system is validating the new expiry year
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system validates the Expiry Year field
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Expiry Year is blank, spaces, LOW-VALUES, or zeros, the system sets an input error flag, sets the expiry year flag to BLANK, and if no prior error message exists, sets the message to indicate the expiry year is not valid; if the Expiry Year is provided, the system checks whether it passes the valid year condition — if the year value fails the validity check, the system sets an input error flag, sets the expiry year flag to NOT-OK, and if no prior error message exists, sets the message to indicate the expiry year is not valid; if the year is valid, the system sets the expiry year flag to VALID

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validate Card Expiry Year Range
all_rules.Rule_Description: When changes have been detected in Update Mode, the expiry year entered by the user must be provided and must represent a valid year within the accepted range.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is in Update Mode, changes have been detected, and all individual field validations (card name, card status, expiry month, expiry year) have been completed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates whether any input errors were found across all validated fields
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If any validation errors were found (INPUT-ERROR flag is set), the system sets the program state to CHANGES-NOT-OK, indicating the user must correct the errors before proceeding; if no validation errors were found across all fields, the system sets the program state to CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED, indicating the changes are valid and ready for the user to confirm with PF5

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Overall Validation Outcome and Set Change Confirmation State
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all individual field validations are complete in Update Mode, the system evaluates the overall validation result to determine whether the user's changes are ready for confirmation or must be corrected.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has completed receiving and validating all user inputs from the credit card update screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sets the navigation target for the next screen interaction
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the next program identifier to the current credit card update program, sets the next map set to the current update map set, and sets the next map to the current update map, so that the credit card update screen is redisplayed to the user with the results of the validation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Navigation Target to Current Update Screen After Input Processing
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all input processing and validation is complete, the system sets the navigation pointers to keep the user on the current credit card update screen, ensuring the screen is redisplayed with appropriate messages and field highlights.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted the Credit Card Update screen by pressing a function key or Enter
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system reads the screen input using the defined map and mapset for the Credit Card Update screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All field values entered by the user on the screen are captured into the program's input holding area (CCRDUPAI) and are available for subsequent field-level processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Receive Screen Input from Terminal
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system captures all data entered by the user on the Credit Card Update screen into the program's input area before any field-level processing begins.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has successfully received the screen input from the terminal
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to process individual field values from the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The new card details holding area (CCUP-NEW-DETAILS) is fully reset to its initial empty state, ensuring all fields — Account ID, Card Number, Card Name, Card Status, Expiry Month, Expiry Year, and Expiry Day — start blank before new values are populated

all_rules.Rule_Name: Initialize New Card Details Holding Area Before Processing
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before processing any individual screen field, the system clears the new card details holding area to ensure no residual data from a previous interaction contaminates the current input processing cycle.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen input has been received and the new card details area has been initialized
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the Account ID field value from the screen input
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Account ID field contains an asterisk ('*') or spaces, the Account ID is set to empty/blank (low-values) in both the working Account ID field (CC-ACCT-ID) and the new Account ID holding field (CCUP-NEW-ACCTID); if the Account ID field contains any other value, that entered value is retained in both CC-ACCT-ID and CCUP-NEW-ACCTID for subsequent validation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Normalize Account ID Field: Treat Asterisk or Spaces as Empty
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user leaves the Account ID field blank or the system previously displayed an asterisk placeholder in that field, the system treats the Account ID as not provided and clears it. Otherwise, the entered value is retained for validation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account ID field has been evaluated and normalized
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the Card Number field value from the screen input
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Card Number field contains an asterisk ('*') or spaces, the Card Number is set to empty/blank (low-values) in both the working Card Number field (CC-CARD-NUM) and the new Card Number holding field (CCUP-NEW-CARDID), and also zeroed in the numeric Card Number field (CDEMO-CARD-NUM); if the Card Number field contains any other value, that entered value is retained in CC-CARD-NUM and CCUP-NEW-CARDID for subsequent validation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Normalize Card Number Field: Treat Asterisk or Spaces as Empty
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user leaves the Card Number field blank or the system previously displayed an asterisk placeholder in that field, the system treats the Card Number as not provided and clears it. Otherwise, the entered value is retained for validation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Number field has been evaluated and normalized
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the Card Name field value from the screen input
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Card Name field contains an asterisk ('*') or spaces, the Card Name is set to empty/blank (low-values) in the new Card Name holding field (CCUP-NEW-CRDNAME); if the Card Name field contains any other value, that entered value is retained in CCUP-NEW-CRDNAME for subsequent validation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Normalize Card Name Field: Treat Asterisk or Spaces as Empty
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user leaves the Cardholder Name field blank or the system previously displayed an asterisk placeholder in that field, the system treats the Card Name as not provided and clears it. Otherwise, the entered value is retained for validation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Name field has been evaluated and normalized
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the Card Status field value from the screen input
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Card Status field contains an asterisk ('*') or spaces, the Card Status is set to empty/blank (low-values) in the new Card Status holding field (CCUP-NEW-CRDSTCD); if the Card Status field contains any other value, that entered value is retained in CCUP-NEW-CRDSTCD for subsequent validation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Normalize Card Status Field: Treat Asterisk or Spaces as Empty
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user leaves the Card Status field blank or the system previously displayed an asterisk placeholder in that field, the system treats the Card Status as not provided and clears it. Otherwise, the entered value is retained for validation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Status field has been evaluated and normalized
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system processes the Expiry Day field from the screen input
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Expiry Day value from the screen input (EXPDAYI) is always directly moved into the new Expiry Day holding field (CCUP-NEW-EXPDAY) without any conditional check or normalization, regardless of its content

all_rules.Rule_Name: Accept Expiry Day Value Unconditionally As Entered
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Expiry Day field is a display-only field that the user cannot modify. The system always accepts whatever value is present in the Expiry Day field from the screen without any asterisk or space normalization, as this field is not user-editable.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Expiry Day field value has been accepted from the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the Expiry Month field value from the screen input
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Expiry Month field contains an asterisk ('*') or spaces, the Expiry Month is set to empty/blank (low-values) in the new Expiry Month holding field (CCUP-NEW-EXPMON); if the Expiry Month field contains any other value, that entered value is retained in CCUP-NEW-EXPMON for subsequent validation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Normalize Expiry Month Field: Treat Asterisk or Spaces as Empty
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user leaves the Expiry Month field blank or the system previously displayed an asterisk placeholder in that field, the system treats the Expiry Month as not provided and clears it. Otherwise, the entered value is retained for validation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Expiry Month field has been evaluated and normalized
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the Expiry Year field value from the screen input
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Expiry Year field contains an asterisk ('*') or spaces, the Expiry Year is set to empty/blank (low-values) in the new Expiry Year holding field (CCUP-NEW-EXPYEAR); if the Expiry Year field contains any other value, that entered value is retained in CCUP-NEW-EXPYEAR for subsequent validation; after this step, all screen fields have been normalized and the data is ready for business validation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Normalize Expiry Year Field: Treat Asterisk or Spaces as Empty
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user leaves the Expiry Year field blank or the system previously displayed an asterisk placeholder in that field, the system treats the Expiry Year as not provided and clears it. Otherwise, the entered value is retained for validation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card Update screen in search mode and submits the screen with the Account Number field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account Number entered is blank, contains only spaces, or is equal to zero (no value provided)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must: (1) flag the overall input as an error, (2) flag the Account Number field specifically as blank/missing, (3) display a prompt message asking the user to enter an account number (only if no prior error message is already set), (4) clear the Account ID from the session (set to zeros), and (5) clear the new Account ID working field (set to low-values), then stop further account validation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account Number Presence Check
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates that the Account Number field has been provided by the user and is not blank, empty, or zero before any further validation is performed. If missing, the input is flagged as an error, the account ID is cleared, and the user is prompted to enter an account number.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card Update screen in search mode, has provided a non-blank, non-zero Account Number, and submits the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account Number entered contains non-numeric characters (i.e., it is not a purely numeric value)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must: (1) flag the overall input as an error, (2) flag the Account Number field as invalid, (3) display the error message 'ACCOUNT FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER' (only if no prior error message is already set), (4) clear the Account ID from the session (set to zero), and (5) clear the new Account ID working field (set to low-values), then stop further account validation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account Number Numeric Format Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates that the Account Number provided by the user contains only numeric digits. If the value is present but contains non-numeric characters, it is rejected with a specific error message indicating the required format.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card Update screen in search mode and submits the screen with an Account Number that is non-blank, non-zero, and contains only numeric digits
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account Number passes both the presence check and the numeric format check
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must: (1) store the validated Account Number into the session Account ID field (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) for use in the card lookup, (2) store the Account Number into the new Account ID working field (CCUP-NEW-ACCTID), and (3) flag the Account Number filter as valid, allowing the card search to proceed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account Number Valid - Store for Processing
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account Number passes all validation checks (is present, non-zero, and numeric), it is accepted as valid, stored in the session for further processing, and flagged as a valid search filter so the card lookup can proceed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card Update search screen and has not entered a Card Number (the field is blank, contains only spaces, or is zero)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user submits the screen for processing
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the Card Number field status to 'Blank', sets the overall input status to 'Error', displays a prompt message asking the user to enter a Card Number, clears the stored Card Number in the session context (set to zeros), and clears the new Card ID value; no card lookup is performed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Number Must Be Provided
all_rules.Rule_Description: Ensures that the card number search filter is not left empty. If the user submits the screen without entering a card number, the system flags the field as blank, prompts the user to provide a card number, and clears any previously stored card number value.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has entered a Card Number on the Credit Card Update search screen and the field is not blank
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user submits the screen and the system evaluates the entered Card Number
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Card Number contains any non-numeric characters, the system sets the Card Number field status to 'Invalid', sets the overall input status to 'Error', displays the error message 'CARD ID FILTER, IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 16 DIGIT NUMBER', clears the stored Card Number in the session context (set to zero), and clears the new Card ID value; no card lookup is performed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Number Must Be a 16-Digit Numeric Value
all_rules.Rule_Description: Ensures that when a card number is provided, it contains only numeric digits. Non-numeric characters are not permitted in the card number field. If the card number contains non-numeric characters, the system rejects it with a specific error message.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has entered a Card Number on the Credit Card Update search screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Number is not blank and contains only numeric digits
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system accepts the Card Number as valid, stores the numeric Card Number value in the session account context (CDEMO-CARD-NUM) for the card lookup, stores the Card Number in the new Card ID field (CCUP-NEW-CARDID), and sets the Card Number filter status to 'Valid', allowing the card search to proceed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Valid Card Number Is Accepted and Stored for Lookup
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the card number passes all validation checks (is provided and is numeric), it is accepted as a valid search filter. The validated card number is stored in the session context for use in the card lookup operation, and the card number filter is marked as valid to allow the search to proceed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Credit Card Update screen in search mode, where card details have not yet been fetched, and the user submits the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account Number field is blank, contains only spaces, or has a value of zero
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system marks the Account Number as blank (FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK), raises an input error, prompts the user to enter an account number, clears the Account ID from the session and from the new account ID field, and exits account validation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account Number Blank Detection During Search
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user is in search mode (card details not yet fetched), the system checks whether the Account Number field was left blank or contains no value. If blank, the account is flagged as blank, an input error is raised, the user is prompted to provide an account number, and the account fields are cleared.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Credit Card Update screen in search mode, where card details have not yet been fetched, and the user submits the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Number field is blank, contains only spaces, or has a value of zero
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system marks the Card Number as blank (FLG-CARDFILTER-BLANK), raises an input error, prompts the user to enter a card number, clears the Card Number from both the session and the new card ID field, and exits card validation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Number Blank Detection During Search
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user is in search mode (card details not yet fetched), the system checks whether the Card Number field was left blank or contains no value. If blank, the card is flagged as blank, an input error is raised, the user is prompted to provide a card number, and the card number fields are cleared.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Credit Card Update screen in search mode, where card details have not yet been fetched, and both the Account Number and Card Number fields have individually been flagged as blank during their respective validations
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the combined result of both field validations and finds that both the Account Number blank flag (FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK) and the Card Number blank flag (FLG-CARDFILTER-BLANK) are set
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the 'No Search Criteria Received' condition (NO-SEARCH-CRITERIA-RECEIVED), indicating to the user that neither an account number nor a card number was provided, and no card lookup will be attempted

all_rules.Rule_Name: No Search Criteria Provided - Both Account and Card Number Blank
all_rules.Rule_Description: After individually validating the Account Number and Card Number fields in search mode, the system performs a combined completeness check. If both the Account Number AND the Card Number were found to be blank, the system sets a 'No Search Criteria Received' condition to inform the user that at least one search criterion must be provided before a card lookup can be performed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Credit Card Update screen in search mode, where card details have not yet been fetched, and the user submits the screen with at least one search field populated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Either the Account Number is provided (not blank and not zero), or the Card Number is provided (not blank and not zero), meaning it is NOT the case that both fields are simultaneously blank
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system does not set the 'No Search Criteria Received' condition and proceeds with the available search criteria, allowing subsequent validation and lookup steps to continue

all_rules.Rule_Name: Proceed With Available Search Criteria When At Least One Field Is Provided
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user provides at least one of the required search fields (Account Number or Card Number) in search mode, the system does not set the 'No Search Criteria Received' condition and instead proceeds with the available search criteria for further processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card Update screen and has submitted card detail changes, and the card name field (CCUP-NEW-CRDNAME) contains no value (is blank, empty, or zero)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system performs card name validation during input editing
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must: (1) mark the overall input as invalid by setting INPUT-ERROR flag to TRUE, (2) set the card name status flag to 'blank' (FLG-CARDNAME-BLANK = TRUE), (3) if no prior error message has been set, display a prompt message asking the user to provide the card name (WS-PROMPT-FOR-NAME), and (4) stop further name validation and exit the card name validation routine

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Name Blank or Empty Check
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates that the cardholder name field is not left blank or empty when the user submits card update details. If the name is missing, an error flag is set and the user is prompted to provide the card name.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card Update screen, has submitted card detail changes, and the card name field (CCUP-NEW-CRDNAME) contains a non-blank value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system checks each character in the card name by replacing all valid alphabetic characters (and spaces) with spaces and then checking if any non-space characters remain after trimming
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If any non-alphabetic, non-space characters are found remaining after the replacement and trim operation: (1) the overall input is marked as invalid by setting INPUT-ERROR flag to TRUE, (2) the card name status flag is set to 'not OK' (FLG-CARDNAME-NOT-OK = TRUE), (3) if no prior error message has been set, a message is displayed indicating that the card name must contain only alphabetic characters (WS-NAME-MUST-BE-ALPHA), and (4) further name validation is stopped and the routine exits

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Name Alphabetic Character Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates that the cardholder name provided contains only alphabetic characters and spaces. Any non-alphabetic, non-space characters (such as numbers or special characters) are not permitted in the card name field.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card Update screen, has submitted card detail changes, and the card name field (CCUP-NEW-CRDNAME) is non-blank and contains only alphabetic characters and spaces
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system completes all card name validation checks without finding any errors
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must mark the card name as valid by setting the card name validity flag to 'valid' (FLG-CARDNAME-ISVALID = TRUE), allowing the card update process to proceed to the next validation step

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Name Valid - Mark as Accepted
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the cardholder name passes all validation checks — it is non-blank and contains only alphabetic characters and spaces — the card name is marked as valid and accepted for further processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card active status validation process is initiated for a card update transaction
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The validation routine begins execution before any value checks are performed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The card active status flag is immediately set to 'Not OK' (invalid) as the default state, ensuring no status value is considered valid unless it explicitly passes all subsequent validation checks

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Active Status Default to Invalid Before Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before any validation check is performed on the card active status field, the system pre-emptively marks the status as invalid. This ensures that only an explicitly successful validation can result in a valid status, preventing any bypass of the validation logic.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is submitting a card update and the card active status field has been entered on the update screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The card active status field value is blank (spaces), empty (low-values), or zero
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the overall input state to 'Error', marks the card active status flag as 'Blank', and sets the error message to 'Card Status Must Be Y or N'; processing of this field stops immediately and no further validation is performed on the status field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Active Status Blank or Not Provided Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user submits a card update, the card active status field must contain a value. If the field is empty, contains only spaces, or is zero, the system must reject the input, flag the field as blank, set the overall input as invalid, and display an instructional error message to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has provided a non-blank value for the card active status field on the card update screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The provided card active status value is evaluated against the allowed values
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the value is 'Y' (active) or 'N' (inactive), the card active status flag is set to 'Valid' and processing continues; if the value is anything other than 'Y' or 'N', the system sets the overall input state to 'Error', marks the card active status flag as 'Not OK' (invalid), and sets the error message to 'Card Status Must Be Y or N'; processing of this field stops immediately

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Active Status Must Be Y or N
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a card active status value is provided, it must be exactly 'Y' (indicating the card is active) or 'N' (indicating the card is inactive). Any other value is rejected with an error message. Only these two values are accepted as valid card active status indicators.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has provided a card active status value on the card update screen and the value is not blank
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The card active status value is confirmed to be exactly 'Y' (active) or 'N' (inactive)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The card active status flag is set to 'Valid', no error message is generated for this field, and the validation routine completes successfully for the card active status field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Active Status Valid Outcome
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the card active status value passes the Y/N validation check, the system explicitly marks the card active status as valid, allowing the card update process to proceed without any status-related errors.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has provided a non-blank value for the card active status field on the card update screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The card active status value is not 'Y' (active) and not 'N' (inactive) — i.e., it is any other character or value
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the overall input state to 'Error', marks the card active status flag as 'Not OK' (invalid), and sets the error message to 'Card Status Must Be Y or N'; the validation routine terminates for this field and the card update cannot proceed until the user corrects the value

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Active Status Invalid Value Error Handling
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a card active status value is provided but is neither 'Y' nor 'N', the system must reject the update, flag the field as invalid, mark the overall input as containing errors, and inform the user of the acceptable values. This prevents invalid status codes from being saved to the card record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card Update screen and has submitted card detail changes, and the card expiry month field (CCUP-NEW-EXPMON) contains no value, is blank (spaces), or is zero
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system performs card expiry month validation as part of the input editing process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must: (1) set the overall input status to ERROR, (2) set the expiry month flag to BLANK (FLG-CARDEXPMON-BLANK) to indicate the field was not provided, (3) set the error message to 'Expiry Month Not Valid' (CARD-EXPIRY-MONTH-NOT-VALID), and (4) stop further month validation and exit the month validation routine

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Expiry Month - Blank or Missing Value Detection
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user submits a card update, the system must verify that the expiry month field has been populated. If the expiry month is absent, blank, or zero, the system must flag the field as blank, mark the overall input as invalid, and display an appropriate error message to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card Update screen and has submitted card detail changes, and the card expiry month field (CCUP-NEW-EXPMON) contains a non-blank, non-zero value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the provided expiry month value against the valid calendar month range (01 through 12 inclusive) using the VALID-MONTH condition check
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must set the expiry month flag to VALID (FLG-CARDEXPMON-ISVALID), indicating the month value is acceptable and no error is raised for this field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Expiry Month - Valid Calendar Month Acceptance
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user provides a non-blank expiry month value, the system must verify that the value represents a valid calendar month (between 01 and 12 inclusive). If the month is within the valid range, the field is accepted and marked as valid.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card Update screen and has submitted card detail changes, and the card expiry month field (CCUP-NEW-EXPMON) contains a non-blank, non-zero value that does not represent a valid calendar month (i.e., the value is outside the range 01 to 12)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the provided expiry month value against the valid calendar month range using the VALID-MONTH condition check and the value fails the check
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must: (1) set the overall input status to ERROR, (2) set the expiry month flag to NOT OK (FLG-CARDEXPMON-NOT-OK) to indicate the field contains an invalid value, (3) set the error message to 'Expiry Month Not Valid' (CARD-EXPIRY-MONTH-NOT-VALID), and (4) stop further month validation and exit the month validation routine

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Expiry Month - Invalid Calendar Month Rejection
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user provides an expiry month value that is outside the valid calendar month range (not between 01 and 12), the system must reject the value, flag the field as invalid, and display an error message prompting the user to correct the entry.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card Update screen and has submitted the form with the card expiry year field left empty, containing only spaces, or containing a zero value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system performs expiry year validation on the submitted card update data
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must: (1) Set the overall input status to ERROR, (2) Set the expiry year field flag to BLANK (FLG-CARDEXPYEAR-BLANK), (3) Set the error message to 'Card Expiry Year Not Valid' (CARD-EXPIRY-YEAR-NOT-VALID), and (4) Stop further expiry year validation and exit the validation routine immediately

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Expiry Year - Blank or Missing Value Detection
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user submits a card update, the system must verify that the card expiry year field has been populated. If the expiry year is absent, blank, or zero, the system must flag the field as blank, mark the overall input as invalid, and display the 'Expiry Year Not Valid' error message to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Credit Card Update screen and has submitted the form with a non-blank, non-zero expiry year value provided in the expiry year field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system performs the expiry year range validation by checking the provided year value against the valid year range (1950 to 2099)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the expiry year is within the valid range (1950–2099): (1) Set the expiry year field flag to VALID (FLG-CARDEXPYEAR-ISVALID) and allow processing to continue; If the expiry year is outside the valid range or is non-numeric: (1) Set the overall input status to ERROR, (2) Set the expiry year field flag to INVALID (FLG-CARDEXPYEAR-NOT-OK), (3) Set the error message to 'Card Expiry Year Not Valid' (CARD-EXPIRY-YEAR-NOT-VALID), and (4) Stop further expiry year validation and exit the validation routine immediately

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Expiry Year - Valid Year Range Check
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user provides a non-blank expiry year value on the card update screen, the system must validate that the year falls within the acceptable range of 1950 to 2099. If the year is within the valid range, it is accepted. If the year is outside the valid range or is non-numeric, the field is flagged as invalid and an error message is displayed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has provided a card expiry year value on the Credit Card Update screen that is non-blank, non-zero, and falls within the valid year range of 1950 to 2099
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system completes the expiry year validation check
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must: (1) Set the expiry year field flag to VALID (FLG-CARDEXPYEAR-ISVALID), (2) Raise no error condition for the expiry year field, and (3) Allow the card update validation process to continue to subsequent validation steps

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Expiry Year - Mark as Valid and Continue
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the card expiry year passes all validation checks (is present and within the valid year range of 1950 to 2099), the system marks the expiry year field as valid, allowing the card update workflow to proceed to the next step without any error condition being raised for this field.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card details have already been fetched and displayed to the user, and the program is in edit mode (not in Details Not Fetched state)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user submits the screen with any input values
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the originally fetched card data — Account ID (CCUP-OLD-ACCTID), Card Number (CCUP-OLD-CARDID), Cardholder Name (CCUP-OLD-CRDNAME), Active Status (CCUP-OLD-CRDSTCD), Expiry Day (CCUP-OLD-EXPDAY), Expiry Month (CCUP-OLD-EXPMON), and Expiry Year (CCUP-OLD-EXPYEAR) — and sets them as the reference baseline for comparison; additionally, the Account and Card filter flags are marked as valid since the card was already successfully retrieved

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Original Card Data as Baseline for Change Detection
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user is in edit mode (card details already fetched and displayed), the system must establish the original card data as the baseline reference before comparing against any new values entered by the user. This baseline includes the Account ID, Card Number, Cardholder Name, Active Status, Expiry Day, Expiry Month, and Expiry Year as they were originally retrieved from the database.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has the original card data (CCUP-OLD-CARDDATA) as the baseline and the user has submitted new card data (CCUP-NEW-CARDDATA) on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system compares the new card data against the original card data using a case-insensitive comparison (both sides converted to uppercase before comparison)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the uppercase version of the new card data exactly equals the uppercase version of the original card data, the system flags the state as 'No Changes Detected'; otherwise, the comparison proceeds to identify that changes have been made

all_rules.Rule_Name: Case-Insensitive Comparison of New Card Data Against Original Card Data
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system performs a case-insensitive comparison of all editable card detail fields entered by the user against the original values that were displayed. The comparison treats uppercase and lowercase letters as equivalent, ensuring that a user typing a name in a different case does not trigger an unnecessary update.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has completed the case-insensitive comparison of new card data (CCUP-NEW-CARDDATA) against original card data (CCUP-OLD-CARDDATA)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The uppercase value of CCUP-NEW-CARDDATA is equal to the uppercase value of CCUP-OLD-CARDDATA
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the state flag to 'No Changes Detected' (NO-CHANGES-DETECTED = TRUE), indicating the user has not modified any card detail fields

all_rules.Rule_Name: Flag No Changes Detected When Submitted Data Matches Original Data
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the case-insensitive comparison determines that the user-submitted card data is identical to the originally displayed card data, the system sets a 'No Changes Detected' flag to indicate that no actual modification has been made by the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has evaluated the card data comparison result and determined the current program state
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The current state is any one of the following: (1) No Changes Detected (NO-CHANGES-DETECTED is TRUE), OR (2) Changes are valid and awaiting user confirmation (CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED is TRUE), OR (3) Changes have already been successfully saved (CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE is TRUE)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system marks all four card detail fields as valid — Cardholder Name (FLG-CARDNAME-ISVALID = TRUE), Active Status (FLG-CARDSTATUS-ISVALID = TRUE), Expiry Month (FLG-CARDEXPMON-ISVALID = TRUE), and Expiry Year (FLG-CARDEXPYEAR-ISVALID = TRUE) — and exits the validation process without performing any further field-level validation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Bypass Field Validation When No Changes Detected, Confirmation Pending, or Update Already Completed
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system skips individual field-level validation for card details under three specific conditions: when no changes were detected, when changes have already been validated and are awaiting user confirmation (PF5), or when the update has already been successfully completed. In all three cases, all card detail fields are automatically marked as valid to avoid redundant re-validation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has determined that field-level validation should be bypassed because the state is No Changes Detected, Changes OK Not Confirmed, or Changes Okayed and Done
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The bypass condition is met
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets FLG-CARDNAME-ISVALID to TRUE, FLG-CARDSTATUS-ISVALID to TRUE, FLG-CARDEXPMON-ISVALID to TRUE, and FLG-CARDEXPYEAR-ISVALID to TRUE, then immediately exits the input editing process without invoking any individual field validation routines

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark All Card Detail Fields as Valid and Skip Further Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the system determines that field-level validation is not required (no changes detected, confirmation already pending, or update already done), it explicitly marks each of the four editable card detail fields as valid and terminates the validation process immediately, preventing unnecessary re-validation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The case-insensitive comparison has determined that the new card data differs from the original card data, AND the current state is not No Changes Detected, not Changes OK Not Confirmed, and not Changes Okayed and Done
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Changes are detected and none of the bypass conditions apply
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the program state to 'Changes Not OK' (CCUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK = TRUE), signaling that the submitted changes require individual field-level validation before they can proceed to the confirmation step

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark State as Changes Not Yet Validated When Changes Are Detected
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the comparison reveals that the user has made changes to the card data, and the bypass conditions are not met, the system transitions the program state to 'Changes Not OK' to indicate that the detected changes have not yet been validated and must go through individual field validation before they can be confirmed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program state has been set to 'Changes Not OK' because the user has submitted card data that differs from the original values
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system proceeds to validate the changed card detail fields
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sequentially invokes validation for: (1) Cardholder Name validation (1230-EDIT-NAME), (2) Card Active Status validation (1240-EDIT-CARDSTATUS), (3) Expiry Month validation (1250-EDIT-EXPIRY-MON), and (4) Expiry Year validation (1260-EDIT-EXPIRY-YEAR) — all four validations are executed in order; if all pass, the state is promoted to 'Changes OK - Not Confirmed'; if any fail, the state remains 'Changes Not OK' with appropriate error indicators set

all_rules.Rule_Name: Invoke Individual Field Validation for All Changed Card Detail Fields
all_rules.Rule_Description: When changes are detected and the state is set to 'Changes Not OK', the system sequentially invokes validation for each of the four editable card detail fields: Cardholder Name, Card Active Status, Expiry Month, and Expiry Year. All four validations are always performed regardless of whether earlier ones fail, ensuring complete error reporting to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Credit Card Update screen is active and the user has interacted with it by pressing a key or submitting data
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the current program state flag which can be one of: Details Not Yet Fetched, Card Details Currently Displayed, Changes Have Validation Errors, Changes OK Awaiting Confirmation, or Update Successfully Completed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system routes processing to the corresponding action branch for that state: search/lookup for Details Not Fetched, change detection for Show Details, error re-display for Changes Not OK, confirmation wait or save for Changes Pending Confirmation, or post-update display for Update Completed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Next Action Based on Current Program State
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system evaluates the current program state to determine which action path to follow. Each distinct state (details not fetched, details shown, changes with errors, changes pending confirmation, update completed) routes the program to a specific processing branch.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program state is Details Not Yet Fetched or the user has pressed PF12 to request a new search
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system checks whether both the Account Number filter flag (FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID) and the Card Number filter flag (FLG-CARDFILTER-ISVALID) are set to valid
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If both are valid, the system proceeds to read the card record from the database; if either is invalid or blank, no database lookup is performed and the screen is re-displayed with existing error indicators

all_rules.Rule_Name: Require Both Account Number and Card Number to Be Valid Before Card Lookup
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the program is in search mode (details not yet fetched) or a new search is requested via PF12, the system will only proceed to look up the card record if both the Account Number and the Card Number have passed their respective validation checks. If either is invalid, no lookup is attempted.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Both Account Number and Card Number have been validated as valid 11-digit and 16-digit numeric values respectively
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system reads the card record from the card database file using the Card Number as the record identifier
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the card record is found, the system stores the following original values: CVV Code, Cardholder Name (converted to uppercase), Expiry Year (positions 1-4 of expiry date), Expiry Month (positions 6-7 of expiry date), Expiry Day (positions 9-10 of expiry date), and Card Active Status; these stored values serve as the baseline for change detection and concurrent update checking

all_rules.Rule_Name: Read Card Details from Database Using Account and Card Number
all_rules.Rule_Description: When both search criteria are valid, the system retrieves the card record from the card database using the Card Number as the key. Upon successful retrieval, the card details including cardholder name (converted to uppercase), CVV code, expiry year, expiry month, expiry day, and active status are stored as the original reference values for subsequent comparison and display.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has attempted to read a card record from the database using the provided Account Number and Card Number
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The card record is successfully found in the database (normal response received)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program state is set to Show Card Details (CCUP-SHOW-DETAILS), and the screen will display the card's current details including cardholder name, active status, expiry month, expiry year, and expiry day

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Show Details State When Card Record Is Found
all_rules.Rule_Description: After attempting to read the card record from the database, if the record is successfully found, the program transitions to the Show Card Details state so the retrieved card information can be displayed to the user for review and editing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has attempted to read a card record from the database using the provided Account Number and Card Number
Acceptance_Criteria.When: No matching card record is found in the database for the given combination
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets an input error condition, marks both the Account Number filter and Card Number filter as invalid (FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK and FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK), and sets the error message to indicate that the account and card combination was not found; the program remains in search mode and re-displays the screen with both fields highlighted in error

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Error When Account and Card Number Combination Is Not Found
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the card record cannot be found in the database for the provided Account Number and Card Number combination, the system flags both the Account Number and Card Number fields as invalid and sets an error message indicating the combination was not found. The program remains in search mode.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is in the Show Card Details state and the user has submitted the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system detects either that the submitted field values are identical to the original database values (case-insensitive comparison of all editable fields) OR that there are input validation errors present
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program remains in the Show Card Details state with no state change; the screen is re-displayed showing the current card details without advancing to the Changes Pending Confirmation state

all_rules.Rule_Name: Remain in Show Details State When No Changes Are Detected or Validation Errors Exist
all_rules.Rule_Description: When card details are currently displayed and the user submits the screen, if the submitted data is identical to the original data (no changes detected) or if there are input validation errors, the program remains in the Show Details state without advancing to the confirmation step.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is in the Show Card Details state and the user has submitted the screen with modified field values
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The submitted data differs from the original database values (at least one of: cardholder name, card status, expiry month, or expiry year has changed) AND there are no input validation errors on any field
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program state is set to Changes OK - Not Confirmed (CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED), all editable fields become protected on screen, and the user is prompted to press PF5 to confirm the changes or PF3 to cancel

all_rules.Rule_Name: Advance to Changes Pending Confirmation When Valid Changes Are Detected
all_rules.Rule_Description: When card details are displayed and the user submits changes that differ from the original values and all field validations pass, the program advances to the Changes Pending Confirmation state, requiring the user to explicitly confirm before the update is saved.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is in the Changes Have Validation Errors state (CCUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK) because one or more of the submitted field values failed validation
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The action decision logic evaluates the current state
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: No state change occurs; the program remains in the Changes Not OK state and proceeds to re-display the screen with all invalid fields highlighted in red, asterisks shown for blank required fields, and appropriate error messages

all_rules.Rule_Name: Remain in Error State When Changes Have Validation Failures
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the program is in the Changes Have Validation Errors state, no further processing action is taken in the decision logic. The program remains in this state and the screen will be re-displayed with error highlights on the invalid fields.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is in the Changes OK - Not Confirmed state (CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED) with valid pending changes awaiting user confirmation
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user submits the screen without pressing PF5 (e.g., presses ENTER or another non-PF5 key)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: No save operation is initiated; the program remains in the Changes OK - Not Confirmed state, all fields remain protected, the PF key area remains highlighted in bright yellow, and the confirmation prompt message continues to be displayed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Wait for User Confirmation When PF5 Has Not Been Pressed
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the program is in the Changes OK Awaiting Confirmation state but the user has not pressed PF5, no save action is taken. The program remains in the confirmation-pending state, keeping all fields protected and continuing to prompt the user for confirmation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is in the Changes OK - Not Confirmed state (CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED) with valid pending changes
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF5 to confirm the changes
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system invokes the write processing routine (9200-WRITE-PROCESSING) to attempt to lock the card record and save the updated values to the database; the outcome of the save attempt determines the next program state

all_rules.Rule_Name: Initiate Card Update Save When User Confirms with PF5
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the program is in the Changes OK Awaiting Confirmation state and the user presses PF5, the system initiates the write processing to save the card updates to the database. This triggers the full save workflow including record locking and concurrent update checking.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has attempted to lock the card record for update as part of the save processing initiated by the user pressing PF5
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The database returns a non-normal response when attempting to read the card record with an update lock (COULD-NOT-LOCK-FOR-UPDATE condition is set)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program state is set to Changes Okayed - Lock Error (CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-LOCK-ERROR), the save is not completed, and a failure message is displayed to inform the user that the record could not be saved

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Lock Error State When Card Record Cannot Be Locked for Update
all_rules.Rule_Description: During the save attempt, if the system is unable to obtain an exclusive lock on the card record (because another user or process has it locked), the program transitions to the Lock Error state and an appropriate failure message is displayed to the user.
