Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has successfully locked the card record for update and has attempted to rewrite the updated card record to the database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The rewrite operation returns a non-normal response (LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED condition is set)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program state is set to Changes Okayed But Failed (CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-BUT-FAILED), the update is not completed, and a failure message is displayed to inform the user that the save operation was unsuccessful

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Update Failed State When Record Is Locked But Write Operation Fails
all_rules.Rule_Description: During the save attempt, if the system successfully locks the card record but the subsequent rewrite operation fails, the program transitions to the Update Failed state and a failure message is displayed to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has successfully locked the card record for update and is performing a concurrent update check by comparing the locked record's current values against the values originally shown to the user (CVV code, cardholder name, expiry year, expiry month, expiry day, and active status)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Any of the compared fields differ between the currently locked database record and the values that were originally displayed to the user (DATA-WAS-CHANGED-BEFORE-UPDATE condition is set), indicating another user or process modified the record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The save operation is aborted without writing any changes; the program state is set to Show Card Details (CCUP-SHOW-DETAILS) with the latest values from the database (updated CVV, name, expiry year, month, day, and status) so the user can review the current record and decide whether to re-submit their changes

all_rules.Rule_Name: Refresh Card Details When Record Was Modified by Another User Before Save
all_rules.Rule_Description: During the save attempt, after locking the record, the system compares the currently locked record against the values that were originally displayed to the user. If any field has been changed by another user or process in the interim, the save is aborted and the screen is refreshed with the latest database values so the user can review the current state before re-confirming.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has successfully locked the card record, confirmed no concurrent modifications occurred, and has rewritten the updated card record to the database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The rewrite operation returns a normal successful response (none of the error conditions COULD-NOT-LOCK-FOR-UPDATE, LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED, or DATA-WAS-CHANGED-BEFORE-UPDATE are set)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program state is set to Changes Okayed and Done (CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE), and a success confirmation message is displayed to the user indicating the card update was completed successfully

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Update Successfully Completed State After Successful Save
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the card record is successfully locked, passes the concurrent update check, and the rewrite operation completes normally, the program transitions to the Update Successfully Completed state and a success confirmation message is displayed to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program state is Update Successfully Completed (CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The originating transaction ID (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID) is equal to LOW-VALUES or spaces, indicating the program was not called from another transaction
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) is set to zeros, the Card Number (CDEMO-CARD-NUM) is set to zeros, and the Account Status (CDEMO-ACCT-STATUS) is set to LOW-VALUES to clear these session references

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Account and Card Number References When No Return Transaction Is Set After Successful Update
all_rules.Rule_Description: After a successful card update, if the program was not called from another transaction (no originating transaction ID is recorded in the session), the Account ID and Card Number references in the session are cleared to prevent stale data from persisting.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program state is Update Successfully Completed (CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE) following a successful save of card updates
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The action decision logic processes the Update Completed state
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program state is set to Show Card Details (CCUP-SHOW-DETAILS) so the screen will display the updated card information, and a success confirmation message is shown to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Updated Card Details After Successful Update
all_rules.Rule_Description: After a successful card update, regardless of whether the program was called from another transaction, the program transitions to the Show Card Details state so the user can see the result of their successful update on screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A request has been made to read card data for display, and the card details storage area may contain data from a previous lookup
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The card data read process is initiated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All previously held card detail fields (including old account ID, card ID, CVV code, cardholder name, expiry year, expiry month, expiry day, and card active status) are cleared and reset to their initial empty state before any new search is performed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Previously Held Card Details Before New Search
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before initiating a new card data retrieval, all previously stored card detail fields must be cleared to ensure no stale data from a prior lookup is retained or displayed to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card details storage has been cleared and a valid Account ID and Card Number are available in the current session
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to search the card database
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account ID from the current session is stored as the old account ID search key, and the Card Number from the current session is stored as the old card ID search key, making both values available for the database lookup and for subsequent comparison operations

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Account Number and Card Number as Search Keys for Card Lookup
all_rules.Rule_Description: Prior to searching the card database, the system must establish the account number and card number as the search identifiers to be used in the lookup operation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account ID and Card Number have been set as search keys, and the card database (CARDDAT) is accessible
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system performs the card database lookup
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The card database is searched using the full Card Number as the key, retrieving the complete card record including cardholder name, CVV code, expiry date, and active status; the search result determines the subsequent processing path (card found, card not found, or retrieval issue)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Search Card Database Using Card Number as the Primary Key
all_rules.Rule_Description: The card database (CARDDAT) must be searched using the Card Number as the unique retrieval key to locate the specific card record for display.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A search of the card database using the Card Number has been performed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The card record is successfully found and retrieved from the card database
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The following card details are extracted from the retrieved record and stored as the current card details for display: CVV code is stored as-is; cardholder name is converted to uppercase before storing; expiry year is extracted from positions 1 through 4 of the expiry date field; expiry month is extracted from positions 6 through 7 of the expiry date field; expiry day is extracted from positions 9 through 10 of the expiry date field; and card active status is stored as-is

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Card Details Upon Successful Card Record Retrieval
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a card record is successfully located in the card database, all relevant card detail fields must be extracted from the retrieved record and stored for display to the user, with the cardholder name converted to uppercase.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card record has been successfully retrieved from the card database and the cardholder name field contains the embossed name as stored in the database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system processes the retrieved card record for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All lowercase alphabetic characters in the cardholder name are converted to their uppercase equivalents before the name is stored in the card details display area, ensuring the name is always presented in uppercase to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Convert Cardholder Name to Uppercase on Retrieval
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a card record is successfully retrieved from the database, the cardholder name (card embossed name) must be standardized to uppercase before being stored and displayed, ensuring consistent presentation regardless of how the name was originally stored.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A search of the card database using the provided Card Number has been performed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The card database returns a 'not found' result, meaning no card record exists for the given Card Number
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: An input error flag is set to indicate invalid input; both the account number filter flag and the card number filter flag are marked as invalid; and if no prior error message has already been set, an error message is displayed to the user indicating that the account and card number combination was not found in the system

all_rules.Rule_Name: Handle Card Not Found - Account and Card Number Combination Does Not Exist
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the card database search returns no matching record for the provided Card Number, the system must flag both the account and card number inputs as invalid and inform the user that the combination was not found.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A search of the card database using the provided Card Number has been performed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The card database returns an unexpected result that is neither a successful retrieval nor a standard not-found response
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: An input error flag is set to indicate invalid input; the account number filter flag is marked as invalid; and if no prior error message has already been set, a file error message is displayed to the user indicating that the card details could not be retrieved, including the operation name, the file name, and the specific error response details

all_rules.Rule_Name: Handle Card Retrieval System Issue - Unable to Retrieve Card Details
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the card database search encounters an unexpected issue (neither a successful retrieval nor a standard not-found response), the system must flag the account number as invalid and display a system error message to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card record has been successfully retrieved from the card database using the provided Account ID and Card Number combination
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the card data for display by populating the old-details holding area
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The CVV security code is extracted from the retrieved card record and stored in the old-details holding area field CCUP-OLD-CVV-CD, preserving the original value for use during update processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: CVV Security Code Extraction and Storage After Card Retrieval
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a card record is successfully retrieved from the database, the CVV security code must be extracted from the card record and stored in the old-details holding area so it can be preserved and carried forward during any subsequent update operation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card record has been successfully retrieved from the card database and the embossed cardholder name is available in the card record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the card data for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All lowercase alphabetic characters in the embossed cardholder name are converted to their uppercase equivalents, so that the name is stored and displayed entirely in uppercase format

all_rules.Rule_Name: Cardholder Embossed Name Conversion to Uppercase
all_rules.Rule_Description: The cardholder embossed name retrieved from the card record must be converted entirely to uppercase letters before being stored or displayed, ensuring consistent name formatting across all card update operations.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The embossed cardholder name from the retrieved card record has been converted to uppercase
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system stores the card details into the old-details holding area
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The uppercase version of the embossed cardholder name is stored in the old-details holding area field CCUP-OLD-CRDNAME, making it available for display and for change-detection comparison during the update workflow

all_rules.Rule_Name: Uppercase Cardholder Name Storage in Old-Details Holding Area
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the embossed cardholder name has been converted to uppercase, the uppercase version must be stored in the old-details holding area so it can be displayed to the user and used as the baseline for detecting any changes made during the update session.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card record has been successfully retrieved and the card expiry date is available in YYYY-MM-DD format within the card record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system extracts individual date components from the expiry date field
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The four-character year value is extracted from positions 1 through 4 of the expiry date field and stored in the old-details holding area field CCUP-OLD-EXPYEAR, representing the four-digit expiry year (e.g., 2027)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Expiry Year Extraction from Expiry Date
all_rules.Rule_Description: The card expiry date is stored in the database as a formatted date string. The expiry year component, occupying the first four characters (positions 1 through 4) of the expiry date field, must be extracted separately and stored in the old-details holding area for individual field display and validation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card record has been successfully retrieved and the card expiry date is available in YYYY-MM-DD format within the card record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system extracts individual date components from the expiry date field
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The two-character month value is extracted from positions 6 through 7 of the expiry date field and stored in the old-details holding area field CCUP-OLD-EXPMON, representing the two-digit expiry month (e.g., 01 through 12)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Expiry Month Extraction from Expiry Date
all_rules.Rule_Description: The expiry month component, occupying two characters at positions 6 through 7 of the expiry date field (after the year and separator), must be extracted separately and stored in the old-details holding area for individual field display and validation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card record has been successfully retrieved and the card expiry date is available in YYYY-MM-DD format within the card record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system extracts individual date components from the expiry date field
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The two-character day value is extracted from positions 9 through 10 of the expiry date field and stored in the old-details holding area field CCUP-OLD-EXPDAY, representing the two-digit expiry day; this value is read-only and will be preserved unchanged in any subsequent update to the card record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Expiry Day Extraction from Expiry Date
all_rules.Rule_Description: The expiry day component, occupying two characters at positions 9 through 10 of the expiry date field, must be extracted separately and stored in the old-details holding area. The expiry day is a display-only value that cannot be modified by the user and is always carried forward unchanged during any update.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card record has been successfully retrieved from the card database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the card data for display by populating the old-details holding area
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The card active status value is extracted from the card record and stored in the old-details holding area field CCUP-OLD-CRDSTCD; the value is Y indicating the card is Active, or N indicating the card is Inactive, and this value is used as the baseline for detecting user-initiated status changes

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Active Status Extraction and Storage in Old-Details Holding Area
all_rules.Rule_Description: The card active status indicator from the retrieved card record must be extracted and stored in the old-details holding area. This status indicates whether the card is currently active (Y) or inactive (N) and serves as the baseline value for display and change detection during the update session.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has confirmed pending changes to a credit card record and the Card Number is available as the record key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system attempts to re-read the card record from the Card File with an exclusive update lock using the Card Number as the lookup key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the latest version of the card record from the Card File and holds an exclusive lock on it, preventing other users from modifying the same record until the update is complete or released

all_rules.Rule_Name: Acquire Exclusive Lock on Card Record Before Update
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before saving any changes to a credit card record, the system must re-read the card record from the Card File using the Card Number as the unique key and request an exclusive update lock to prevent simultaneous modifications by other users.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has confirmed pending changes to a credit card record and the system has attempted to re-read the card record with an exclusive update lock
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The lock acquisition fails because the card record is unavailable or already locked by another process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The update process is immediately stopped, the system sets the status to 'Could Not Lock for Update', and the user is informed of the failure so they may retry the operation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reject Update When Card Record Cannot Be Locked
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the system is unable to acquire an exclusive lock on the card record during the update attempt, the update process must be immediately halted and the user must be informed that the record could not be locked.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card record has been successfully re-read from the Card File with an exclusive lock and the card name field contains the current database value in any mix of upper and lower case
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to compare the current database card name against the originally displayed card name
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system converts all lowercase letters in the current database card name to uppercase before performing the comparison, ensuring the comparison is not affected by letter casing differences

all_rules.Rule_Name: Normalize Card Name to Uppercase Before Comparison
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before comparing the current database card name against the originally fetched card name, the card name retrieved from the database must be converted to uppercase to ensure a case-insensitive and consistent comparison.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card record has been successfully re-read and locked, and the system holds the originally fetched card values (CVV Code, Card Name, Expiry Year, Expiry Month, Expiry Day, Active Status) from when the card was first displayed to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system compares the current database values against the originally fetched values for all six fields: CVV Code, Card Name (uppercase), Expiry Year (positions 1-4 of expiry date), Expiry Month (positions 6-7 of expiry date), Expiry Day (positions 9-10 of expiry date), and Active Status
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If all six fields match exactly, no concurrent modification is detected and the system proceeds to apply the user's changes; if any one or more fields differ, a concurrent modification is detected and the update is blocked

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect Concurrent Modification by Comparing All Card Fields
all_rules.Rule_Description: After acquiring the exclusive lock, the system must compare all key card fields from the current database record against the values that were originally displayed to the user. If any field differs, it means another user has modified the record in the meantime and the update must be blocked.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A concurrent modification has been detected because one or more of the six compared fields (CVV Code, Card Name, Expiry Year, Expiry Month, Expiry Day, Active Status) differ between the current database record and the originally fetched values
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to re-display the card details to the user with the latest data
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system overwrites the stored original card details with the latest values from the database for all six fields: CVV Code is updated from the current database CVV, Card Name is updated from the current database card name (uppercase), Expiry Year is updated from positions 1-4 of the current expiry date, Expiry Month is updated from positions 6-7 of the current expiry date, Expiry Day is updated from positions 9-10 of the current expiry date, and Active Status is updated from the current database active status

all_rules.Rule_Name: Refresh Stored Original Card Details When Concurrent Modification Is Detected
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a concurrent modification is detected, the system must update its internally stored 'original' card details with the latest values from the database so that the refreshed screen accurately reflects the most current state of the card record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A concurrent modification has been detected and the stored original card details have been refreshed with the latest database values
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system determines the outcome of the write processing attempt
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the program state to 'Show Details' (CCUP-SHOW-DETAILS), cancels the pending update, and redisplays the card detail screen populated with the latest database values so the user can review the changes made by the other user before deciding to re-enter and re-confirm their own changes

all_rules.Rule_Name: Block Update and Redisplay Refreshed Card Details After Concurrent Modification
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a concurrent modification is detected, the pending update must be cancelled and the screen must be returned to the Show Details state so the user can review the latest card data before deciding whether to re-submit their changes.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All six fields (CVV Code, Card Name, Expiry Year, Expiry Month, Expiry Day, Active Status) match exactly between the current database record and the originally fetched values, and the card record rewrite to the Card File has completed without error
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the outcome of the write processing
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the program state to 'Changes Okayed and Done' (CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE), confirming the update was successfully applied, and the screen is subsequently refreshed to display the updated card details with a success confirmation message

all_rules.Rule_Name: Proceed to Confirm Successful Update When No Concurrent Modification Detected
all_rules.Rule_Description: When all six compared fields match between the current database record and the originally fetched values, confirming no concurrent modification has occurred, the system proceeds to apply the user's changes and marks the update as successfully completed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has confirmed changes to a card record and the card number is available in the current session
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system attempts to retrieve and lock the card record from the card database using the card number as the lookup key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The card record is locked exclusively for update, preventing other users from modifying it simultaneously, and processing continues to verify data integrity before applying changes

all_rules.Rule_Name: Lock Card Record for Update Using Card Number
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before any update can be made to a card record, the system must exclusively lock the card record in the database using the card number as the key, to prevent simultaneous updates by other users.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has attempted to lock the card record for update using the card number
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The lock attempt is unsuccessful (the record cannot be exclusively acquired for update)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The update is immediately aborted, a lock error status (COULD-NOT-LOCK-FOR-UPDATE) is set, and the user is notified that the update cannot proceed; no changes are written to the database

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Record Lock Failure Prevents Update
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the card record cannot be locked for update (e.g., it is already locked by another user or process), the update must be aborted and the user must be informed that the update cannot proceed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card record has been successfully locked for update and the system holds the originally fetched card values (CVV code, cardholder name, expiry year, expiry month, expiry day, and active status)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system compares the current database values of the card record against the originally fetched values for all of the following fields: CVV Code, Cardholder Name (converted to uppercase), Expiry Year, Expiry Month, Expiry Day, and Active Status
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If all six fields match exactly, the data is confirmed unchanged and the update proceeds; if any field differs, a concurrent change is detected and the update is blocked

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect Concurrent Modification of Card Record Before Update
all_rules.Rule_Description: After successfully locking the card record, the system must verify that the card data has not been changed by another user between the time it was originally displayed to the current user and the time the update is being applied. This protects against lost updates in a concurrent environment.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A concurrent change has been detected, meaning the current database values differ from the values originally shown to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system processes the concurrent change condition
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the DATA-WAS-CHANGED-BEFORE-UPDATE status flag, refreshes the stored original card details with the latest values from the database for all fields (CVV Code, Cardholder Name, Expiry Year, Expiry Month, Expiry Day, Active Status), and returns to display the updated card details to the user so they can review and re-confirm their changes

all_rules.Rule_Name: Refresh Card Details and Notify User of Concurrent Change
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a concurrent modification is detected (another user changed the card record after it was displayed to the current user), the system must refresh the displayed card details with the latest database values and notify the user so they can review the current state before re-attempting their update.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card record has been locked, no concurrent modification has been detected, and the system is ready to prepare the updated card record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system begins constructing the card update record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The card update record is fully initialized and cleared of all prior values before any new field values are populated

all_rules.Rule_Name: Initialize a Clean Card Update Record Before Populating
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before populating the card update record with new values, the update record must be fully initialized (cleared) to ensure no residual or stale data from previous operations is carried into the new update.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card update record has been initialized and the confirmed new card number and current session account ID are available
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the identifying fields of the card update record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The card update record is populated with the new card number (CCUP-NEW-CARDID) as the card identifier and the account ID (CC-ACCT-ID-N) as the account identifier

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Card Update Record with Card Number and Account ID
all_rules.Rule_Description: The card update record must be populated with the card number (from the user's confirmed input) and the account ID (from the current session) as key identifying fields of the card record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card update record is being populated and the original CVV code (CCUP-NEW-CVV-CD) from the previously fetched card record is available
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sets the CVV code on the card update record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The CVV code from the originally fetched card record is transferred to the card update record (CARD-UPDATE-CVV-CD) without modification, preserving the original CVV value

all_rules.Rule_Name: Carry Forward Original CVV Code to Updated Card Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The CVV code is not a user-editable field in this update process. The original CVV code from the fetched card record must be carried forward unchanged into the updated card record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card update record is being populated and the user has provided a validated new cardholder name (CCUP-NEW-CRDNAME) consisting of alphabetic characters only
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sets the cardholder name on the card update record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The new cardholder name entered by the user is moved to the embossed name field (CARD-UPDATE-EMBOSSED-NAME) of the card update record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set New Embossed Cardholder Name on Updated Card Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The cardholder name entered and validated by the user must be applied to the card update record as the new embossed name on the card.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card update record is being populated with the user's new expiry year (CCUP-NEW-EXPYEAR) and new expiry month (CCUP-NEW-EXPMON), and the original expiry day (CCUP-NEW-EXPDAY) carried forward from the originally fetched card record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system constructs the expiry date for the card update record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The expiry date is formatted by concatenating the new expiry year, a hyphen separator, the new expiry month, a hyphen separator, and the original expiry day (e.g., YYYY-MM-DD), and this formatted date is stored in the CARD-UPDATE-EXPIRAION-DATE field of the card update record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format and Set Card Expiry Date as YYYY-MM-DD
all_rules.Rule_Description: The card expiry date must be stored in the database in a standardized YYYY-MM-DD format. The year and month come from the user's new input, while the expiry day is always carried forward from the original card record (the day is not user-editable).

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card update record is being populated and the user has provided a validated new card active status (CCUP-NEW-CRDSTCD) with a value of either Y (active) or N (inactive)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sets the active status on the card update record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The new card active status entered by the user is moved to the active status field (CARD-UPDATE-ACTIVE-STATUS) of the card update record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set New Card Active Status on Updated Card Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The card active status entered and validated by the user (Y for active, N for inactive) must be applied to the card update record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card update record has been fully populated with the new card name, formatted expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD), active status, CVV code, card number, and account ID, and the card record is currently locked for update
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system writes the updated card record back to the card database
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The card database record is overwritten with the fully populated card update record, replacing the previous card details with the new values

all_rules.Rule_Name: Write Updated Card Record Back to Card Database
all_rules.Rule_Description: Once the card update record has been fully populated with all new and carried-forward values, the updated record must be written back to the card database to persist the changes.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has attempted to write the updated card record back to the card database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the outcome of the write operation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the write operation is successful, the update success status (CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE) is set and the user is informed of the successful update; if the write operation fails (even though the record was locked), the update failed status (LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED) is set and the user is notified of the failure

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Update Success or Failure After Write Operation
all_rules.Rule_Description: After attempting to write the updated card record to the database, the system must determine whether the write operation succeeded or failed, and set the appropriate outcome status to inform the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has confirmed pending card changes by pressing PF5, and the system attempts to lock the card record in the database using the Card Number as the unique identifier
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system attempts to acquire an exclusive lock on the card record for update
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the lock is successfully acquired, processing continues to check for concurrent changes; if the lock cannot be acquired (record is already held by another process), the system sets the status to 'Could Not Lock For Update', marks the input as in error, and exits the update process without making any changes to the card record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Record Lock Verification Before Update
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before applying any changes to a card record, the system must exclusively reserve (lock) the record for update. If the record cannot be locked, the update is abandoned and a lock error status is set to inform the user that the card could not be reserved.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card record has been successfully locked for update, and the system holds the original card values that were displayed to the user (CVV Code, Cardholder Name, Expiry Year, Expiry Month, Expiry Day, and Active Status)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system compares the current database values of the card record against the original values that were displayed to the user, checking all six fields: CVV Code, Cardholder Name (case-insensitive, converted to uppercase), Expiry Year (positions 1-4 of expiry date), Expiry Month (positions 6-7 of expiry date), Expiry Day (positions 9-10 of expiry date), and Active Status
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If all six fields match exactly, the record is considered unchanged and the system proceeds to write the user's changes; if any one or more fields differ, the system sets the status to 'Data Was Changed Before Update', refreshes the stored original values with the latest database values (CVV Code, Cardholder Name, Expiry Year, Expiry Month, Expiry Day, Active Status), and exits the update process without saving the user's changes

all_rules.Rule_Name: Concurrent Modification Detection Before Card Update
all_rules.Rule_Description: After successfully locking the card record, the system must verify that no other user has modified the card data between the time it was displayed to the current user and the time the update is being applied. This protects data integrity by detecting concurrent modifications.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has detected that the card record was modified by another user between the time it was displayed and the time the current user attempted to confirm their changes, and the stored original values (CVV Code, Cardholder Name, Expiry Year, Expiry Month, Expiry Day, Active Status) have been refreshed with the latest database values
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the update outcome and finds the status is 'Data Was Changed Before Update'
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the program state to 'Show Details', which causes the screen to re-display the card record using the refreshed latest database values for Cardholder Name, Active Status, Expiry Year, Expiry Month, and Expiry Day, effectively notifying the user that the data has changed and prompting them to review and re-confirm any desired changes

all_rules.Rule_Name: Refresh Screen with Latest Card Data After Concurrent Change
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a concurrent modification is detected — meaning another user changed the card record after the current user loaded it — the system must discard the current user's pending changes, update the displayed values with the latest data from the database, and return the screen to the 'Show Details' state so the user can review the current values before attempting any further changes.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card record has been successfully locked, no concurrent changes were detected, and the system has constructed the updated card record with the new Cardholder Name, new Active Status, new Expiry Month, new Expiry Year, original Expiry Day, original CVV Code, Card Number, and Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system attempts to write (rewrite) the updated card record to the database
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the write operation completes successfully, processing continues and the success status will be set; if the write operation fails for any reason, the system sets the status to 'Locked But Update Failed', indicating that the record was locked but the save could not be completed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Record Write Success Verification
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the system has locked the card record and confirmed no concurrent changes, it attempts to write the updated card details to the database. The outcome of this write operation must be evaluated to determine whether the update was successfully persisted or whether it failed despite the record being locked.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card record was successfully locked for update, no concurrent modifications were detected, and the system attempted to write the updated card details to the database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The database write (rewrite) operation does not complete successfully
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the status to 'Locked But Update Failed', which will subsequently cause the update outcome evaluation to set the program state to 'Changes Okayed But Failed' and display a failure notification message to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Update Failure Due to Write Error
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the card record was successfully locked and no concurrent changes were detected, but the actual write operation to the database fails, the system must set a specific failure status to distinguish this scenario from a lock failure, allowing the screen to display an appropriate failure notification to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card record was successfully locked, no concurrent modifications were detected, and the database write operation completed successfully
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the overall update outcome and none of the failure conditions (lock error, update failed, data changed) are present
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the program state to 'Changes Okayed And Done', which will cause the screen to display a success confirmation message and re-display the card details reflecting the successfully saved values

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Update Success Status Assignment
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the card record has been locked, no concurrent changes were found, and the write operation completed successfully, the system must set the success status to confirm that the card details have been permanently updated in the database and to trigger the appropriate success confirmation message on screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has completed the card update write processing, which may have resulted in one of four possible internal statuses: 'Could Not Lock For Update', 'Locked But Update Failed', 'Data Was Changed Before Update', or a successful write with none of those statuses set
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the outcome of the write processing attempt
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system applies the following routing logic in priority order: (1) If status is 'Could Not Lock For Update' — set program state to 'Changes Okayed Lock Error' and display a failure notification; (2) If status is 'Locked But Update Failed' — set program state to 'Changes Okayed But Failed' and display a failure notification; (3) If status is 'Data Was Changed Before Update' — set program state to 'Show Details' and re-display the refreshed card data for user review; (4) In all other cases (successful write) — set program state to 'Changes Okayed And Done' and display a success confirmation message

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Update Outcome Routing and Status Assignment
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the write processing attempt completes, the system evaluates the overall outcome across all possible scenarios — lock failure, concurrent data change, write failure, or success — and routes to the appropriate program state to ensure the correct message and screen behavior is presented to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Credit Card Update screen is about to be prepared for display to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Screen initialization begins
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All output screen fields in the Credit Card Update screen area (CCRDUPAO) are cleared and reset to blank/empty values, ensuring no previously displayed data remains visible

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Screen Output Area Before Initialization
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before populating any screen fields, the entire output screen area must be reset to blank/empty to ensure no residual data from a previous interaction is displayed to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Credit Card Update screen output area has been cleared and is ready for population
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Screen initialization is in progress
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current system date and time are retrieved and stored in the working storage date/time data area (WS-CURDATE-DATA) for subsequent formatting and display on the screen header

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Current System Date and Time for Screen Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system must retrieve the current date and time at the moment the screen is being prepared, so that accurate and up-to-date information is displayed in the screen header.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Credit Card Update screen is being initialized and the output area has been cleared
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Screen header fields are being populated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Title Line 1 on the screen header is populated with the standard application title (CCDA-TITLE01) and Title Line 2 is populated with the standard application subtitle (CCDA-TITLE02)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Screen Header with Application Title Lines
all_rules.Rule_Description: The screen header must display two standard application title lines that identify the application context to the user. These titles are sourced from predefined application constants.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Credit Card Update screen header is being populated during screen initialization
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The transaction identifier field on the screen header is being set
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction ID field on the screen header (TRNNAMEO) is populated with the current transaction identifier (LIT-THISTRANID) that identifies this Credit Card Update transaction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Current Transaction ID on Screen Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: The screen header must display the transaction identifier of the currently executing transaction, allowing users to identify which transaction they are working with.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Credit Card Update screen header is being populated during screen initialization
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program name field on the screen header is being set
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Program Name field on the screen header (PGMNAMEO) is populated with the current program name (LIT-THISPGM) that identifies this Credit Card Update program

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Current Program Name on Screen Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: The screen header must display the name of the currently executing program, providing users and support staff with clear identification of the program being used.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The current system date has been retrieved and stored in the working storage date area (WS-CURDATE-DATA)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The date is being formatted for screen header display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The month component is extracted into the 2-digit month field (WS-CURDATE-MM), the day component is extracted into the 2-digit day field (WS-CURDATE-DD), and only the last 2 digits of the 4-digit year are extracted into the 2-digit year field (WS-CURDATE-YY), resulting in a date formatted as MM-DD-YY

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format Current Date as MM-DD-YY for Screen Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: The current system date must be formatted into the standard MM-DD-YY display format before being shown on the screen header. The year is represented as a 2-digit value extracted from the full 4-digit year.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The current date has been formatted into MM-DD-YY format and stored in the formatted date field (WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The formatted date is being placed onto the screen header
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The formatted date in MM-DD-YY format is moved into the screen header current date display field (CURDATEO of CCRDUPAO) so it is visible to the user on the rendered screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Formatted Date on Screen Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: The formatted MM-DD-YY date must be placed into the screen header date display field so that the user can see the current date when the screen is rendered.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The current system time has been retrieved and stored in the working storage time area as part of the current date/time data (WS-CURDATE-DATA)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The time is being formatted for screen header display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The hours component is extracted into the 2-digit hours field (WS-CURTIME-HH), the minutes component is extracted into the 2-digit minutes field (WS-CURTIME-MM), and the seconds component is extracted into the 2-digit seconds field (WS-CURTIME-SS), resulting in a time formatted as HH-MM-SS

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format Current Time as HH-MM-SS for Screen Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: The current system time must be formatted into the standard HH-MM-SS display format before being shown on the screen header, with hours, minutes, and seconds each extracted into their respective 2-digit fields.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The current time has been formatted into HH-MM-SS format and stored in the formatted time field (WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The formatted time is being placed onto the screen header
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The formatted time in HH-MM-SS format is moved into the screen header current time display field (CURTIMEO of CCRDUPAO) so it is visible to the user on the rendered screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Formatted Time on Screen Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: The formatted HH-MM-SS time must be placed into the screen header time display field so that the user can see the current time when the screen is rendered.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update program is being accessed and the current program state is a fresh entry (first-time entry into the program with no prior session data)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the screen fields for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All screen fields are left blank and no data is populated; the user is presented with an empty form to enter their Account Number and Card Number search criteria

all_rules.Rule_Name: Skip Screen Field Population on Fresh Program Entry
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the credit card update screen is accessed for the first time in a new session, all screen fields should remain blank so the user can enter their search criteria from scratch. No prior data should be pre-populated.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update program is in a re-entry state (not a fresh program entry) and the session Account ID has a numeric value of zero
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Account Number field on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account Number field on the screen is cleared to blank (LOW-VALUES), displaying nothing to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Account Number Field When Account ID Is Zero
all_rules.Rule_Description: During screen re-entry (non-fresh entry), if the current Account ID held in the session has a zero value, the Account Number field on the screen must be cleared to blank rather than displaying a zero or invalid value.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update program is in a re-entry state (not a fresh program entry) and the session Account ID has a non-zero numeric value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Account Number field on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account Number field on the screen is populated with the current Account ID value from the session

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Account Number on Screen When Account ID Is Non-Zero
all_rules.Rule_Description: During screen re-entry, if the current session Account ID holds a non-zero value, the Account Number field on the screen must be populated with that value so the user can see the account they are working with.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update program is in a re-entry state (not a fresh program entry) and the session Card Number has a numeric value of zero
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Card Number field on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Number field on the screen is cleared to blank (LOW-VALUES), displaying nothing to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Card Number Field When Card Number Is Zero
all_rules.Rule_Description: During screen re-entry, if the current Card Number held in the session has a zero value, the Card Number field on the screen must be cleared to blank rather than displaying a zero or invalid value.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update program is in a re-entry state (not a fresh program entry) and the session Card Number has a non-zero numeric value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Card Number field on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Number field on the screen is populated with the current Card Number value from the session

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Card Number on Screen When Card Number Is Non-Zero
all_rules.Rule_Description: During screen re-entry, if the current session Card Number holds a non-zero value, the Card Number field on the screen must be populated with that value so the user can see the card they are working with.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update program is in a re-entry state and the current program state is 'Details Not Yet Fetched' (no card data has been retrieved from the database yet)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the card detail fields on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All card detail fields are cleared to blank (LOW-VALUES): Card Name field is cleared, Card Status Code field is cleared, Expiry Day field is cleared, Expiry Month field is cleared, and Expiry Year field is cleared

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear All Card Detail Fields When Card Details Have Not Yet Been Fetched
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the program state indicates that card details have not yet been retrieved from the database (the user has not yet performed a successful search), all card detail fields on the screen must be cleared to blank. This prevents stale or misleading data from being displayed in the editable detail section.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update program is in a re-entry state and the current program state is 'Show Details' (card data has been successfully retrieved from the database)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the card detail fields on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All card detail fields are populated with the originally fetched database values: Card Name field is set to the original Card Name (CCUP-OLD-CRDNAME), Card Status Code field is set to the original Card Status (CCUP-OLD-CRDSTCD), Expiry Day field is set to the original Expiry Day (CCUP-OLD-EXPDAY), Expiry Month field is set to the original Expiry Month (CCUP-OLD-EXPMON), and Expiry Year field is set to the original Expiry Year (CCUP-OLD-EXPYEAR)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Originally Fetched Card Values When Showing Card Details
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the program state is 'Show Details' (a card has been successfully retrieved from the database and is being presented to the user), all card detail fields on the screen must be populated with the original values that were read from the database. This gives the user an accurate view of the current state of the card record before making any changes.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update program is in a re-entry state and the current program state is 'Changes Made' (user has entered changes that are in progress - either pending confirmation or validation)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the card detail fields on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Name field is populated with the new Card Name entered by the user (CCUP-NEW-CRDNAME); the Card Status Code field is populated with the new Card Status entered by the user (CCUP-NEW-CRDSTCD); the Expiry Month field is populated with the new Expiry Month entered by the user (CCUP-NEW-EXPMON); the Expiry Year field is populated with the new Expiry Year entered by the user (CCUP-NEW-EXPYEAR); and the Expiry Day field is populated with the ORIGINAL Expiry Day from the database (CCUP-OLD-EXPDAY) — the Expiry Day is never changed by user input

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display New User-Entered Values During Changes In Progress While Preserving Original Expiry Day
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the program state indicates that changes are in progress (the user has entered modifications that are either pending validation confirmation or awaiting final confirmation via PF5), the screen must display the new values entered by the user for editable fields. Critically, the Expiry Day field must always retain the original value from the database because the Expiry Day is not an editable field and cannot be changed by the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update program is in a re-entry state and the current program state does not match 'Details Not Fetched', 'Show Details', or 'Changes Made' (i.e., it is any other state such as post-update success, post-update failure, or an unrecognized state)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the card detail fields on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All card detail fields are populated with the originally fetched database values as a safe default: Card Name field is set to the original Card Name (CCUP-OLD-CRDNAME), Card Status Code field is set to the original Card Status (CCUP-OLD-CRDSTCD), Expiry Day field is set to the original Expiry Day (CCUP-OLD-EXPDAY), Expiry Month field is set to the original Expiry Month (CCUP-OLD-EXPMON), and Expiry Year field is set to the original Expiry Year (CCUP-OLD-EXPYEAR)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Originally Fetched Card Values for All Other Program States
all_rules.Rule_Description: For any program state not explicitly handled by the other state-specific rules (such as after a successful update, after a failed update, or any unexpected state), the screen must fall back to displaying the original values that were fetched from the database. This ensures the user always sees consistent and accurate card data as a safe default.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update program has been entered fresh (no prior session data exists, i.e., program state is set to ENTER for the first time)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the current program state to determine which informational message to display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The informational message is set to prompt the user to enter both the Account Number and Card Number to perform a card search

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Search Prompt on Fresh Program Entry
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the credit card update program is entered for the first time in a session, the system must guide the user to begin by entering search criteria (Account Number and Card Number).

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program state is 'Details Not Fetched', meaning no card record has been retrieved and displayed yet in the current interaction
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the current program state to determine which informational message to display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The informational message is set to prompt the user to enter both the Account Number and Card Number to perform a card search

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Search Prompt When Card Details Have Not Been Fetched
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the program is in a state where card details have not yet been retrieved from the database, the system must prompt the user to provide search criteria before any card information can be displayed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program state is 'Show Details', meaning a card record was successfully found and its details (cardholder name, active status, expiry month, expiry year, expiry day) are displayed on screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the current program state to determine which informational message to display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The informational message is set to indicate that card details have been found and the user may review and make changes if needed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Card Found Message When Card Details Are Shown
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a card record has been successfully retrieved and its details are currently displayed on screen, the system must inform the user that the card was found and invite them to review and optionally modify the details.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program state is 'Changes Not OK', meaning the user submitted changes to card fields (cardholder name, active status, expiry month, and/or expiry year) and at least one field failed validation
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the current program state to determine which informational message to display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The informational message is set to prompt the user to correct the highlighted fields and resubmit the changes

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Correction Prompt When Validation Errors Are Present
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user has submitted changes to card details but one or more fields have failed validation, the system must direct the user to correct the highlighted fields before resubmitting.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program state is 'Changes OK - Not Confirmed', meaning all edited card fields (cardholder name, active status, expiry month, expiry year) have passed validation and the changes are pending user confirmation
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the current program state to determine which informational message to display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The informational message is set to prompt the user to confirm the changes by pressing PF05 to save them to the database

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Confirmation Prompt When Changes Are Validated and Awaiting Confirmation
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user has entered changes that have passed all validation checks but have not yet been confirmed and saved, the system must prompt the user to explicitly confirm the changes by pressing PF5.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program state is 'Changes Okayed and Done', meaning the user pressed PF5 to confirm changes, the record was locked, verified as unchanged by another user, and successfully rewritten to the card database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the current program state to determine which informational message to display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The informational message is set to confirm that the card update was completed successfully

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Success Message After Card Update Is Completed
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user has confirmed their changes and the card record has been successfully updated in the database, the system must notify the user that the update was completed successfully.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program state is 'Changes Okayed - Lock Error', meaning the user pressed PF5 to confirm changes but the system failed to lock the card record for update because it was already locked by another process
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the current program state to determine which informational message to display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The informational message is set to inform the user that the update could not be completed because the record is currently locked, and the failure message is placed in the screen error area

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Failure Message When Record Cannot Be Locked for Update
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user confirms changes but the system is unable to obtain an exclusive lock on the card record (because another user or process currently holds it), the system must inform the user that the update could not be completed due to a record lock.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program state is 'Changes Okayed - But Failed', meaning the user pressed PF5 to confirm changes, the card record was successfully locked for update, but the rewrite operation to the card database did not complete successfully
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the current program state to determine which informational message to display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The informational message is set to inform the user that the update could not be completed and they should try again, and the failure message is placed in the screen error area

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Failure Message When Record Is Locked But Write Operation Fails
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user confirms changes, the record is successfully locked, but the actual write/rewrite operation to the card database fails, the system must inform the user that the update could not be completed and they should try again.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program state does not match any of the defined states (Fresh Entry, Details Not Fetched, Show Details, Changes Not OK, Changes OK Not Confirmed, Changes Done, Lock Error, Write Error) and no informational message has been set (WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the current program state to determine which informational message to display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The informational message defaults to prompting the user to enter both the Account Number and Card Number to perform a card search

all_rules.Rule_Name: Default to Search Prompt When No Informational Message Is Available
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no specific informational message has been set for the current program state, the system defaults to displaying the search prompt to guide the user to enter search criteria.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The appropriate informational message (WS-INFO-MSG) has been set based on the current program state (one of: search prompt, card found, correct changes, confirm with PF5, update success, or failure notification)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the screen output for display to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The informational message stored in WS-INFO-MSG is moved to the screen's information message display area (INFOMSGO) so it is visible to the user on the current screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Place Informational Message in Screen Information Area
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the appropriate informational message has been determined based on the current program state, the system must place that message into the designated informational message area of the screen so the user can see it.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A return or error message (WS-RETURN-MSG) may have been set during input processing or validation (e.g., 'Account filter must be an 11-digit number', 'Card ID filter must be a 16-digit number', 'Name must be alphabetic', 'Card status must be Y or N', 'Expiry month not valid', 'Expiry year not valid', 'Did not find account/card combination', or a system error message)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the screen output for display to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The error or return message stored in WS-RETURN-MSG is moved to the screen's error message display area (ERRMSGO) so it is visible to the user alongside the informational message

all_rules.Rule_Name: Place Error or Return Message in Screen Error Area
all_rules.Rule_Description: In addition to the informational message, any error or return message generated during processing (such as validation errors, field-level error descriptions, or system messages) must be placed in the dedicated error message area of the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is displayed and the program state is 'Details Not Yet Fetched' (no card has been looked up yet)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen field attributes are being set for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account Number field is set to editable (unprotected), the Card Number field is set to editable (unprotected), the Card Name field is set to protected (non-editable), the Card Status field is set to protected (non-editable), the Expiry Month field is set to protected (non-editable), and the Expiry Year field is set to protected (non-editable)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Screen Fields to Search Mode When Card Details Not Yet Fetched
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the program is in the initial search state (card details have not yet been retrieved), the Account Number and Card Number fields must be editable so the user can enter search criteria, while all card detail fields (Name, Status, Expiry Month, Expiry Year) are protected and cannot be edited.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is displayed and the program state is either 'Show Details' (card details are visible) or 'Changes Not OK' (card field validation errors exist)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen field attributes are being set for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account Number field is set to protected (non-editable), the Card Number field is set to protected (non-editable), the Card Name field is set to editable (unprotected), the Card Status field is set to editable (unprotected), the Expiry Month field is set to editable (unprotected), and the Expiry Year field is set to editable (unprotected)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Screen Fields to Edit Mode When Card Details Are Displayed or Have Validation Errors
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the program is in the 'Show Details' state (card found and displayed) or in the 'Changes Not OK' state (validation errors exist in card fields), the Account Number and Card Number fields must be protected (non-editable) while all card detail fields become editable so the user can make or correct changes.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is displayed and the program state is either 'Changes OK - Not Confirmed' (pending PF5 confirmation) or 'Changes Okayed and Done' (update successfully completed)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen field attributes are being set for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account Number field is set to protected, the Card Number field is set to protected, the Card Name field is set to protected, the Card Status field is set to protected, the Expiry Month field is set to protected, and the Expiry Year field is set to protected — all fields are non-editable

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set All Screen Fields to Protected When Changes Are Confirmed Pending or Already Saved
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the program is in the 'Changes OK - Not Confirmed' state (awaiting user confirmation via PF5) or the 'Changes Okayed and Done' state (update successfully saved), all screen fields must be fully protected so the user cannot modify any values until the current workflow step is resolved.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is displayed and the program state does not match any of the explicitly defined states (Details Not Fetched, Show Details, Changes Not OK, Changes OK Not Confirmed, Changes Done)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen field attributes are being set for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account Number field is set to editable (unprotected), the Card Number field is set to editable (unprotected), the Card Name field is set to protected (non-editable), the Card Status field is set to protected (non-editable), the Expiry Month field is set to protected (non-editable), and the Expiry Year field is set to protected (non-editable)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Apply Default Search Mode Field Attributes for All Other Program States
all_rules.Rule_Description: For any program state not explicitly handled (default/fallback), the screen reverts to search mode: Account Number and Card Number fields are editable, while all card detail fields are protected.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The condition 'Found Cards for Account' is true OR the condition 'No Changes Detected' is true
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor is automatically positioned on the Card Name field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Position Cursor on Card Name Field When Card Is Found or No Changes Detected
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a card has been successfully found and its details are displayed, or when the user submits the screen but no changes have been detected compared to the original values, the cursor is automatically positioned on the Card Name field to guide the user to begin editing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account Number filter flag is set to 'Not OK' (invalid value) OR the Account Number filter flag is set to 'Blank' (no value entered)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor is automatically positioned on the Account Number field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Position Cursor on Account Number Field When Account Number Is Invalid or Blank
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account Number field fails validation (either because it is blank or contains a non-numeric value), the cursor is automatically positioned on the Account Number field to direct the user to correct the entry.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Number filter flag is set to 'Not OK' (invalid value) OR the Card Number filter flag is set to 'Blank' (no value entered)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor is automatically positioned on the Card Number field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Position Cursor on Card Number Field When Card Number Is Invalid or Blank
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Card Number field fails validation (either because it is blank or contains a non-numeric value), the cursor is automatically positioned on the Card Number field to direct the user to correct the entry.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Name flag is set to 'Not OK' (invalid characters) OR the Card Name flag is set to 'Blank' (no value entered)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor is automatically positioned on the Card Name field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Position Cursor on Card Name Field When Card Name Is Invalid or Blank
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Card Name field fails validation (either because it is blank or contains non-alphabetic characters), the cursor is automatically positioned on the Card Name field to direct the user to correct the entry.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Status flag is set to 'Not OK' (invalid value) OR the Card Status flag is set to 'Blank' (no value entered)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor is automatically positioned on the Card Status field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Position Cursor on Card Status Field When Card Status Is Invalid or Blank
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Card Status field fails validation (either because it is blank or does not contain a valid Y/N value), the cursor is automatically positioned on the Card Status field to direct the user to correct the entry.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Expiry Month flag is set to 'Not OK' (invalid month value) OR the Expiry Month flag is set to 'Blank' (no value entered)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor is automatically positioned on the Expiry Month field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Position Cursor on Expiry Month Field When Expiry Month Is Invalid or Blank
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Expiry Month field fails validation (either because it is blank or is not a valid calendar month 01-12), the cursor is automatically positioned on the Expiry Month field to direct the user to correct the entry.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Expiry Year flag is set to 'Not OK' (invalid year value) OR the Expiry Year flag is set to 'Blank' (no value entered)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor is automatically positioned on the Expiry Year field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Position Cursor on Expiry Year Field When Expiry Year Is Invalid or Blank
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Expiry Year field fails validation (either because it is blank or fails the year validity check), the cursor is automatically positioned on the Expiry Year field to direct the user to correct the entry.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: None of the specific cursor-positioning conditions are met (no card found, no changes detected, no field validation errors)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor is automatically positioned on the Account Number field by default

all_rules.Rule_Name: Position Cursor on Account Number Field as Default When No Specific Error Condition Applies
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no specific field error or card-found condition applies, the cursor defaults to the Account Number field as the primary entry point for the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The last map set used was the Card List map set (indicating the user arrived from the Card List screen)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account Number field color is set to the default display color and the Card Number field color is set to the default display color (overriding any previously set color)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reset Account and Card Number Field Colors to Default When User Arrived from Card List Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user navigates to the card update screen from the Card List screen, the Account Number and Card Number fields are displayed in the default color (not highlighted), since these values were passed in from the list and are pre-populated.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account Number filter flag is set to 'Not OK' (the value entered is invalid, e.g., non-numeric)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account Number field is displayed with a red color highlight

all_rules.Rule_Name: Highlight Account Number Field in Red When Account Number Value Is Invalid
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account Number entered by the user fails validation (non-numeric or otherwise invalid), the Account Number field is highlighted in red to visually alert the user to the error.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display and the program is in re-entry mode (user has previously submitted the screen)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account Number filter flag is set to 'Blank' (no account number was entered)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: An asterisk character '*' is displayed in the Account Number field and the field is highlighted in red color

all_rules.Rule_Name: Show Asterisk and Highlight Account Number Field in Red When Account Number Is Blank on Re-entry
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user has previously interacted with the screen (re-entry) and the Account Number field is blank, an asterisk placeholder is displayed in the field and it is highlighted in red to indicate that a required value is missing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Number filter flag is set to 'Not OK' (the value entered is invalid, e.g., non-numeric)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Number field is displayed with a red color highlight

all_rules.Rule_Name: Highlight Card Number Field in Red When Card Number Value Is Invalid
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Card Number entered by the user fails validation (non-numeric or otherwise invalid), the Card Number field is highlighted in red to visually alert the user to the error.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display and the program is in re-entry mode (user has previously submitted the screen)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Number filter flag is set to 'Blank' (no card number was entered)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: An asterisk character '*' is displayed in the Card Number field and the field is highlighted in red color

all_rules.Rule_Name: Show Asterisk and Highlight Card Number Field in Red When Card Number Is Blank on Re-entry
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user has previously interacted with the screen (re-entry) and the Card Number field is blank, an asterisk placeholder is displayed in the field and it is highlighted in red to indicate that a required value is missing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display and the program state is 'Changes Not OK'
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Name flag is set to 'Not OK' (the name contains invalid characters such as non-alphabetic characters)
