Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Name field is displayed with a red color highlight

all_rules.Rule_Name: Highlight Card Name Field in Red When Card Name Is Invalid and Changes Have Errors
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Card Name field contains an invalid value (e.g., non-alphabetic characters) AND the program is in the 'Changes Not OK' state (validation errors exist), the Card Name field is highlighted in red.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display and the program state is 'Changes Not OK'
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Name flag is set to 'Blank' (no card name was entered)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: An asterisk character '*' is displayed in the Card Name field and the field is highlighted in red color

all_rules.Rule_Name: Show Asterisk and Highlight Card Name Field in Red When Card Name Is Blank and Changes Have Errors
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Card Name field is blank AND the program is in the 'Changes Not OK' state (validation errors exist), an asterisk placeholder is displayed in the field and it is highlighted in red to indicate the required value is missing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display and the program state is 'Changes Not OK'
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Status flag is set to 'Not OK' (the value is not a valid Y or N)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Status field is displayed with a red color highlight

all_rules.Rule_Name: Highlight Card Status Field in Red When Card Status Is Invalid and Changes Have Errors
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Card Status field contains an invalid value (not Y or N) AND the program is in the 'Changes Not OK' state, the Card Status field is highlighted in red.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display and the program state is 'Changes Not OK'
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Status flag is set to 'Blank' (no status value was entered)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: An asterisk character '*' is displayed in the Card Status field and the field is highlighted in red color

all_rules.Rule_Name: Show Asterisk and Highlight Card Status Field in Red When Card Status Is Blank and Changes Have Errors
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Card Status field is blank AND the program is in the 'Changes Not OK' state, an asterisk placeholder is displayed in the field and it is highlighted in red to indicate the required value is missing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Screen field attributes are being applied, regardless of the current program state or any validation conditions
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Expiry Day field is always set to dark/non-interactive display attribute, making it non-editable and visually suppressed at all times

all_rules.Rule_Name: Always Display Expiry Day Field as Dark and Non-Editable
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Expiry Day field is always displayed as dark (suppressed/non-interactive) regardless of program state, because the expiry day cannot be changed by the user — it is always carried forward from the original card record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display and the program state is 'Changes Not OK'
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Expiry Month flag is set to 'Not OK' (the month value is not between 01 and 12)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Expiry Month field is displayed with a red color highlight

all_rules.Rule_Name: Highlight Expiry Month Field in Red When Expiry Month Is Invalid and Changes Have Errors
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Expiry Month field contains an invalid value (not a valid calendar month 01-12) AND the program is in the 'Changes Not OK' state, the Expiry Month field is highlighted in red.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display and the program state is 'Changes Not OK'
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Expiry Month flag is set to 'Blank' (no month value was entered)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: An asterisk character '*' is displayed in the Expiry Month field and the field is highlighted in red color

all_rules.Rule_Name: Show Asterisk and Highlight Expiry Month Field in Red When Expiry Month Is Blank and Changes Have Errors
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Expiry Month field is blank AND the program is in the 'Changes Not OK' state, an asterisk placeholder is displayed in the field and it is highlighted in red to indicate the required value is missing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display and the program state is 'Changes Not OK'
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Expiry Year flag is set to 'Not OK' (the year value fails the validity check)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Expiry Year field is displayed with a red color highlight

all_rules.Rule_Name: Highlight Expiry Year Field in Red When Expiry Year Is Invalid and Changes Have Errors
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Expiry Year field contains an invalid value AND the program is in the 'Changes Not OK' state, the Expiry Year field is highlighted in red.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display and the program state is 'Changes Not OK'
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Expiry Year flag is set to 'Blank' (no year value was entered)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: An asterisk character '*' is displayed in the Expiry Year field and the field is highlighted in red color

all_rules.Rule_Name: Show Asterisk and Highlight Expiry Year Field in Red When Expiry Year Is Blank and Changes Have Errors
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Expiry Year field is blank AND the program is in the 'Changes Not OK' state, an asterisk placeholder is displayed in the field and it is highlighted in red to indicate the required value is missing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The information message indicator is set to 'No Info Message' (no message content is available)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The information message area on the screen is set to dark display attribute (suppressed/non-visible)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Suppress Information Message Area When No Informational Message Is Present
all_rules.Rule_Description: When there is no informational message to display to the user, the information message area on the screen is set to dark/suppressed so it does not draw attention or display blank space prominently.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The information message indicator contains a message (the 'No Info Message' condition is false)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The information message area on the screen is set to bright yellow display attribute, making it prominently visible to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Information Message Area as Bright and Visible When a Message Is Present
all_rules.Rule_Description: When there is an informational message to display to the user (e.g., card found, update successful, prompt for confirmation), the information message area is set to bright/visible so the user's attention is drawn to it.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The current informational message state is 'Prompt for Confirmation' (program state is 'Changes OK - Not Confirmed', awaiting PF5 press)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The function key area of the screen is set to bright yellow display attribute to visually alert the user that PF5 confirmation is required

all_rules.Rule_Name: Highlight Function Key Area in Bright Yellow When User Must Confirm Changes via PF5
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the program is in the 'Changes OK - Not Confirmed' state and the user must press PF5 to confirm and save their changes, the function key area of the screen is highlighted in bright yellow to draw the user's attention to the required confirmation action.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display, and either a card record has just been successfully found in the database (FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT is true) OR the user submitted the screen and no differences were detected between the entered values and the original card data (NO-CHANGES-DETECTED is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system determines where to position the screen cursor for the next user interaction
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor is positioned on the Card Name (Cardholder Name) input field, directing the user to begin entering or reviewing the cardholder name

all_rules.Rule_Name: Position Cursor on Card Name After Successful Card Lookup
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a card has just been successfully retrieved from the database, or when the user submits the screen with no changes detected compared to the original card data, the screen cursor is automatically positioned on the Card Name field to guide the user to begin editing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display, and the card details have not yet been fetched (search mode is active), and the Account Number field is either flagged as invalid (FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK is true) OR flagged as blank (FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system determines where to position the screen cursor for the next user interaction
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor is positioned on the Account Number (Account ID) input field, directing the user to enter or correct the 11-digit numeric Account Number

all_rules.Rule_Name: Position Cursor on Account Number Field When Account Is Invalid or Blank
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account Number entered by the user is either invalid (non-numeric or otherwise fails validation) or was left blank, the screen cursor is positioned on the Account Number field to direct the user to correct or supply the required value.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display, and the card details have not yet been fetched (search mode is active), and the Account Number is not flagged with an error, and the Card Number field is either flagged as invalid (FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK is true) OR flagged as blank (FLG-CARDFILTER-BLANK is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system determines where to position the screen cursor for the next user interaction
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor is positioned on the Card Number (Card ID) input field, directing the user to enter or correct the 16-digit numeric Card Number

all_rules.Rule_Name: Position Cursor on Card Number Field When Card Number Is Invalid or Blank
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Card Number entered by the user is either invalid (non-numeric or otherwise fails validation) or was left blank, the screen cursor is positioned on the Card Number field to direct the user to correct or supply the required value.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display in edit mode (card details already fetched), and neither a successful card lookup nor a no-change condition applies, and the Account Number and Card Number are not flagged with errors, and the Card Name field is either flagged as invalid (FLG-CARDNAME-NOT-OK is true) OR flagged as blank (FLG-CARDNAME-BLANK is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system determines where to position the screen cursor for the next user interaction
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor is positioned on the Card Name (Cardholder Name) input field, directing the user to enter or correct the cardholder name using alphabetic characters only

all_rules.Rule_Name: Position Cursor on Card Name Field When Card Name Is Invalid or Blank
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user has submitted changes to the card details and the Cardholder Name field is either invalid (contains non-alphabetic characters) or was left blank, the screen cursor is positioned on the Card Name field to direct the user to correct or supply the required value.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display in edit mode (card details already fetched), and neither a successful card lookup, no-change condition, account error, card number error, nor card name error applies, and the Card Active Status field is either flagged as invalid (FLG-CARDSTATUS-NOT-OK is true) OR flagged as blank (FLG-CARDSTATUS-BLANK is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system determines where to position the screen cursor for the next user interaction
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor is positioned on the Card Active Status input field, directing the user to enter or correct the status value which must be Y (Yes/Active) or N (No/Inactive)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Position Cursor on Card Status Field When Card Active Status Is Invalid or Blank
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user has submitted changes to the card details and the Card Active Status field is either invalid (not Y or N) or was left blank, the screen cursor is positioned on the Card Status field to direct the user to correct or supply the required value.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display in edit mode (card details already fetched), and none of the higher-priority error conditions apply (no successful lookup, no no-change, no account error, no card number error, no card name error, no card status error), and the Expiry Month field is either flagged as invalid (FLG-CARDEXPMON-NOT-OK is true) OR flagged as blank (FLG-CARDEXPMON-BLANK is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system determines where to position the screen cursor for the next user interaction
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor is positioned on the Expiry Month input field, directing the user to enter or correct the card expiry month with a valid value between 01 and 12

all_rules.Rule_Name: Position Cursor on Expiry Month Field When Expiry Month Is Invalid or Blank
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user has submitted changes to the card details and the Expiry Month field is either invalid (not a valid calendar month 01–12) or was left blank, the screen cursor is positioned on the Expiry Month field to direct the user to correct or supply the required value.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display in edit mode (card details already fetched), and none of the higher-priority error conditions apply (no successful lookup, no no-change, no account error, no card number error, no card name error, no card status error, no expiry month error), and the Expiry Year field is either flagged as invalid (FLG-CARDEXPYEAR-NOT-OK is true) OR flagged as blank (FLG-CARDEXPYEAR-BLANK is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system determines where to position the screen cursor for the next user interaction
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor is positioned on the Expiry Year input field, directing the user to enter or correct the card expiry year with a valid year value

all_rules.Rule_Name: Position Cursor on Expiry Year Field When Expiry Year Is Invalid or Blank
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user has submitted changes to the card details and the Expiry Year field is either invalid (fails year validity check) or was left blank, the screen cursor is positioned on the Expiry Year field to direct the user to correct or supply the required value.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update screen is being prepared for display, and none of the following conditions are true: card just found (FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT), no changes detected (NO-CHANGES-DETECTED), account number invalid (FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK), account number blank (FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK), card number invalid (FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK), card number blank (FLG-CARDFILTER-BLANK), card name invalid (FLG-CARDNAME-NOT-OK), card name blank (FLG-CARDNAME-BLANK), card status invalid (FLG-CARDSTATUS-NOT-OK), card status blank (FLG-CARDSTATUS-BLANK), expiry month invalid (FLG-CARDEXPMON-NOT-OK), expiry month blank (FLG-CARDEXPMON-BLANK), expiry year invalid (FLG-CARDEXPYEAR-NOT-OK), expiry year blank (FLG-CARDEXPYEAR-BLANK)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system determines where to position the screen cursor for the next user interaction and no specific field error or post-lookup state is identified
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor is positioned on the Account Number (Account ID) input field as the default starting point, prompting the user to begin by entering the account number

all_rules.Rule_Name: Default Cursor Position on Account Number Field When No Specific Error Applies
all_rules.Rule_Description: When none of the specific error or state conditions (card found, no changes, account error, card number error, card name error, card status error, expiry month error, expiry year error) are applicable, the screen cursor defaults to the Account Number field as the primary entry point for the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has arrived at the Credit Card Update screen from the Card List screen (the last mapset used equals the Card List mapset)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account Number field and the Card Number field are both rendered in the default display color (no error highlighting), indicating they were passed in from the Card List screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Apply Default Color to Account and Card Number Fields When Arriving from Card List Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user navigates to the Credit Card Update screen from the Card List screen, the Account Number and Card Number fields are displayed in the default color to indicate they were pre-populated from the previous screen and are not in an error state.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted the Credit Card Update screen with an Account Number value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account Number fails format validation — it is present but is not a valid numeric value
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account Number field is highlighted in RED on the screen to indicate an invalid format error

all_rules.Rule_Name: Highlight Account Number Field in Red When Format is Invalid
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account Number entered by the user fails format validation (i.e., it is not a valid 11-digit numeric value), the Account Number field is highlighted in red to alert the user to the error.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on a re-entry interaction with the Credit Card Update screen (not the first time the screen is shown) and the Account Number field is blank or empty
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: An asterisk character ('*') is placed in the Account Number field as a visual placeholder, and the field is highlighted in RED to indicate it is required and missing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Show Asterisk and Highlight Account Number Field in Red When Blank on Re-entry
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user has previously interacted with the screen (re-entry) and the Account Number field is blank, an asterisk placeholder is displayed in the field and it is highlighted in red to prompt the user to provide the required value.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted the Credit Card Update screen with a Card Number value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Number fails format validation — it is present but is not a valid numeric value
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Number field is highlighted in RED on the screen to indicate an invalid format error

all_rules.Rule_Name: Highlight Card Number Field in Red When Format is Invalid
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Card Number entered by the user fails format validation (i.e., it is not a valid 16-digit numeric value), the Card Number field is highlighted in red to alert the user to the error.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on a re-entry interaction with the Credit Card Update screen (not the first time the screen is shown) and the Card Number field is blank or empty
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: An asterisk character ('*') is placed in the Card Number field as a visual placeholder, and the field is highlighted in RED to indicate it is required and missing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Show Asterisk and Highlight Card Number Field in Red When Blank on Re-entry
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user has previously interacted with the screen (re-entry) and the Card Number field is blank, an asterisk placeholder is displayed in the field and it is highlighted in red to prompt the user to provide the required value.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen is in the 'Changes Not OK' state (changes were submitted but failed validation) and the Card Name field contains an invalid value (non-alphabetic characters)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Name field is highlighted in RED to indicate the value entered is not valid

all_rules.Rule_Name: Highlight Card Name Field in Red When Invalid During Active Change Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user has entered a Card Name that fails validation (e.g., contains non-alphabetic characters) and the screen is in an active change-editing state (changes have been detected but not yet confirmed), the Card Name field is highlighted in red.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen is in the 'Changes Not OK' state and the Card Name field is blank or empty
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: An asterisk character ('*') is placed in the Card Name field as a visual placeholder, and the field is highlighted in RED to indicate it is required and missing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Show Asterisk and Highlight Card Name Field in Red When Blank During Active Change Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user has left the Card Name field blank and the screen is in an active change-editing state (changes not OK), an asterisk placeholder is displayed and the field is highlighted in red to indicate the required value is missing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen is in the 'Changes Not OK' state and the Card Status field contains a value that is not 'Y' or 'N'
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Status field is highlighted in RED to indicate the value entered is not valid

all_rules.Rule_Name: Highlight Card Status Field in Red When Invalid During Active Change Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user has entered a Card Active Status value that is not a valid Y (Yes) or N (No) and the screen is in an active change-editing state (changes not OK), the Card Status field is highlighted in red.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen is in the 'Changes Not OK' state and the Card Status field is blank or empty
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: An asterisk character ('*') is placed in the Card Status field as a visual placeholder, and the field is highlighted in RED to indicate it is required and missing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Show Asterisk and Highlight Card Status Field in Red When Blank During Active Change Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user has left the Card Status field blank and the screen is in an active change-editing state (changes not OK), an asterisk placeholder is displayed and the field is highlighted in red to indicate the required value is missing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Credit Card Update screen is being prepared for any display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Screen color attributes are being applied
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Expiry Day field is always rendered in dark color (DFHBMDAR) regardless of any other conditions, indicating it is a read-only display field that cannot be modified by the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Apply Dark Non-Editable Color to Expiry Day Field
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Expiry Day field is always displayed in a dark, non-interactive color on every screen display, indicating to the user that this field cannot be edited and is maintained by the system.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen is in the 'Changes Not OK' state and the Expiry Month field contains a value that is not a valid month (not between 01 and 12)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Expiry Month field is highlighted in RED to indicate the value entered is not a valid calendar month

all_rules.Rule_Name: Highlight Expiry Month Field in Red When Invalid During Active Change Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user has entered an Expiry Month value that is not a valid calendar month (01–12) and the screen is in an active change-editing state (changes not OK), the Expiry Month field is highlighted in red.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen is in the 'Changes Not OK' state and the Expiry Month field is blank or empty
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: An asterisk character ('*') is placed in the Expiry Month field as a visual placeholder, and the field is highlighted in RED to indicate it is required and missing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Show Asterisk and Highlight Expiry Month Field in Red When Blank During Active Change Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user has left the Expiry Month field blank and the screen is in an active change-editing state (changes not OK), an asterisk placeholder is displayed and the field is highlighted in red to indicate the required value is missing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen is in the 'Changes Not OK' state and the Expiry Year field contains a value that does not pass year validity checks
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Expiry Year field is highlighted in RED to indicate the value entered is not a valid year

all_rules.Rule_Name: Highlight Expiry Year Field in Red When Invalid During Active Change Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user has entered an Expiry Year value that fails year validation and the screen is in an active change-editing state (changes not OK), the Expiry Year field is highlighted in red.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen is in the 'Changes Not OK' state and the Expiry Year field is blank or empty
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: An asterisk character ('*') is placed in the Expiry Year field as a visual placeholder, and the field is highlighted in RED to indicate it is required and missing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Show Asterisk and Highlight Expiry Year Field in Red When Blank During Active Change Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user has left the Expiry Year field blank and the screen is in an active change-editing state (changes not OK), an asterisk placeholder is displayed and the field is highlighted in red to indicate the required value is missing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen is in the 'Changes OK - Not Confirmed' state, meaning the user has entered valid changes that have not yet been confirmed for saving
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The function keys area of the screen is highlighted in BRIGHT YELLOW (DFHBMBRY) to visually alert the user that confirmation via PF5 is required to complete the update

all_rules.Rule_Name: Highlight Function Keys Area in Bright Yellow When Confirmation of Changes is Required
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user has submitted valid changes that are awaiting confirmation (pending PF5 confirmation), the function key area of the screen is highlighted in bright yellow to draw the user's attention to the need to press PF5 to confirm and save the changes.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Credit Card Update screen has been fully prepared with all field values, informational messages, error highlights, cursor positioning, and field attributes populated in the output screen buffer (CCRDUPAO)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system is ready to transmit the formatted screen to the user terminal
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must set the target map name to the Credit Card Update map (LIT-THISMAP) and the target mapset name to the Credit Card Update mapset (LIT-THISMAPSET), storing these as the next map and mapset to be sent (CCARD-NEXT-MAP and CCARD-NEXT-MAPSET respectively)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Target Screen Map and Mapset Before Transmission
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before transmitting the Credit Card Update screen to the user terminal, the system must designate the correct screen map name and mapset name as the target destination for the screen send operation. This ensures the correct screen layout is used for the card update interaction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The target map name (CCARD-NEXT-MAP) and mapset name (CCARD-NEXT-MAPSET) have been set, and the output screen buffer (CCRDUPAO) contains all formatted field values, colors, error indicators, and informational messages; the cursor position has been set to -1 on the appropriate field during screen attribute setup (3300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS) based on the current program state and any validation errors
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sends the screen to the user terminal
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must transmit the formatted screen buffer (CCRDUPAO) using the designated map and mapset, with the cursor automatically placed on the field that was assigned a cursor-position value of -1 during attribute setup — which is determined by the following priority: (1) card name field when a card is found or no changes are detected, (2) account ID field when account filter is invalid or blank, (3) card number field when card filter is invalid or blank, (4) card name field when card name is invalid or blank, (5) card status field when card status is invalid or blank, (6) expiry month field when expiry month is invalid or blank, (7) expiry year field when expiry year is invalid or blank, (8) account ID field as the default

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transmit Formatted Screen to User Terminal with Cursor Positioning
all_rules.Rule_Description: The fully formatted Credit Card Update screen, including all field values, error highlights, and informational messages, must be transmitted to the user's terminal. The cursor must be automatically positioned on the field designated during screen attribute setup, guiding the user to the next required action or the field needing correction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The formatted Credit Card Update screen buffer (CCRDUPAO) is ready for transmission and the user terminal may currently be displaying content from a previous screen interaction
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sends the new screen to the user terminal
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must erase all previously displayed content on the terminal screen before rendering the new formatted screen, so that only the current screen content is visible to the user with no residual data from prior displays

all_rules.Rule_Name: Erase Previous Screen Content Before Displaying New Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When transmitting the Credit Card Update screen to the user terminal, the system must clear any previously displayed screen content before rendering the new screen. This ensures the user always sees a clean, accurate, and unambiguous display of the current card update state without residual data from prior interactions.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The formatted Credit Card Update screen has been successfully transmitted to the user terminal and the previous screen content has been erased and replaced with the new screen display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen transmission is complete
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must release the keyboard lock on the user terminal (FREEKB), enabling the user to type in editable fields, navigate between fields, and press valid function keys (ENTER, PF3, PF5, PF12) to continue interacting with the Credit Card Update screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Unlock User Keyboard After Screen Is Displayed
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the Credit Card Update screen has been transmitted and displayed on the user terminal, the keyboard must be unlocked to allow the user to interact with the screen. This enables the user to enter or modify data, navigate fields, and press function keys to trigger the next step in the card update workflow.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Credit Card Update program has completed processing the current user interaction and is preparing to return control, and a return message (WS-RETURN-MSG) may have been set during processing (e.g., a validation error message, a prompt message, or a success/failure notification)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program reaches the Program Return step (COMMON-RETURN) after any processing path concludes
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current return message (WS-RETURN-MSG) must be copied into the communication area error message field (CCARD-ERROR-MSG) so that the message is preserved and available for display on the next screen presented to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Preserve Error Message for User Feedback on Return
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before returning control to the CICS environment, the program must preserve any error or informational return message generated during the current interaction so it is available for display to the user in the next screen interaction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Credit Card Update program has completed processing and is preparing to return control to CICS, and the main application communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) contains current session-level data including account ID, card number, calling program details, transaction IDs, user type, and program state flags
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program reaches the Program Return step (COMMON-RETURN)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The entire contents of the main application communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) must be copied into the first portion of the combined return communication area (WS-COMMAREA), starting at position 1, so that all shared application session data is preserved for the next interaction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Package Main Application Session Data into Return Communication Area
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before returning control to CICS, the program must consolidate the main application-level communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA), which holds shared session data such as account ID, card number, program navigation details, and user type, into the combined return communication area so that this context is available to the next program or transaction invoked.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Credit Card Update program has completed processing and is preparing to return control to CICS, and the program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) contains card update workflow state data including old card details (name, status, expiry), new card details entered by the user, update state flags (e.g., details-not-fetched, changes-ok-not-confirmed, changes-done), and field-level validation flags
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program reaches the Program Return step (COMMON-RETURN) after the main application communication area has already been packaged into the combined return area
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The entire contents of the program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) must be copied into the combined return communication area (WS-COMMAREA) starting at the position immediately after the end of the main application communication area (offset = LENGTH OF CARDDEMO-COMMAREA + 1) for a length equal to the size of WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA, so that the card update workflow state is fully preserved for the next interaction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Package Program-Specific Session Data into Return Communication Area
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before returning control to CICS, the program must also consolidate its own program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA), which holds card update workflow state data such as old and new card details, update status flags, and field-level validation flags, into the second portion of the combined return communication area immediately following the main application data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Credit Card Update program has completed processing the current user interaction, the error message has been saved into the communication area, and both the main application communication area and the program-specific communication area have been packaged into the combined return communication area (WS-COMMAREA)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program executes the final return step
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Control must be returned to CICS specifying: (1) the current Credit Card Update transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID) as the transaction to be re-invoked on the next user interaction, and (2) the complete combined communication area (WS-COMMAREA) at its full defined length, so that the next user interaction resumes with the complete preserved session context including all application state, card details, validation flags, and navigation information

all_rules.Rule_Name: Return Control to CICS with Transaction Context for Next User Interaction
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all session data has been packaged, the program must formally return control to the CICS environment, specifying the current transaction ID so that the same transaction is re-invoked when the user next interacts with the screen, and passing the complete combined communication area so that all session context (application-level and program-specific) is available for that next interaction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is viewing card details on the Credit Card Update screen and has submitted changes to one or more editable fields (Card Name, Active Status, Expiry Month, or Expiry Year)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system detects that the submitted values differ from the original card details currently stored
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the program state to 'Changes Not Yet Validated' (CCUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK) before proceeding to validate each individual field, ensuring no changes are treated as valid until all validations pass

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark Card Update State as Changes Not Yet Validated
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user submits changed card details, the system immediately marks the update state as 'Changes Not Yet Validated' before performing any field-level validation, ensuring that no unvalidated changes can proceed to confirmation or saving.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Credit Card Update screen in edit mode with card details displayed, and has submitted changes
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Cardholder Name field is blank, contains only spaces, or contains only zero values
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets an input error flag, marks the card name field status as blank/missing, and sets the informational message to prompt the user to enter a card name; validation of the card name field stops and processing continues to the next field (Card Active Status)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Name - Required Field Check
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates that the Cardholder Name field is not left blank when the user submits card update changes. The card name is a mandatory field and must be provided before any update can proceed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has provided a non-blank value in the Cardholder Name field on the Credit Card Update screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system checks the provided name by replacing all valid alphabetic characters with spaces and then trimming the result — if any non-space characters remain after trimming, the name contains invalid (non-alphabetic) characters
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If non-alphabetic characters are found: the system sets an input error flag, marks the card name field as invalid, and sets the informational message to indicate the name must contain alphabetic characters only; if all characters are alphabetic: the card name is marked as valid and processing continues to the next field (Card Active Status)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Name - Alphabetic Characters Only Check
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates that the Cardholder Name contains only alphabetic characters. Names with numeric digits or non-alphabetic special characters are rejected to ensure data integrity of the embossed card name.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Credit Card Update screen in edit mode and has submitted changes
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Active Status field is blank, contains only spaces, or contains only zero values
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets an input error flag, marks the card status field as blank/missing, and sets the informational message to indicate that card status must be Y or N; validation of the status field stops and processing continues to the next field (Expiry Month)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Active Status - Required Field Check
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates that the Card Active Status field is not left blank when the user submits card update changes. The active status is a mandatory field indicating whether the card is active or inactive.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has provided a non-blank value in the Card Active Status field on the Credit Card Update screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system checks whether the provided status value passes the Y-or-N validity check
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the value is not Y or N: the system sets an input error flag, marks the card status field as invalid, and sets the informational message to indicate that card status must be Y or N; if the value is Y or N: the card active status is marked as valid and processing continues to the next field (Expiry Month)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Active Status - Valid Value Check (Y or N Only)
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates that the Card Active Status field contains only an accepted value of Y (Yes/Active) or N (No/Inactive). Any other value is rejected to ensure the card's active state is unambiguous.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Credit Card Update screen in edit mode and has submitted changes
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Expiry Month field is blank, contains only spaces, or contains only zero values
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets an input error flag, marks the expiry month field as blank/missing, and sets the informational message to indicate that the expiry month is not valid; validation of the month field stops and processing continues to the next field (Expiry Year)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Expiry Month - Required Field Check
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates that the Card Expiry Month field is not left blank when the user submits card update changes. The expiry month is a mandatory field for the card's expiration date.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has provided a non-blank value in the Card Expiry Month field on the Credit Card Update screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system checks whether the provided month value passes the valid-month condition (must be a numeric value representing a valid calendar month, i.e., 01 through 12)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the month is outside the valid range or is not numeric: the system sets an input error flag, marks the expiry month field as invalid, and sets the informational message to indicate that the expiry month is not valid; if the month is valid: the expiry month is marked as valid and processing continues to the next field (Expiry Year)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Expiry Month - Valid Calendar Month Range Check
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates that the Card Expiry Month contains a valid calendar month value. Only values representing actual months of the year are accepted.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Credit Card Update screen in edit mode and has submitted changes
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Expiry Year field is blank, contains only spaces, or contains only zero values
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets an input error flag, marks the expiry year field as blank/missing, and sets the informational message to indicate that the expiry year is not valid; validation of the year field stops and processing continues to the overall validation outcome check

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Expiry Year - Required Field Check
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates that the Card Expiry Year field is not left blank when the user submits card update changes. The expiry year is a mandatory field for the card's expiration date.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has provided a non-blank value in the Card Expiry Year field on the Credit Card Update screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system checks whether the provided year value passes the valid-year condition (must be a numeric value within the accepted year range)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the year fails the validity check: the system sets an input error flag, marks the expiry year field as invalid, and sets the informational message to indicate that the expiry year is not valid; if the year is valid: the expiry year is marked as valid and processing continues to the overall validation outcome check

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Expiry Year - Valid Year Range Check
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates that the Card Expiry Year contains a valid year value. Only years within an accepted range are permitted to ensure the expiry date is meaningful and within a reasonable business timeframe.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has completed validation of all four editable card fields: Card Name, Card Active Status, Expiry Month, and Expiry Year
Acceptance_Criteria.When: One or more of the validated fields has been flagged with an input error
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program state remains as 'Changes Not Yet Validated' (CCUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK); the screen is redisplayed with all invalid fields highlighted in red, blank required fields shown with an asterisk placeholder, and an appropriate error message prompting the user to correct the changes

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Overall Validation Outcome - Errors Found
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all four card detail fields have been individually validated, the system evaluates the overall validation result. If any field failed validation, the update state remains as 'Changes Not Yet Validated' and the screen is redisplayed with all errors highlighted so the user can correct them.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has completed validation of all four editable card fields: Card Name, Card Active Status, Expiry Month, and Expiry Year
Acceptance_Criteria.When: All four fields have passed their respective validations with no input errors detected
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program state is promoted to 'Changes OK - Not Confirmed' (CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED); all screen fields are set to protected (non-editable); the function key area is highlighted in bright yellow; and the informational message prompts the user to confirm the changes by pressing PF5

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Overall Validation Outcome - All Fields Valid, Promote to Awaiting Confirmation
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all four card detail fields have been individually validated without any errors, the system promotes the update state to 'Changes OK - Awaiting Confirmation', protecting all fields from further editing and prompting the user to press PF5 to confirm and save the changes.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has confirmed their card changes by pressing PF5, and the card number is available in the current session
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system attempts to retrieve and lock the card record from the Card Database using the Card Number as the unique identifier
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The card record is locked exclusively for update using the Card Number as the lookup key, preventing any other user from modifying the same record until the update is complete or released

all_rules.Rule_Name: Lock Card Record Before Update
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before any card update can be performed, the system must exclusively lock the card record in the database using the card number as the key. This prevents other users from modifying the same record simultaneously during the update process.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has confirmed their card changes by pressing PF5 and the system has attempted to lock the card record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The card record cannot be locked because it is currently unavailable or held by another process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the status to 'Could Not Lock For Update', marks the input as an error, and the update does not proceed; the final outcome is evaluated as a Lock Error and the user is informed of the failure

all_rules.Rule_Name: Handle Record Lock Failure
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the card record cannot be locked for update — because it is already held by another process or is otherwise unavailable — the update must be aborted and the user must be informed of the failure.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card record has been successfully locked for update, and the system has the original values that were displayed to the user (Card Name, CVV Code, Expiry Year, Expiry Month, Expiry Day, Active Status)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system compares the current database values of the card record against the originally displayed values for all of the following fields: CVV Code, Cardholder Name (converted to uppercase), Expiry Year (positions 1–4 of expiry date), Expiry Month (positions 6–7 of expiry date), Expiry Day (positions 9–10 of expiry date), and Active Status
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If all six fields match exactly between the current database record and the originally displayed values, no concurrent modification is detected and the update proceeds; if any single field differs, a concurrent modification is detected and the update is aborted

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect Concurrent Modification of Card Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: After successfully locking the card record, the system must verify that no other user has changed the record between the time it was originally displayed to the current user and the time the update is being applied. This is done by comparing the current database values against the values that were originally shown to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has detected that the card record was modified by another user after it was originally displayed, by finding at least one difference in CVV Code, Cardholder Name, Expiry Year, Expiry Month, Expiry Day, or Active Status
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The concurrent modification is confirmed and the current update is aborted
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the status to 'Data Was Changed Before Update', refreshes the stored original values with the latest database values for CVV Code, Cardholder Name, Expiry Year, Expiry Month, Expiry Day, and Active Status, and the final outcome is evaluated as a Concurrent Change; the screen is re-displayed with the latest card details and the user is prompted to re-enter their changes

all_rules.Rule_Name: Abort Update and Refresh Card Data on Concurrent Change
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a concurrent modification is detected — meaning another user changed the card record after it was displayed to the current user — the current update must be aborted. The screen must be refreshed with the latest values from the database so the user can review the current state and re-enter their changes.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: No concurrent modification has been detected and the update is cleared to proceed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the updated card record for writing to the database
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The updated card record is assembled with the following values: Card Number (new value from user input), Account ID (from current session, numeric format), CVV Code (carried forward unchanged from the original record), Cardholder Name (new value entered by user), and Active Status (new value entered by user, Y or N)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Prepare Updated Card Record with New Field Values
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no concurrent modification is detected, the system prepares the updated card record by assembling the new values entered by the user alongside the unchanged values carried forward from the original record. The update record is initialized before being populated.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The updated card record is being prepared and the user has provided a new Expiry Year and new Expiry Month, while the original Expiry Day is retained from the originally displayed record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system constructs the expiry date field for the updated card record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The expiry date is formatted as YYYY-MM-DD by concatenating: the new Expiry Year (4 digits), a hyphen '-', the new Expiry Month (2 digits), a hyphen '-', and the original Expiry Day (2 digits, unchanged from the original record); the resulting date string is stored in the Card Expiry Date field of the update record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format Expiry Date as YYYY-MM-DD Preserving Original Day
all_rules.Rule_Description: The expiry date stored in the database must always follow the YYYY-MM-DD format. When preparing the update, the expiry year and expiry month come from the new values entered by the user, but the expiry day is always carried forward from the original record because the user is not permitted to change the expiry day.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The updated card record has been fully prepared with the new Card Name, formatted Expiry Date, new Active Status, carried-forward CVV Code, Card Number, and Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system writes the updated card record to the Card Database to replace the existing locked record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Database record is rewritten with the updated card record; the outcome of the write operation (success or failure) is captured for subsequent evaluation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Write Updated Card Record to Database
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the updated card record has been fully prepared with all new and carried-forward values, the system writes the updated record back to the Card Database, replacing the previously locked record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has attempted to write the updated card record to the Card Database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The write operation completes successfully with a normal response
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the status to 'Changes Okayed and Done'; the final outcome is evaluated as Update Success and the user is shown a confirmation that the changes have been saved to the database

all_rules.Rule_Name: Confirm Successful Card Update
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the write operation to the Card Database completes successfully, the system sets the program state to indicate that the changes have been saved, and the user is shown a success confirmation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card record was successfully locked for update and the updated record was prepared, but the write operation to the Card Database did not complete successfully
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The write operation returns a non-normal response
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the status to 'Locked But Update Failed'; the final outcome is evaluated as Update Failed and the user is informed of the failure

all_rules.Rule_Name: Handle Write Failure After Successful Lock
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the card record was successfully locked but the subsequent write operation fails, the system must set a specific failure status to distinguish this scenario from a lock failure. The user is informed that the update could not be completed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The write processing has completed and a final outcome status has been set: one of 'Could Not Lock For Update', 'Data Was Changed Before Update', 'Changes Okayed and Done', or 'Locked But Update Failed'
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the final outcome status
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system routes to the appropriate end state as follows: if the status is 'Could Not Lock For Update' then the program state is set to 'Changes Okayed Lock Error' and the user is informed of a lock failure; if the status is 'Data Was Changed Before Update' then the program state is set to 'Show Details' and the screen is refreshed with the latest card data prompting the user to re-enter changes; if the status is 'Changes Okayed and Done' (normal write success) then the program state remains 'Changes Okayed and Done' and the user receives a success confirmation; if the status is 'Locked But Update Failed' then the program state is set to 'Changes Okayed But Failed' and the user is informed of the failure

all_rules.Rule_Name: Evaluate and Route Final Update Outcome to Appropriate End State
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the write processing completes, the system evaluates the final outcome status and routes the program to the appropriate end state, each with a distinct user-facing result: lock error, concurrent change, success, or update failure.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card record has been retrieved from the database as part of the concurrent update check, and the cardholder name field (Card Embossed Name) may contain lowercase or mixed-case characters
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to compare the current database record against the values originally fetched and displayed to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system converts all lowercase alphabetic characters in the Card Embossed Name retrieved from the database to uppercase before any field-level comparison is performed, ensuring the name comparison is case-insensitive

all_rules.Rule_Name: BR-21.1.1: Normalize Card Name to Uppercase Before Concurrent Update Comparison
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before comparing the card record retrieved from the database against the values originally shown to the user, the cardholder name from the database must be converted to uppercase to ensure a case-insensitive, consistent comparison.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has confirmed their changes and the system has successfully locked the card record for update, and the system holds the originally fetched values for: CVV Code, Card Name (uppercase), Expiry Year (positions 1-4 of expiry date), Expiry Month (positions 6-2 of expiry date), Expiry Day (positions 9-2 of expiry date), and Active Status
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system compares the current database values against the originally fetched values across all six fields simultaneously: CVV Code, Card Name (after uppercase conversion), Expiry Year, Expiry Month, Expiry Day, and Active Status
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If ALL six fields match between the current database record and the originally fetched values, the system determines that no concurrent modification has occurred and proceeds safely with the card update; if ANY one or more of the six fields do not match, the system determines that the record was changed by another user and cancels the current update attempt

all_rules.Rule_Name: BR-21.1.2: Detect Concurrent Modification by Comparing All Card Fields Against Originally Fetched Values
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system performs a comprehensive six-field comparison between the current database record and the values originally displayed to the user to detect whether another user has modified the card record in the interim. All six fields must match for the update to be considered safe to proceed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has completed the six-field comparison between the current database record and the originally fetched values for CVV Code, Card Name, Expiry Year, Expiry Month, Expiry Day, and Active Status
Acceptance_Criteria.When: All six fields match exactly between the current database record and the originally fetched values (CVV Code matches AND Card Name matches AND Expiry Year matches AND Expiry Month matches AND Expiry Day matches AND Active Status matches)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the concurrent-change indicator to 'No Change Detected', confirms it is safe to proceed with writing the user's updates to the database, and continues with the card update write operation without interruption

all_rules.Rule_Name: BR-21.1.3: Allow Update to Proceed When No Concurrent Modification is Detected
all_rules.Rule_Description: When all six card fields in the current database record exactly match the values originally fetched and displayed to the user, the system confirms that no other user has modified the record and the pending update is safe to apply.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has completed the six-field comparison between the current database record and the originally fetched values
Acceptance_Criteria.When: At least one of the following mismatches is detected: CVV Code in the database does not match the originally fetched CVV Code, OR Card Name in the database (after uppercase conversion) does not match the originally fetched Card Name, OR Expiry Year in the database does not match the originally fetched Expiry Year, OR Expiry Month in the database does not match the originally fetched Expiry Month, OR Expiry Day in the database does not match the originally fetched Expiry Day, OR Active Status in the database does not match the originally fetched Active Status
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the concurrent-change indicator to 'Data Was Changed Before Update', marking that another user has modified the record since it was last displayed to the current user, and the current user's update attempt is cancelled

all_rules.Rule_Name: BR-21.1.4: Flag Record as Concurrently Modified When Any Field Mismatch is Detected
all_rules.Rule_Description: If any one of the six compared fields (CVV Code, Card Name, Expiry Year, Expiry Month, Expiry Day, or Active Status) differs between the current database record and the values originally shown to the user, the system concludes that another user has modified the card record and the current update must be cancelled.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has detected that the card record was modified by another user (concurrent modification flag is set to 'Data Was Changed Before Update')
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system refreshes the held card values after detecting the concurrent modification
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system overwrites all six originally fetched held values with the latest values from the current database record: the held CVV Code is replaced with the database CVV Code, the held Card Name is replaced with the database Card Name (uppercase), the held Expiry Year is replaced with characters 1-4 of the database expiry date, the held Expiry Month is replaced with characters 6-2 of the database expiry date, the held Expiry Day is replaced with characters 9-2 of the database expiry date, and the held Active Status is replaced with the database Active Status; the update write operation is then immediately cancelled and control returns to the calling update process

all_rules.Rule_Name: BR-21.1.5: Refresh Held Card Values with Latest Database Data After Concurrent Modification is Detected
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a concurrent modification is detected, the system replaces the previously held (originally fetched) card values with the latest values from the database, so that the most current data is available to be re-displayed to the user for review before they can attempt another update.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The write processing routine has returned with the concurrent-change indicator set to 'Data Was Changed Before Update', indicating that another user modified the card record before the current user's confirmed update could be saved
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the outcome of the write processing after the user pressed PF5 to confirm their changes
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the program display state to 'Show Details', causing the screen to be refreshed and re-displayed to the user with the latest card values retrieved from the database (the refreshed held values), so the user can see what the record currently contains before deciding to re-enter and re-confirm their changes

all_rules.Rule_Name: BR-21.1.6: Re-Display Latest Card Details to User After Concurrent Modification Cancels Update
all_rules.Rule_Description: After a concurrent modification is detected and the update is cancelled, the program transitions the screen state to Show Details so that the user is presented with the latest card data from the database, allowing them to review the current values and decide whether to re-submit their changes.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A confirmed card update request has passed concurrent change validation and the system is ready to construct the update record for writing to the database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system begins preparing the card update record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All fields in the card update record are reset to their initial empty state, ensuring no previously held values remain before new data is populated

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Update Record Before Populating New Card Data
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before writing updated card information to the database, the card update record must be fully cleared to ensure no residual or stale data from previous operations is carried forward into the new update.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card update record has been initialized and the new card number is available from the user's confirmed update request
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the card number field in the update record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The new card number (CCUP-NEW-CARDID) is copied into the card update record's card number field (CARD-UPDATE-NUM), uniquely identifying the card being updated

all_rules.Rule_Name: Carry Forward Card Number Into Update Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The card number associated with the update request must be written into the update record to correctly identify which card record is being modified in the database.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card update record has been initialized and the account ID is available as a numeric value (CC-ACCT-ID-N) from the current session
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the account ID field in the update record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The numeric account ID (CC-ACCT-ID-N) is copied into the card update record's account ID field (CARD-UPDATE-ACCT-ID), preserving the card-to-account relationship

all_rules.Rule_Name: Associate Account ID With the Card Update Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The account identifier must be included in the card update record to maintain the association between the credit card and its owning account in the database.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card update record has been initialized and the CVV code (CCUP-NEW-CVV-CD) has been carried forward from the original card record that was read and displayed to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the CVV security code field in the update record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The CVV code value (CCUP-NEW-CVV-CD) is first staged into the CVV working field (CARD-CVV-CD-X), and then the resulting numeric CVV value (CARD-CVV-CD-N) is copied into the card update record's CVV field (CARD-UPDATE-CVV-CD), preserving the original security code without any user modification

all_rules.Rule_Name: Preserve Original CVV Security Code in Update Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The CVV security code must be carried forward unchanged from the original card record into the update record. The CVV is not a user-editable field and must remain as originally stored to preserve card security integrity.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card update record has been initialized, and the new cardholder name (CCUP-NEW-CRDNAME) has been entered by the user, validated as alphabetic-only, and confirmed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the embossed cardholder name field in the update record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The new cardholder name (CCUP-NEW-CRDNAME) is copied into the card update record's embossed name field (CARD-UPDATE-EMBOSSED-NAME), replacing the previously stored name

all_rules.Rule_Name: Write New Embossed Cardholder Name Into Update Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The new cardholder name entered and validated by the user must be written into the update record as the embossed name on the card. This replaces the previously stored cardholder name.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card update record has been initialized, the new expiry year (CCUP-NEW-EXPYEAR) and new expiry month (CCUP-NEW-EXPMON) have been entered and validated by the user, and the original expiry day (CCUP-NEW-EXPDAY, carried forward from the original record) is available
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system formats and populates the card expiry date field in the update record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The expiry date is constructed by concatenating the new expiry year, a hyphen separator '-', the new expiry month, a hyphen separator '-', and the original expiry day, resulting in a date string in YYYY-MM-DD format, which is stored in the card update record's expiry date field (CARD-UPDATE-EXPIRAION-DATE). The expiry day component is never changed from its original value regardless of user input.

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format Card Expiry Date as YYYY-MM-DD Combining New Year and Month With Original Day
all_rules.Rule_Description: The card expiry date must be stored in the database in a standardized YYYY-MM-DD format. The year and month are taken from the user's new input, while the expiry day is always preserved from the original card record since the expiry day is not an editable field.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card update record has been initialized, and the new card active status (CCUP-NEW-CRDSTCD) has been entered by the user with a value of either 'Y' (Active) or 'N' (Inactive), validated, and confirmed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the card active status field in the update record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The new card active status value (CCUP-NEW-CRDSTCD), which must be either 'Y' for Active or 'N' for Inactive, is copied into the card update record's active status field (CARD-UPDATE-ACTIVE-STATUS), replacing the previously stored status

all_rules.Rule_Name: Write New Card Active Status Into Update Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The new card active status entered and validated by the user must be written into the update record. The status indicates whether the card is active (Y) or inactive (N) and controls whether the card can be used for transactions.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update program is being entered for the first time in a new session (program entry state is set to fresh/initial entry)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the screen fields for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All screen fields including Account Number, Card Number, Card Name, Card Status, Expiry Day, Expiry Month, and Expiry Year are left empty and no values are populated on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Skip Screen Field Population on Fresh Program Entry
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the credit card update screen is accessed for the first time in a new session (fresh program entry), no field values should be populated on the screen. All screen fields are left empty to present a clean entry form to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update program is in a re-entry session (not a fresh program entry) and the current session Account ID has a numeric value of zero
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the Account Number field for display on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account Number field on the screen is set to blank (low-values), displaying no account number to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Blank Account Number Field When Account ID Is Zero
all_rules.Rule_Description: During a re-entry session, if the current Account ID held in the session has a numeric value of zero (meaning no account has been selected or the account was cleared), the Account Number field on the screen must be displayed as blank.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update program is in a re-entry session (not a fresh program entry) and the current session Account ID has a non-zero numeric value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the Account Number field for display on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account Number field on the screen is populated with the current Account ID value from the session

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Account Number on Screen When Account ID Is Non-Zero
all_rules.Rule_Description: During a re-entry session, if the current Account ID held in the session has a non-zero numeric value (meaning a valid account has been selected), the Account Number field on the screen must be populated with the current Account ID value.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update program is in a re-entry session (not a fresh program entry) and the current session Card Number has a numeric value of zero
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the Card Number field for display on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Number field on the screen is set to blank (low-values), displaying no card number to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Blank Card Number Field When Card Number Is Zero
all_rules.Rule_Description: During a re-entry session, after the Account Number field has been handled, if the current Card Number held in the session has a numeric value of zero (meaning no card has been selected or the card was cleared), the Card Number field on the screen must be displayed as blank.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update program is in a re-entry session (not a fresh program entry) and the current session Card Number has a non-zero numeric value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the Card Number field for display on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Number field on the screen is populated with the current Card Number value from the session

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Card Number on Screen When Card Number Is Non-Zero
all_rules.Rule_Description: During a re-entry session, after the Account Number field has been handled, if the current Card Number held in the session has a non-zero numeric value (meaning a valid card has been selected), the Card Number field on the screen must be populated with the current Card Number value.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update program is in a re-entry session and the current program state is 'Details Not Yet Fetched' (no card lookup has been performed yet)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the card detail fields for display on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All five card detail fields are set to blank (low-values): Card Name field, Card Status field, Expiry Day field, Expiry Month field, and Expiry Year field are all cleared on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear All Card Detail Fields When Card Details Have Not Yet Been Fetched
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the program state indicates that card details have not yet been retrieved from the database (the user is still in the search phase), all card detail fields on the screen must be cleared to blank. This prevents stale or misleading data from being shown before a card lookup has been performed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update program is in a re-entry session and the current program state is 'Showing Fetched Card Details' (a successful card lookup has been performed)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the card detail fields for display on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All five card detail fields are populated with the previously fetched database values: Card Name field is set to the fetched Card Name, Card Status field is set to the fetched Card Active Status, Expiry Day field is set to the fetched Expiry Day, Expiry Month field is set to the fetched Expiry Month, and Expiry Year field is set to the fetched Expiry Year

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Previously Fetched Card Detail Values When Showing Card Details
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the program state indicates that card details are being shown to the user (after a successful card lookup), all five card detail fields on the screen must be populated with the original values that were retrieved from the database. These are the stored 'old' values representing the current state of the card record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update program is in a re-entry session and the current program state is 'Changes Made by User' (the user has entered modifications to card details)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the card detail fields for display on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Name field is set to the newly entered Card Name value, the Card Status field is set to the newly entered Card Status value, the Expiry Month field is set to the newly entered Expiry Month value, the Expiry Year field is set to the newly entered Expiry Year value, AND the Expiry Day field is set to the original fetched Expiry Day value (not the user-entered value), preserving the original expiry day throughout the update process

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Newly Entered Card Detail Values While Preserving Original Expiry Day When Changes Have Been Made
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the program state indicates that the user has made changes to card details (changes are in progress, pending validation or confirmation), the screen must display the new values entered by the user for Card Name, Card Status, Expiry Month, and Expiry Year. However, the Expiry Day field must always retain and display the original value fetched from the database, as the Expiry Day is not editable by the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The credit card update program is in a re-entry session and the current program state is any state other than 'Details Not Yet Fetched', 'Showing Fetched Card Details', or 'Changes Made by User' (for example: changes confirmed and saved, lock error, update failure, or any other state)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the card detail fields for display on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All five card detail fields are populated with the previously fetched database values: Card Name field is set to the fetched Card Name, Card Status field is set to the fetched Card Active Status, Expiry Day field is set to the fetched Expiry Day, Expiry Month field is set to the fetched Expiry Month, and Expiry Year field is set to the fetched Expiry Year

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Previously Fetched Card Detail Values for All Other Program States
all_rules.Rule_Description: For any program state not explicitly handled by the other state-specific rules (such as changes confirmed and done, lock errors, update failures, or any unexpected state), the screen must fall back to displaying the original values that were retrieved from the database for all five card detail fields.

description:
COCRDUPC is an online CICS program that handles credit card detail updates, allowing users to search for a credit card by account and card number, view the existing card details, make changes to card name, active status, and expiry date, and commit those changes after validation and confirmation.
